# dsh-usage · Token Usage Breakdown, API Balance & Cost Monitor for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) English | [中文](README.zh.md)

   

Token Usage Breakdown, Multi-Provider Balance & Cost Monitor for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
Daily Token Analytics · Provider API Balance · Subscription Quotas · Peak/Off-Peak Costing · Token Bank

A dedicated token usage and cost monitoring plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI and official desktop client: multi-provider balances, coding subscription quota tracking, live token accounting ledgers, and a compact quick-glance card above settings in the sidebar. ## What it does The plugin runs a host-side service and a first-level settings section (使用统计, directly below the Workshop entry): - **Usage tab (用量)**: today's token totals per bucket (input / output / cache read / cache write, disjoint as the provider reports them) with per-provider and per-model breakdown, the last 30 days as a horizontal provider/model bar chart, and the balance of every configured provider (one row per adapter family: a dormant catalog alias shadowed by the family's live route no longer renders its own balance row). A **day picker** switches that card to any retained day that recorded usage (today first, then the other days newest first) and the card then shows that day's own totals, provider rows, and estimated spend; the peak/off-peak line stays on today because it describes the pricing window now. The ledger folds live `session/event` streams (`request/header` route attribution plus `assistant/message` usage) into `$DSH_HOME/dsh-usage/usage-ledger.json` with day-based retention, so past days survive restarts; counting starts when the plugin is first enabled. For the official DeepSeek family the tab also shows the current peak/off-peak pricing period (Beijing weekdays 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 are peak, billed at double) and today's estimated spend in CNY. - **Plans tab (个人套餐)**: coding-plan quota windows for every configured provider that exposes one — used percent and reset time per window (Kimi For Coding 5h/week, GLM Coding Plan 5h/week/month, OpenCode Go rolling/weekly/monthly, MiniMax 5h/week, Codex / ChatGPT subscription 5h/week). Providers without a real plan or subscription (DeepSeek, ZenMux, Moonshot, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow) never appear on this tab; their balance shows on the usage tab instead. - **Token Bank tab (Token 银行)**: the whale-yuan voucher (鲸元券) minted from the official DeepSeek family's ledger at an anti-inflation exchange rate of 1,000,000 tokens per whale yuan. The tab sums the family's retained-ledger tokens (the `deepseek` catalog alias and the live `deepseek-official` route combined), stamps the minted face value onto the banknote artwork with a serial line carrying the minting window, and offers a save-image button plus a native share button when the browser supports sharing files. The spend line shows the real CNY total observed from the official balance once available — balance decreases accrue as spend, top-ups never count — and falls back to the fold-time estimate before the first observation. The minted total prefers the host's whole-ledger aggregate and falls back to the last 30 days on an older host; with no official DeepSeek usage the tab shows its empty state. A day picker mints the note from one picked day instead of the whole retention window (the observed-spend line, which accrues from the first balance reading, is whole-window only and falls back to that day's fold-time estimate on a single day). The on-note text is locale-neutral (digits, latin captions, ISO dates) and the export is rendered locally in the browser. - **Sidebar foot card**: a compact glance seated above the sidebar's Settings row — today's estimated spend as the headline (today's tokens when nothing priced is recorded yet), the tokens/calls line, and up to two configured-provider balances with a +N overflow. The whole card is one button that opens the usage settings section, so detail stays in one place, and the corner chevron folds it into a one-line strip (the spending provider's name, the label, and the headline value), a choice persisted across reloads. It polls at a relaxed 30 s cadence while the tab is visible, hides in the collapsed 56 px rail, and disappears while the plugin is disabled. - Probes run entirely host-side on a poll cycle (default 60 s, manual refresh button); API keys are resolved through the harness credential seam (`llm-pi-ai` records, `apiKeyEnv` references) and never reach the browser. Supported balance endpoints: DeepSeek (the official live route `deepseek-official` and the catalog alias `deepseek` both resolve), Moonshot (CN/international), OpenRouter, SiliconFlow (CN/international), ZenMux. Supported plan endpoints: Kimi For Coding, GLM Coding Plan (CN via open.bigmodel.cn, international via api.z.ai — the `zai` route the pi-ai catalog registers, plus the `zai-coding` / `zai-coding-cn` aliases; 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, token-metered and credit-metered plans), OpenCode Go, MiniMax, Codex / ChatGPT subscription (OAuth access token from the pi-ai grant; a stale token shows an error until the harness next refreshes it). Providers without a programmatic endpoint (Qwen token plans, OpenCode Zen PAYG, Anthropic, OpenAI) are listed without facts. ### Spend estimate scope Today's spend is an estimate priced at fold time from the published DeepSeek peak/off-peak price book (CNY per million tokens; peak = the windows above, off-peak half of peak). The rows in force are `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) and `deepseek-v4-pro`: the retired flash ids (`deepseek-v4-flash`, `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) bill the flash row, and `deepseek-v4-pro` moves to that row once DeepSeek routes the id to V4.1-Flash on 2026-09-14 12:00 Beijing. It covers the official DeepSeek routes only — relay traffic billed elsewhere (ZenMux, SiliconFlow, ...) stays unpriced — and unknown DeepSeek model ids take the flash-class row. Buckets recorded before a price change keep the old pricing, so a price-book update is reflected from the moment it ships, not retroactively. The published rule bills a Chinese public holiday entirely off-peak even on a Monday-Friday, and bills an adjusted workday falling on a Saturday or Sunday off-peak too. Weekends are therefore already off-peak by construction, and this package ships the State Council holiday table (`src/core/holidays.ts`, 2020 through 2026, taken from the MIT-licensed [chinese-holidays-node](https://github.com/bastengao/chinese-holidays-node) yearly data with only its `holiday` entries), so a public-holiday weekday is estimated at the off-peak row instead of reading up to about twice the real spend. A year the table does not cover (later than 2026) falls back to the published windows, which reads high rather than low — the safer direction to be wrong in. ## Install Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or later: the plugin is developed against the 0.2.1-rc.2 DSH cohort (its settings page is the Host-generated page of the plugin's own Config schema) and its `@deepseek-ai/*` runtime imports are provided by the host itself. In your profile (e.g. `~/.dsh/profiles/web`): ```bash pnpm add @linxin666/dsh-usage ``` and insert into `cordis.patch.yml` (or use the bundle patch): ```yaml - insert: - id: usage name: '@linxin666/dsh-usage' ``` Restart `dsh web` for the host half; the client half applies on refresh. The section lives in `Settings -> Usage Statistics`. ## Configuration | Key | Default | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | `enabled` | `true` | Master switch; off = no listeners, no probes, no routes | | `pollIntervalSec` | `60` | Provider probe cycle (30-3600 s; a change reloads the plugin row) | | `retainDays` | `180` | Ledger retention in local days (7-730) | ## Known limitations - Usage counting starts when the plugin is first enabled; historical sessions are not backfilled. - OAuth-based routes (for example qwen OAuth grants) are detected as such but not probed; the plugin does not spend third-party OAuth budgets. - A failed probe keeps the previous fact visible and reports the error line; providers may rate-limit aggressive polling. - The voucher's face value covers the ledger's retention window (`retainDays`): pruned days drop out of both the trend chart and the note. - The day pickers list only days the ledger recorded usage on: a day without usage is never offered, and a day pruned by retention leaves an empty or zeroed card rather than a different one. - The real-spend watch starts at the first official balance observation: earlier consumption is not backfilled, and only observed balance decreases accrue (a balance rise is a top-up and never counts). # @linxin666/dsh-usage DSH Web GUI 的用量统计插件:按 provider 记录 token 账本、探测余额与编码套餐额度,并在侧栏 Settings 上方放一张紧凑的价格速览卡。 Usage statistics plugin for the DSH web GUI: per-provider balance and coding-plan quota detection plus a live token usage ledger, with a compact price glance card above the sidebar's Settings row. > 双语说明:每一节先中文、后英文,两种语言都能独立读完。 > Bilingual on purpose: each section gives the Chinese text first, then the English text; either half reads on its own. ![使用统计面板(今日视图) · The usage panel, today view](preview/final-today.png) --- ## 简介 · Overview ### 中文 `dsh-usage` 是 DeepSeek Harness(DSH)的用量统计插件。本仓库包含它的源码、构建产物与测试脚本,并在上游@linxin666/dsh-usage 0.4.8 之上做了四类增强: 1. **使用统计面板重做**(浏览器半边 `lib/client.js`)——8 个统计窗口、6 格汇总、趋势图、按渠道/按模型的彩色拆分,详见下文「特性」。 2. **会话日志回填**(host 半边 `lib/index.js`)——插件挂载之前发生的用量,从会话日志补读回来;由 `src/` 直接构建。 3. **多设备账本**——每台机器写自己的 `usage-ledger..json`,总览相加所有设备;账本可导出/导入,导入是替换而非合并,同一文件导入两次不会重复计数。详见 [`docs/multi-device.md`](docs/multi-device.md)。 4. **上游 0.4.8 合并**——DeepSeek 峰谷价标签;识别反向代理的 loopback 校验(`isProxiedRequest()`):带 `x-forwarded-for`、`cf-connecting-ip`、`x-real-ip` 或 `forwarded` 头的请求不再被当作本机直连,堵住 GUI 挂在反代后面的鉴权绕过;反代必须配置 `proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;`(nginx 默认不注任何转发头),详见 [`docs/upstream-and-local-patches.md`](docs/upstream-and-local-patches.md)。 基线是 npm 上正式发布的 **0.4.8**(本地合并,不是上游 fork)。 ### English `dsh-usage` is the usage-statistics plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). This repository holds its sources, build output and test harnesses, plus four groups of enhancements on top of upstream 0.4.8: 1. **A redesigned usage panel** (browser half, `lib/client.js`) — eight statistic windows, a six-cell totals row, a trend chart and a colour-coded channel/model breakdown; see Features below. 2. **Session-log backfill** (host half, `lib/index.js`) — usage that happened before the plugin mounted is read back from the session logs; built straight from `src/`. 3. **Multi-device ledgers** — each machine writes its own `usage-ledger..json` and the overview sums every device; ledgers can be exported and imported, and importing replaces (never merges), so the same file cannot double-count. Windows up to 45 days are summed day by day; anything longer — all time, or a custom range past 45 days — is answered by one `GET /api/dsh-usage/range` aggregate, so a six-month view no longer has to fetch two hundred days one at a time. **A six-cell totals row that answers the cache question.** Total tokens, input, output, cache read, cache-hit ratio and calls, where the ratio is `cacheRead / (input + cacheRead + cacheWrite)` — the number to look at when judging whether prompt caching pays for itself. **A trend chart that survives long windows.** `TrendChart` buckets daily up to 45 days, weekly from 46 to 200, monthly beyond that; gridlines follow the 1/2/5×10ⁿ steps; the hover tooltip shows totals, calls, the hit ratio and the top three models; days with nothing recorded say so explicitly. **One colour per model, everywhere.** Colours come from a stable hash of the normalized model name over a sixteen-hue palette, so a model keeps a single hue across the trend chart, the channel bars, the model rows, the legend and the tooltip. Spellings that differ only by letter case or by a `provider/` prefix (`DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` vs `deepseek-v4.1-flash`) fold into one model instead of splitting into two colours. **A breakdown that lists every model, not just the top three.** Each channel draws one bar stacked by its models, then lists every model the host returned (the wire caps a provider at twelve rows) with a sub-bar in the same hue. The channel bar measures against the window total, so its length is the channel's share of the window; the model sub-bars measure against their own channel, so they read as how that channel splits. The channel header carries the heavier type and the sub-rows sit one step lighter, which keeps the two levels apart at a glance. **One click from the sidebar to the panel.** Clicking the usage card at the bottom of the sidebar opens the usage-statistics settings page directly instead of going through the account menu. It asks the shell's registry to open the page (a synthetic Ctrl+, keydown, the platform default) and falls back to the account-menu path only if the page has not appeared within 500 ms. --- ## 快速开始 · Quick start ### 中文 环境要求:Node `^22.19.0` 或 `>=24.0.0`,DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2`,React `^18.2.0`(peer)。许可证 Apache-2.0。 ```bash pnpm install --frozen-lockfile # 从 pnpm-lock.yaml 装工具链 cd packages/dsh-usage && ../../node_modules/.bin/tsc -b tsconfig.build.json \ && ../../node_modules/.bin/tsdown # 构建(~100 ms,exit 0) cd ../.. && node harness/build-test-bundle.cjs && node harness/render-test.mjs node --experimental-strip-types harness/host-test.mjs ``` 期望输出:`=== 243/243 checks passed ===` 和 `=== 288/288 checks passed ===`。`node_modules/` 已被 git 忽略,新克隆的仓库要先装依赖;构建能逐字节复现已提交的产物。 ### English Requirements: Node `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0`, DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2`, React `^18.2.0` (peer). []; for (const packageName of bundles) { /* resolve, read dsh.bundle.patch, load */ } ``` 插件管理器和插件市场两条路会自动登记;手工 `pnpm add` 只做了第 1 步,所以要补上: ```bash node -e ' const fs = require("fs"); const p = "package.json"; const m = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p, "utf8")); m.dsh ??= {}; m.dsh.profile ??= {}; const b = m.dsh.profile.bundles ??= []; if (!b.includes("@linxin666/dsh-usage")) { b.push("@linxin666/dsh-usage"); fs.writeFileSync(p, JSON.stringify(m, null, 2) + "\n"); console.log("added to dsh.profile.bundles"); } else console.log("already in dsh.profile.bundles"); ' ``` 然后**重启 DSH**:host bundle 在启动时一次性进 ESM 图,新的 host 路由必须重启(只改客户端半边的话,刷新页面即可)。 **踩坑清单:** - `#path:/packages/dsh-usage` 必填——插件在仓库的子目录里,不在根目录。 - 离线机器可改用本地克隆:`git+file:///E:/path/to/dsh-usage/.git#path:/packages/dsh-usage`;目录本身不是 git checkout 时用 `file:E:/path/to/dsh-usage/packages/dsh-usage`。POSIX 风格路径的 `file:` 会报 `ERR_PNPM_LINKED_PKG_DIR_NOT_FOUND`,Windows 上要传 Windows 路径(`cygpath -w`)。 - pnpm 会把 git 依赖解析成钉住 commit 的 codeload tarball(`pnpm-lock.yaml` 里形如 `…/tar.gz/#path:/packages/dsh-usage`),装出来是一份**真拷贝,不是链接**:好处是别的插件再也覆盖不掉,坏处是**新提交不会自己过来**——推完之后重跑一次 `pnpm add`(或 `pnpm update @linxin666/dsh-usage`)。 - `hoisted` linker 下改 `src/` 不会更新已安装的机器:重新构建、提交、再跑一次 `pnpm add`。 - 命令以 `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`(koffi、node-pty、protobufjs……)收尾是 profile 既有的噪声,不是失败。装好后用 `patches/audit-store.sh` 加下面的哈希表验证;树已经来自本仓库,`patches/install-patches.sh` 不再需要。 ### English Two steps: install the package into the profile, then register it in `dsh.profile.bundles`. **Step 1 — install.** Profiles normally pin this package to a registry version, and any other plugin's install, update or removal re-resolves that pin and **overwrites the copy**. Pointing the profile at a git dependency pins the commit instead and makes the copy stable: ```bash cd "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles/desktop" pnpm remove @linxin666/dsh-usage pnpm add "github:beici/dsh-usage-for-personal-use#path:/packages/dsh-usage" ``` **Step 2 — register the bundle.** The host builds its patch layers from the `dsh.profile.bundles` list, not from `node_modules` — a package that is installed but absent from the list is simply never loaded: no patch layer, no routes, no panel: ```js // loadProfileDirectory() in the DSH host const bundles = readProfileManifest(binName, dir).dsh?.profile?.bundles ?? []; for (const packageName of bundles) { /* resolve, read dsh.bundle.patch, load */ } ``` The plugin manager and the plugin market register the bundle for you; a bare `pnpm add` does not, so add it by hand: ```bash node -e ' const fs = require("fs"); const p = "package.json"; const m = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p, "utf8")); m.dsh ??= {}; m.dsh.profile ??= {}; const b = m.dsh.profile.bundles ??= []; if (!b.includes("@linxin666/dsh-usage")) { b.push("@linxin666/dsh-usage"); fs.writeFileSync(p, JSON.stringify(m, null, 2) + "\n"); console.log("added to dsh.profile.bundles"); } else console.log("already in dsh.profile.bundles"); ' ``` Then **restart DSH**: the host bundle joins the ESM graph once at boot, so new host routes need a restart (client-only changes reload on page refresh). **Pitfalls:** - `#path:/packages/dsh-usage` is required — the plugin lives in a subdirectory of the repository, not at its root. - On a machine without network access to the remote, use a local clone: `git+file:///E:/path/to/dsh-usage/.git#path:/packages/dsh-usage`; for a plain directory that is not a git checkout, `file:E:/path/to/dsh-usage/packages/dsh-usage`. A POSIX-style path with `file:` fails (`ERR_PNPM_LINKED_PKG_DIR_NOT_FOUND`) — pass a Windows path (`cygpath -w`) on Windows. - pnpm resolves the git dependency to a commit-pinned codeload tarball (`…/tar.gz/#path:/packages/dsh-usage` in `pnpm-lock.yaml`), so the installed tree is a **real copy, not a link**: other plugins can no longer overwrite it, but **new commits do not arrive by themselves** — re-run `pnpm add` (or `pnpm update @linxin666/dsh-usage`) after pushing. - Under the `hoisted` linker, editing `src/` does not update an installed machine: rebuild, commit, run `pnpm add` again. - Ending with `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS` (koffi, node-pty, protobufjs, ...) is pre-existing profile noise, not a failure. # dsh-agentdescent

Evolve skills, agent definitions, prompts, code and host plugins from inside
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), using
[AgentDescent](https://github.com/Birfy/agentdescent).

```bash
pip install "agentdescent[mcp]"            # the tools this plugin exposes
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-agentdescent
```

The plugin registers the `agentdescent` skill at runtime -- no file to install,
and it cannot drift from the package -- and its `cordis.patch.yml` adds the
`agentdescent mcp` server, so the model gets `mcp__agentdescent__plan`,
`__start`, `__status`, `__show`, `__apply`, `__list_algorithms`,
`__describe_algorithm` and the rest. Named methods match
`agentdescent algorithms list` / `show` (dsh has no slash surface; use the
skill or those tools).

Check it composed:

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -n agentdescent
```

`agentdescent install dsh` is the alternative that needs no npm install: it
writes the same skill as a file into `$DSH_HOME/skills/` and the same MCP row
into `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`. Use one or the other, not both.

Generated from the Python package; see `agentdescent/integrations/__init__.py`.

# AgentDescent

**[Website & interactive demo](https://birfy.github.io/agentdescent/)** ·
[Get started](https://birfy.github.io/agentdescent/install/) ·
[Documentation](https://birfy.github.io/agentdescent/docs/)

> **Gradient descent — but the parameters are agents.** A parallel, asynchronous
> framework for self-evolving agents (skills, prompts, harnesses) where **diffs
> are the gradients** and **the aggregator is the optimizer**.

[![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.22348027.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22348027)
[![PyPI](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/agentdescent)](https://pypi.org/project/agentdescent/)
[![tests](https://github.com/Birfy/agentdescent/actions/workflows/tests.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Birfy/agentdescent/actions/workflows/tests.yml)
[![docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-mkdocs--material-1f6feb)](https://birfy.github.io/agentdescent/)
[![python](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-%E2%89%A53.9-1f6feb)](https://www.python.org/)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-3fb950)](https://github.com/Birfy/agentdescent/blob/main/LICENSE)

*N* workers propose edits to a shared artifact **in parallel**; a barrier-free
aggregator merges them into one version-controlled library. Serial
self-improvement is bounded at one accepted change per iteration, and merging
concurrent edits is the attempt to lift that bound.

The place the analogy has to break is the whole design: **gradients add, diffs do
not.** So aggregation is not averaging but conflict resolution, fusion,
statistical acceptance and a transactional commit.

## What it measures

Every row names the setting that produced it, and
[the full results page](https://birfy.github.io/agentdescent/results/) also
reports the runs where there was nothing left to learn.

| | measured | setting |
|---|---|---|
| An artifact held in **one key**, where a keyed union can never fuse | keyed union fuses **0 of 48** merges · reflective merge **42 of 48** | BBH `dyck_languages`, `GLM-5.2`, *N*=4, 4 seeds |
| What that costs, at a pinned rollout budget | **40% fewer model calls** (95% CI 27–54%, same direction on every seed) | the same runs |
| Wall-clock against a *faithful* serial control | median **6.8×** (three seeds, 3.1–9.5×) | GEPA on HotpotQA, *N*=4, 16 rollouts pinned |
| The one-call path, end to end | held-out exact match **0.167 → 0.583** | 40 HotpotQA items, 12 held out |

Quality is claimed only where the design can support it. The
[paper](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22348027) reports intervals rather than
*p*-values where a comparison cannot reach significance, and says so.

## How it works

![AgentDescent architecture: N workers roll out against ledger snapshots and emit
diffs with evidence cards into a buffer; a single aggregator thread runs the
five-stage merge pipeline and commits to a git-backed ledger; four pluggable
seams sit under the components they select; the L0 governance layer gates the
audit step.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Birfy/agentdescent/main/docs/assets/architecture.png)

**Solid, top:** the fixed data path. *N* workers roll out tasks against ledger
snapshots and emit diffs with evidence cards; one aggregator thread runs the
five-stage merge and commits winners; the green edge is the only feedback path,
bounded by the lag budget.

**Dashed, bottom:** the seams, each selected by one keyword argument of
`evolve()`. **Red:** the governance layer, deliberately *not* a seam — a
self-modifying system must not be able to replace its own evaluator.

Stages 1–5 are one optimizer step over a discrete space. Whether that step has
anything to do at all is decided upstream, by the **key space** your strategy
writes — edits on disjoint keys fuse, edits on the same key conflict. That is
why the table above starts with a one-key artifact.

The figure is the paper's, rendered from its TikZ source by
[`tools/gen_architecture_figure.py`](tools/gen_architecture_figure.py) so it
cannot drift from what the paper shows.

## Install and run the offline demo

Install **0.8.0** from PyPI:

```bash
pip install "agentdescent>=0.8.0"
agentdescent demo
```

Or, when developing from source, install your checkout:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Birfy/agentdescent && cd agentdescent
pip install -e .
agentdescent demo
```

The library supports Python ≥ 3.9 and installs NumPy for its
prediction-powered audit estimator. The packaged demo runs the offline
evolution loop without a model API key and ends with output like:

```
held-out reward: 1.000 outcomes: {'committed': 1}
what it learned: rules.md -> 'COLUMN: amount'
```

Research examples are outside the wheel. To run the
`python -m examples.run_demo` comparison, clone the repo and follow
[install and first run](docs/install.md).
The library includes [`evolve()`](docs/evolution.md),
[`DirectoryStrategy`](docs/directory-evolution.md), and its algorithm ports.

## Quickstart — a dataset to an evolved skill

One entry point, `evolve()`, and three building blocks that turn a dataset into
its arguments. The decisions that are actually yours — your data, how to score
it, which model — are the ones you still make.

**Set your key first.** Credentials are read from the environment at call time —
never from code, arguments, or a file the repo owns — and the base URL is what
picks the provider:

```bash
export OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://api.deepseek.com   # or GLM, a local vLLM, OpenAI itself
export OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...                      # your key for *that* endpoint
```

`agentdescent doctor` reports what a machine has; the demo above and `pytest -q`
need none of it.
[Every provider, with its base URL →](https://birfy.github.io/agentdescent/agents/#configuring-your-provider-and-key)

```python
from agentdescent import SingleSlot, evolve, openai_compatible, reflector, scorer, tasks_from
from agentdescent.dataloader import hf_rows

rows = hf_rows("hotpotqa/hotpot_qa", "validation", config="distractor", limit=40)
model = openai_compatible(model="deepseek-v4-flash")

tasks = tasks_from(rows, prompt="question", gold="answer")     # rows -> Task objects
run = lambda skill, task: model(f"{skill}\n\n{task.prompt}")   # the skill meets the question

result = evolve(tasks, scorer("exact"), run=run, propose=reflector(model),
                strategy=SingleSlot(initial_value="You are a helpful assistant."),
                rounds=8, n_workers=8, max_concurrency=8, held_out_frac=0.3,
                patience=3, target_reward=0.98)

print(result.rendered)        # the skill it learned
print(result.final_reward)    # held-out reward
print(result.outcomes())      # why it went that way
```

That run is the last row of the table above. It learned *"Respond with only the
requested answer, omitting any extra explanation or restatement."*

<details>
<summary>The same thing without a dataset. Runnable as-is — no API key, no dependencies.</summary>

```python
from agentdescent import Task, evolve

tasks = [Task(id=f"t{i}", prompt=f"item {i}") for i in range(12)]

def reward(task, output):                  # must return [0, 1]
    return 1.0 if "2026" in output else 0.0

def run(rendered, task):                   # your solver
    return "answer" + (" 2026" if "year" in rendered else "")

def propose(rendered, task, output, reward):   # what to add on a failure
    return "always state the year"

result = evolve(tasks, reward, run=run, propose=propose,
                rounds=6, n_workers=3, max_concurrency=3)
print(result.rendered, result.final_reward, result.error)
```

Swap in a real model or agent by passing `agent=` instead of `run`/`propose`:

```python
from agentdescent import LLMAgent, claude, openai_compatible, claude_code

evolve(tasks, reward, agent=LLMAgent(claude(model="claude-haiku-4-5")))
evolve(tasks, reward, agent=LLMAgent(openai_compatible(model="deepseek-v4-flash")))
evolve(tasks, reward, agent=LLMAgent(claude_code()))     # Claude Code CLI
# ...or run barrier-free: evolve(..., asynchronous=True, async_ratio=3)
```

</details>

## Use it from your agent — Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, DeepSeek Harness, Grok Bot

The same engine as a **plugin**. A shared skill teaches the host when to reach
for it, an MCP server exposes `doctor / plan / start / status / show / apply /
cancel / resume`, and the CLI mirrors them, so a run started from an agent can
be inspected from a shell.

From the current `main` checkout:

```bash
bash scripts/setup-hosts.sh   # installs it and wires up whichever agent CLIs you have
agentdescent demo             # a complete evolution, offline, no key, ~10s
agentdescent doctor           # which CLIs and keys this machine has
```

Grok Bot is a **scaffold**, not a one-click wire-up: `agentdescent install grok-bot`
writes `SKILL.md` / `HOST.md` under `~/.agentdescent/plugins/grok-bot/`, and the
MCP server is reached via `agentdescent mcp --transport streamable-http` behind an
HTTPS tunnel. See [Use it from your agent](https://birfy.github.io/agentdescent/plugins/).

Say *"improve this prompt against these examples"* inside the agent. It runs
`doctor`, writes a spec, **quotes the call count before starting**, waits for
your yes, runs detached, and asks again before it writes anything back.

**No cases yet is not a blocker.** Drafting them is step one of the procedure,
not a prerequisite: point it at the file and it writes 8–20 for you to check
first.

`kind` is `text`, `skill_dir`, `agent_dir`, `agent_code` — or **`plugin`**: the
host plugins themselves are evolvable, each rollout loaded into an isolated copy
of the host, hooks and permission config frozen, with a recursion guard so a
plugin evolving itself cannot start a nested run.

[The plugin in three commands →](https://birfy.github.io/agentdescent/plugin-quickstart/)
· [set it up and test it →](https://birfy.github.io/agentdescent/testing-guide/)

## What you can replace

Two seams carry the algorithm, and both are `typing.Protocol`s — nothing to
inherit from, and the contracts are re-derived from the engine's own call sites
by a test, so the published interface cannot drift from what runs.

**The strategy — what evolves.** Three methods over a flat `{key: value}` state.
Its key space is what decides whether concurrent proposals can fuse at all.

| strategy | the artifact is | concurrent proposals |
|---|---|---|
| `AppendRules` | a deduped list of lessons, keyed by content | almost always **fuse** |
| `KeyedRules(categories)` | one entry per named category | contradict within, fuse across |
| `FileTree(files)` | a directory, one key per path | contradict per file |
| `SingleSlot` | one value — a prompt, an instruction | always contradict |

**Eight policy slots — the rules of evolution.** Each is one field of a
`Policies` bundle, each defaults to the shipped rule, and filling one leaves the
other seven alone. A driver *refuses* a field it cannot honour rather than
ignoring it — a policy that installs but never runs is the one failure a caller
cannot detect from a completed run.

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selection` | `task_sampler` | `proposal` | `staleness` |
| `conflict` | `fusion` | `acceptance` | `promotion` |

Mechanisms that need state the pipeline does not keep — an archive, per-instance
score rows, an island pool — take the `aggregator_factory` exit instead.
[How to fill a slot →](https://birfy.github.io/agentdescent/policy-guide/)

## Twenty-three algorithm ports

Published self-evolution algorithms run as plug-ins rather than forks, under
serial, synchronous or barrier-free scheduling without touching the engine —
which is what makes the scheduler a controlled variable instead of a property of
each paper's own loop.

**Benchmark-faithful (8):** ACE · GEPA · EvoSkill · SkillOpt · ADAS · DGM ·
OpenEvolve · ERA
**Microports and analogues (15):** PromptBreeder · AFlow · Self-Refine ·
Reflexion · SICA · Gödel Agent · Voyager · SkillWeaver · Absolute Zero · R-Zero ·
Agent0 · gskill · TextGrad · Dynamic Cheatsheet · **Genesis**

Genesis is the one whose whole algorithm — a recursion over `(version, path)`
worlds, a three-way merge and a parent's verdict — installs through
`Policies(proposal=, acceptance=, conflict=)` and a `Strategy`, with **no engine
change at all**.

Fidelity is declared per port, follows each project's *released code* where it
diverges from its paper, and analogues are not to be cited as benchmark
reproductions. Every port has a `--dry-run` mode that needs no API key.
[All twenty-three, with their measured results →](https://birfy.github.io/agentdescent/self-evolution-examples/)

| [Use it from your agent](https://birfy.github.io/agentdescent/plugins/) · [Testing it](https://birfy.github.io/agentdescent/testing-guide/) | The plugin surface, and how to verify each host |
| [Efficiency](https://birfy.github.io/agentdescent/efficiency/) · [Runtime matrix](https://birfy.github.io/agentdescent/matrix-overview/) | Measured scaling and the scheduler comparison |
| [Molecule search — porous crystals](https://birfy.github.io/agentdescent/porous-molecules/) | A domain application: flat-PUCT tree search over molecules, with a validity gate and a real `P(s,a)` |

## Citing

The paper — *AgentDescent: Asynchronous Parallel Self-Evolution of LLM Agents by
Merging Conflicting Edits* — gives the design, a closed-form condition for when
merging can fire at all, and a live-model evaluation with every generating script
named.

```bibtex
@article{chen2026agentdescent,
  title  = {{AgentDescent}: Asynchronous Parallel Self-Evolution of {LLM} Agents
            by Merging Conflicting Edits},
  author = {Chen, Danyang},
  year   = {2026},
  doi    = {10.5281/zenodo.22348027}
}
```

LaTeX source and the built PDF live on the
[`paper`](https://github.com/Birfy/agentdescent/tree/paper/paper) branch, not
here: the write-up and the code change on different clocks. Per-result raw data
is in [`bench/results/`](bench/results/) for most results; the
merge-versus-selection sweeps are re-measurable from the command the paper names
rather than recomputable, because their per-run data was not retained — the paper
says so too.

## Scope

A **research reference implementation**, not a production system. The novelty is
a narrow engineering synthesis — concurrent, staleness-bounded,
conflict-resolved diff-level merge over a git-backed versioned ledger — and its
throughput premise is a testable hypothesis rather than community consensus.
Contributions welcome: [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). The suite is offline
and deterministic, so `pytest -q` needs no API key.

# dsh-ronge-gongzhonghao

> DeepSeek Harness 插件 + 内置技能：**公众号长文写作、去 AI 味扫描、自包含 HTML 生成**。

Repo: https://github.com/bugtakue/dsh-ronge-gongzhonghao
Skill repo: https://github.com/bugtakue/ronge-gongzhonghao

## 它做什么

装一个插件，得到三个工具：

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `gongzhonghao_check` | 给中文草稿打"AI 味分数"，列出命中词、行号、上下文、替换建议 |
| `gongzhonghao_build` | 把 Markdown 生成自包含微信公众号 HTML（内联样式 + base64 图） |
| `gongzhonghao_install_skill` | 把内置的 `ronge-gongzhonghao` 技能装进 `~/.dsh/skills` |

内置技能就是 [ronge-gongzhonghao](https://github.com/bugtakue/ronge-gongzhonghao)：禁用词表、写法手册、排版规范、微信踩坑、构建器。

## 安装

从 GitHub 安装（`dsh` CLI 或 DSH 插件页）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:bugtakue/dsh-ronge-gongzhonghao
# 桌面端
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:bugtakue/dsh-ronge-gongzhonghao
```

装完后在会话里让 Agent 先装技能：

```text
调用 gongzhonghao_install_skill
```

然后就能用 `ronge-gongzhonghao` 技能了。

## 用法

### 扫 AI 味

```text
gongzhonghao_check({ path: "article.md" })
```

返回：

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "score": 19.11,
  "grade": "重灾区",
  "hits": 9,
  "top": [
    { "word": "本文", "line": 129, "fix": "删掉，用'我/我们'或直接说事" }
  ]
}
```

目标：**分数 < 3/千字**。

### 生成公众号 HTML

```text
gongzhonghao_build({ mdPath: "article.md", outPath: "article.html", brand: "循 济 研 究" })
```

Markdown 约定见 [skill/SKILL.md](skill/SKILL.md)：

- `==文字==` → 淡金高亮
- `:::lead` → 开头结论卡
- `:::note` → 免责声明
- `## 01｜标题` → 金色编号小节

生成后用 Chrome 打开 HTML，全选复制，粘进公众号后台。

### 安装技能

```text
gongzhonghao_install_skill({ force: false })
```

装到 `~/.dsh/skills/ronge-gongzhonghao`（可用 `DSH_SKILLS_DIR` 覆盖）。

## 依赖

- Node.js ≥ 20（插件本身无依赖）；
- `gongzhonghao_build` 需要 `python3`（构建器只用标准库）；
- 预览图需要 Chrome（可选）。

## 文件

```
index.js              插件主逻辑（tools 注册）
cordis.patch.yml      DSH bundle patch
skill/                内置技能（SKILL.md / references / kit / examples）
screenshots.json      商店截图
docs/screenshot.png
package.json
```

## License

MIT © 2026 bugtakue

# dsh-session-fix · 会话修复

修 DSH 里**坏掉的会话记录**。装好之后在 **设置 → 会话修复** 里一键扫描、选中、修复，不用退 DSH、不用手工搬文件。

作者：汐（记忆修复师）· 许可：MIT

---

## 一、什么时候用它

会话报这种错、从此每轮都失败的时候：

```
messages.3.1: `tool_use` ids were found without `tool_result` blocks
immediately after: call_xxxxxxxx (INVALID_REQUEST)
```

或者会话打不开、历史加载失败，但**文件还在**。

如果你的报告是「凭据失效 / 网络超时 / 版本不兼容 / 配置读不进去」，那不是它，别在这上面花时间。

---

## 二、真因

模型的工具调用有一条死规矩：

> 一条助手消息里声明了几个工具调用，**紧随其后**就必须有同样数量的工具结果，一一对应，中间不许夹别的东西。

而 DSH 会把助手消息切成若干段。如果一条助手消息里的块顺序是：

```
tool-call + text + tool-call        ← 坏
```

切开之后，文本块夹在了两个调用之间，那条调用的结果就不再是「紧接的下一条」。上游直接拒收。

正确顺序是把非调用块放前面：

```
text + reasoning + tool-call + tool-call        ← 好
```

**这个坏结构一旦进了历史，每一轮都会重放它，所以这条会话此后每轮都失败。**

---

## 三、它到底改什么

只做一件事：

> 把 `assistant/message` 里的 `text` / `reasoning` 块，挪到所有 `tool-call` 块前面。

**三条不碰：**

| 不碰 | 为什么 |
|---|---|
| 不删任何一行 | DSH 校验 `seq` 连续，删一条整份判损坏 |
| 不改记录类型、不从旧备份「恢复」记录 | 记录类型是契约的一部分，乱改会把结构弄成另一种坏 |
| 不动聊天正文 | `user` / `assistant` 的文字一个字节都不改 |

技术细节：

- 会话日志是**一串 zstd 帧**，DSH 逐帧校验。只重压**改过的帧**（带 checksum，与 DSH 自身写法一致），没改的帧原样复制 —— 所以**帧数和边界不变**，这是它还能被读回来的前提。
- 改完立刻从磁盘重读一遍自查：记录数是否没变、`seq` 是否连续、残留病灶是否 0、调用与结果是否配对完整。**任何一项不过就当场回滚。**

---

## 四、回退

修之前，原文件被改名保留在同目录：

```
session.v4.jsonl.zstd.before-fix-2026-10-31_20-15-33
```

想退回去，把它的 `.before-fix-<时间戳>` 去掉、覆盖回 `session.v4.jsonl.zstd` 就行。

---

## 五、能修什么 / 修不了什么

这一节是故意写清楚的 —— 免得你装了之后发现「我那个报错它居然不管」。

### ✅ 能修

报 `tool_use ids found without tool_result blocks immediately after` 的会话，也就是上面第二节说的那一种坏法。

### ❌ 修不了（别指望它救命）

| 情况 | 为什么 | 怎么办 |
|---|---|---|
| 会话文件被**整个删掉**（目录/文件没了） | 没有数据可修 | 先用文件恢复工具（Recuva / Disk Drill / testdisk 之类）把文件捞回来，再交给本插件 |
| `seq` 已经**断档** | 结构性损坏，修了也是坏的 | 插件只报不修，把文件发给作者 |
| 调用与结果**配对不上**（悬空调用 / 孤立结果） | 同上，缺的那条补不回来 | 同上 |
| 帧解不开（文件被截断 / 还在被写） | 读都读不动 | 确认 DSH 已完全退出后重试；不行就是文件本身坏了 |
| 报错根本不是这一类 | 病因不在会话结构 | 看具体报错排查，别归因到这里 |

### ⏸ 唯一不能碰的会话

**正被打开着的那条。**

本插件跑在 DSH 里面，所以**不用退出 DSH** —— 退出了它自己也死了，那就什么都修不了。

但「正在说话的那条会话」文件还在被宿主追加写入，动它就是拿历史换事故。所以列表里会把它标成 **「被占用」**，并且不给修复按钮。

> **要修它，先切到别的会话，再回来。**

---

## 六、适用版本

- 会话格式 **v4**（`session.v4.jsonl.zstd`）
- 需要 Node 内置 zstd 支持：Node **≥ 22.15**（桌面版自带的运行时满足）
- 在 DSH 0.2.1-rc 系列上实测

---

## 七、安装

本插件是标准的 DSH 插件包（`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`）。

**A. 从 GitHub 装（推荐）**

```bash
# 在 profile 目录里（默认 %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\<profile>）
pnpm add github:CalamitySpiritKite/dsh-session-fix
```

**B. 本地链接（改代码 / 自己用）**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/CalamitySpiritKite/dsh-session-fix.git
cd <profile 目录>
pnpm add link:<刚 clone 下来的目录绝对路径>
```

两种方式装完，确认 `cordis.patch.yml` 里有这一行（多数情况 `dsh.bundle.patch` 会自动带上；没有就手加）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-session-fix
  name: dsh-session-fix
```

**然后重启 DSH**，设置页左侧会出现「会话修复」。

> 卸载：`pnpm remove dsh-session-fix`，并把 `cordis.patch.yml` 里那两行删掉，重启。

---

## 八、自己验一遍（可选）

仓库里带了两个自测脚本，用的是**你自己的真实会话文件**，全程只读，所有写入都在系统临时目录：

```bash
# 内存里造坏 → 修 → 逐项对照（不写盘）
node tools/selftest.mjs "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\sessions\<某个>\session.v4.jsonl.zstd"

# 完整落盘流程：临时目录里复制一份，造坏 → 原子替换 → 验备份 → 验回退
node tools/e2e.mjs     "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\sessions\<某个>\session.v4.jsonl.zstd"
```

两个都跑出「全部通过」再装，心里就有底了。

---

## 九、它会动你的哪些文件

| 文件 | 动作 |
|---|---|
| `session.v4.jsonl.zstd` | 修复时原子替换（先改名原件，再放新文件） |
| `session.v4.jsonl.zstd.before-fix-<时间戳>` | 新建，原件备份，**不自动删** |
| 同目录 `*.tmp-<时间戳>` | 只在替换过程中短暂存在，失败会清掉 |

**不碰**：别的会话、记忆、附件、配置、当前打开的会话。

---

## 十、给踩到的人一句话

会话记录是**唯一真源**：没有索引、没有副本、没有回收站。它在，你的历史就在；它没了，那段历史与你再无关系。

这个插件能救的是「写坏了的结构」，救不了「已经不存在的文件」。

所以：**别在运行中删会话目录，删之前先复制一份。**

# GitHub Release 下载加速（github-release-download-acceleration）

一个零依赖的 Windows PowerShell 技能：用户只说「这个包下太慢了」，它自己探清机器家底、实测选出最快路线、单流或分段并发下载，最后用 release 自带的 `digest` 做 SHA256 闭环校验。

## 视频介绍

[![2 分钟看懂：为什么它能让 GitHub 下载更快](assets/explainer-poster.png)](https://github.com/chenjrastro-tech/github-release-download-acceleration/releases/download/v0.3.5/github-release-download-acceleration-explainer.mp4)

<sub>2 分 13 秒 · 中文讲解 + 英文字幕 · 原理演示，不替代下方基准数据。点击封面播放；GitHub README 不能直接内嵌 release 资产，所以使用封面链接。</sub>

## 1. 项目解决什么问题

GitHub Release 的大资产（几十到几百 MB 的安装包、便携包）在国内网络下经常出现三种情况：

- **直连被限速**：`release-assets.githubusercontent.com` 前几秒还快，随后掉到几百 KB/s，一个 200MB 的包要等好几分钟。
- **公共镜像不可靠**：`ghfast.top`、`ghproxy.net`、`github.moeyy.xyz` 这类镜像随时可能 TLS 握手超时、返回错误页，或者比直连还慢。
- **本机其实有代理能力**：很多人装了 Clash Verge，但内核没在跑、系统代理没开，命令行下载完全用不上它。

手工排这些可能性很费时间，而且「装个 aria2 / 7z 再研究参数」对环境要求太高。本技能把这件事变成一条命令：**不装东西、不改系统代理、不问用户参数**，自己把上面这些路线实测一遍再决定怎么下。

## 2. 主要功能

| 能力 | 具体行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 环境自检 | 查 `curl.exe`、环境变量代理、系统代理、常见代理端口是否在监听；`ProxyServer` 残留值不算数，只有端口真的 Listen 才算 |
| 四类路线并行实测 | A 现有代理 / B 无头拉起本机 Clash Verge 内核（`127.0.0.1:7897`）/ C 六个公共镜像 / D 直连，各跑一次 1MB range GET，按「先看是否真拿到 ≥512KB 数据，再看 KB/s」排序 |
| 资产名校验闸门 | 测速前先用 release API 校验资产名；名字对不上就报 `ASSET_NOT_FOUND`，列出全部真实候选（名字 + MB）和最接近的一条，**停下等用户确认，绝不静默换名继续下** |
| 并发阶梯（先判值不值得测） | 只有「资产 ≥100 MB **且** 单连接探针 <3 MB/s」才测——探针就是第 5 步那个 8 MB 单连接 GET 的 `$singleKB`，不额外花流量。测的时候 1/16 两档 × 三遍、限同一时间窗（4 秒）比聚合吞吐，取中位数并报 min–max；胜出档还要满足「完成数 n/n、三次波动 ≤2×」，两档中位数差 10% 以内选低并发，多段比单段快不到 1.25 倍就用单流。小包或单连接已经够快时**跳过整个阶梯**（省下约 24 秒与上百 MB 采样流量），`-ForceLadder` 可强制测 |
| 单流 / 分段两条下载路径 | `$winN=1` 或 `<100MB` 走单流一次拿完；大资产按 `$winN` 段并发，每段独立日志、带 `--retry`，`--retry-all-errors` 仅在 curl ≥7.71 时启用 |
| 下载中自愈 | 45 秒看一次增长，20–30 秒还是 0 字节就只杀自己的 curl、清空分片、降并发（16→8→4）或切第二路线重开 |
| digest 闭环校验 | 拼装前核对分片总字节，拼完比对 `size` 与 SHA256；无 digest 的老 release 只报「字节数一致」，绝不冒充校验通过 |
| 收尾还原 | 只停自己起的进程、只删自己建的目录，确认 7897 不再监听、`ProxyEnable` 与开始时一致 |

它明确**不做**的事：不装 aria2/7z/winget，不写注册表代理项，不开 Clash GUI，不把 `allow-lan` 打开，不杀用户的其它下载进程。

## 3. 安装方法

技能就是一个目录，放进宿主的技能发现根即可。

```
github-release-download-acceleration/
├── SKILL.md              # 技能正文（索引）：决策表 + 错误路径 + 步骤说明 + 参数 + Pitfalls
├── references/
│   ├── runner-steps.md   # 0–10 步 powershell 真源（build-runner 用它生成 ghdl.ps1）
│   ├── maintenance.md    # 施工法 A/B、发布四份证据（维护附录，不占 SKILL.md 体积）
│   └── fetch-raw-via-api.md  # raw 文件改走 contents API 的具体命令
├── README.md             # 本文件
├── LICENSE               # MIT 许可证
├── package.json          # 插件清单：声明 dsh.bundle.patch（市场只收带 dsh.bundle 的包）
├── cordis.patch.yml      # bundle patch：把本插件插进 profile 的 loader 树
├── index.js              # 技能 provider：把包里的 SKILL.md 挂进 ctx.skills（零依赖）
├── agents/
│   └── openai.yaml       # Codex/OpenAI 宿主的展示元数据（DSH 不读这个文件）
├── scripts/
│   ├── build-runner.ps1  # 生成器：references/runner-steps.md -> ghdl.ps1
│   ├── ghdl.ps1          # Windows runner（生成物，勿手改）
│   ├── ghdl.sh           # macOS/Linux runner
│   ├── ghdl-min.sh       # 单文件最小版（正文内联同一份）
│   └── validate.ps1      # 自检脚本：结构 / frontmatter / 5.1 兼容性 / 代码块语法
├── assets/               # 市场卡片图标、实测截图与视频封面
└── screenshots.json      # 声明 1-8 张截图（市场详情页读取，放 package.json 旁边）
```

**DeepSeek Harness（DSH）**

1. 项目级：放到 `<项目根>/.dsh/skills/github-release-download-acceleration/`（`<项目根>` = 最近含 `.git` 的祖先目录）。
2. 用户级：放到 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\skills\github-release-download-acceleration/`（即 `C:\Users\<用户名>\.dsh\skills\`）。
3. 若技能目录本身不在任何含 `.git` 的项目里（比如它自己就是项目根，而你没有 init git），DSH 会把 `projectRoot` 退化成当前会话目录，此时用目录联接把它挂进用户级技能根即可：

```powershell
$src = '<技能所在目录>\github-release-download-acceleration'
$dst = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\github-release-download-acceleration"
if (-not (Test-Path $dst)) { cmd /c mklink /J "$dst" "$src" }
```

挂好后用宿主的 `skill` 工具**真正加载一次**验证；只看目录存在不算数（DSH 会对技能目录热加载）。

4. 插件方式（推荐，和插件市场一致）：

```powershell
dsh plugin add github:chenjrastro-tech/github-release-download-acceleration
```

包装层就是 `package.json` + `cordis.patch.yml` + `index.js` 三个文件：DSH 装上后由 `index.js` 把包内的 `SKILL.md` 注册成技能（`source: bundled`、rank 600）。因此它同时是「能手动放的技能目录」和「能用 `dsh plugin add` 装的插件包」，两条路读的是同一份 `SKILL.md`，不会出现两份正文漂移。

5. 也发布到了 npm，但包名不叫 `github-release-download-acceleration`，而是 **`github-release-accelerator`**：

```powershell
npm i github-release-accelerator
```

原因：npm registry 拒绝包名里出现 `download` 这个词（`400 That word is not allowed`），所以发布名去掉了它；仓库名与技能名保持不变（仍为 `github-release-download-acceleration`）。npm 包与 `dsh plugin add` 装的是同一份代码，在 DSH 里建议用上面第 4 条。

**其它基于 SKILL.md 的宿主**（Codex 等）：把整个目录放进其技能目录，`agents/openai.yaml` 提供 `display_name` / `short_description` / `default_prompt` 展示信息。

**环境要求**：Windows 10/11 + Windows PowerShell 5.1 + 系统自带 `curl.exe`（Win10 1803+ 自带）。没有任何第三方依赖。

## 4. 使用方法

直接用自然语言说，不需要报端口、代理地址、并发数或仓库名。

**给了 release 直链**

```text
帮我把 https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/releases/download/33.0.0/OBS-Studio-33.0.0-Windows-x64.zip 下下来，太慢了
```

**只给 tag 页**（技能会自己挑最大的资产，并说明选择理由）

```text
github.com/neovim/neovim/releases/tag/v0.11.0 这个包下不动，你看着办
```

**文件名可能记错**（技能会先校验，对不上就停下等你确认）

```text
https://github.com/junegunn/fzf/releases/download/v0.65.2/fzf-0.65.2-windows-x64.zip 帮我下这个
```

可选地给一个目标目录（例如 `下到 D:\Downloads\_dl`）。不给目标目录时由宿主任选落地目录；含空格也可以，runner 用 `ConvertTo-ArgString` 给 `-o` 等参数加引号，最后在报告里给出绝对路径。

内部执行顺序固定为：`解析 URL → 环境自检 → 定位内核与配置 → API 校验资产名 → 并行探测路线 →（必要时）无头起内核 → 按需阶梯（<100MB 或单连接已够快则跳过）→ 下载 → 监控/降档 → 拼装 → digest 校验 → 收尾`。

### 一次性 runner（宿主只能执行一条命令时）

有些宿主只肯跑一次本地命令，没有「逐块读文档再执行」的能力。这种场景用 runner，一条命令走完全流程：

```powershell
# Windows：PowerShell 5.1 与系统 curl 都自带，不需要装任何东西
powershell -NoProfile -File scripts\ghdl.ps1 -Url '<release 直链>'
powershell -NoProfile -File scripts\ghdl.ps1 -Url '<release 直链>' -OutDir 'D:\Downloads'
powershell -NoProfile -File scripts\ghdl.ps1 -Url '<release 直链>' -ForceLadder   # 强制单流 vs 多段对照
powershell -NoProfile -File scripts\ghdl.ps1 -Url '<release 直链>' -Parts 16      # 手动指定并发段数
powershell -NoProfile -File scripts\ghdl.ps1 -Url '<release 直链>' -ForceClean    # 删旧分片/旧输出，强制重下
powershell -NoProfile -File scripts\ghdl.ps1 -Url '<release 直链>' -KeepParts     # 校验通过也保留分片（排查用）
powershell -NoProfile -File scripts\ghdl.ps1 -Url '<release 直链>' -Sha256 '<sha256>'   # API 限流/手工下载时指定期望值，仍做闭环校验

# 任意直链也能用（自建 CDN / GitLab / 内网制品库），只做字节数校验
powershell -NoProfile -File scripts\ghdl.ps1 -Url 'https://example.com/big.bin'
```

行为约定（agent 可以直接依赖）：

- **幂等**：目标文件已存在且字节数（有 digest 时再加 SHA256）都对 → `ALREADY_DONE` 直接跳过，不重下。
- **可续传**：分段方案写在 `<asset>.parts/manifest.json`，记 content identity（`source`）而不是某一轮胜出的镜像；换镜像/代理启停后重跑仍能 `RESUME_PLAN`。旧格式（只有 `url`）也兼容。
- **不留双写**：上次被强杀留下的 curl 还在写同一目录时，先 `ORPHANS_KILLED` 清掉再开工。
- **退出码**：`0` 只有在校验通过时才返回；`DOWNLOAD_VERIFY_FAILED` / `SEGMENT_SIZE_MISMATCH` / `NO_ROUTE` 都是 `1`。
- **失败保留现场**：校验没过时分片不删（`PARTS_KEPT`），下次接着下；确认不要了再加 `-ForceClean`。

```sh
# macOS / Linux：核心下载/校验语义与 ps1 一致；B 内核入池、单流多候选回退是 Windows 侧增强
# CI 的 ubuntu-latest 与 macos-latest 均跑过 26 条 sh 套件
sh scripts/ghdl.sh '<release 直链>'
sh scripts/ghdl.sh '<release 直链>' -o /tmp/dl -p 16      # 选项与环境变量等价，选项优先
sh scripts/ghdl.sh --help                                  # 全部选项
```

### 两端参数对照（P1-c）

| 语义 | Windows `ghdl.ps1` | macOS / Linux `ghdl.sh` | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 输出目录 | `-OutDir <dir>` | `-o, --outdir <dir>` | 默认 `~/Downloads` |
| 并发段数 | `-Parts N` | `-p, --parts N` | `0` = 按单连接速度自适应 |
| 清现场重下 | `-ForceClean` | `--force-clean` | 连旧分片一起删 |
| 强制阶梯 | `-ForceLadder` | `--force-ladder` | 跳过「单连接够快就单流」 |
| 分段池内核 | `-NoKernelPool` | — | 默认把 B 本机内核加入分段池；加此开关关闭 |
| 保留现场 | `-KeepParts` | `--keep-tmp` | 排错时看分片与日志 |
| 冒烟 | **恒定开启** | `--smoke 0\|1` | ps1 故意不给关闭开关：`SMOKE_FAILED` 必须看得见 |
| 帮助 | `-?` / `Get-Help` | `-h, --help` | |

选择器（代理、镜像、并发档）两端都不需要用户传参：都由第 4–6 步的实测自己决定。

只有 `SKILL.md`、没有 `scripts/`（raw 又被墙）时，用 **最小版**：`SKILL.md` 里「拿不到 scripts/ 时的最小版」一节内联了完整脚本（86 行、只依赖 curl、会分段+续传+校验），
也单独放在 `scripts/ghdl-min.sh`；`validate.ps1` 会逐字比对两处，改一边不改另一边直接 FAIL。

`scripts/ghdl.ps1` 不是手写的：`scripts/build-runner.ps1` 把 `references/runner-steps.md` 的 11 个代码块拼成它（只替换 URL/输出目录/强制阶梯三处），`validate.ps1` 会比对两者，改了文档不重生成就 FAIL。

### 并发引擎（P2）：自适应段 + 多源 + 工作窃取

- 段大小由单连接实测速度决定（每段约 4 秒的活，夹在 2MB–24MB），不再硬编码 16 段。
- 路线池只收「回 206 且速度 ≥ 最快路线 35%」的前三条；慢路线混进来会让 1/3 的段轮流卡住。
- 并发从 4 条起步：3 秒窗口里吞吐涨 15% 就 +2 条，卡住 2 段就砍一半。实测硬上 16 段会被节点重置（同一资产 173s），自适应后 32s。
- 某段 6 秒不长进就算卡住：杀掉、按已下字节续传、换下一条路线重新排队，空闲 worker 接手——这就是工作窃取。
- `curl --parallel` 快路径**实现过、实测过、又撤了**：P2 阶段单进程 `--parallel` 跑 16 段是 31.6s，同资产多进程自适应是 32.3s（差值在噪声内），但它只能整批跑完——某段卡死时没法只杀掉那一段再换源重排队，等于用可靠性换 0.7 秒。P3 重写引擎时移除，结论写在 `SKILL.md` Verification 里；要加回就加回，但不是默认。

同机实测（2026-10-30，OBS 223.7MB，同一时段、同一节点）：

| 方式 | 耗时 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 单流（基线） | 31.2s（7.0 MB/s） | 节点没限速时本来就快 |
| 自适应窃取 `-Parts 16` | 32.3s | `RAMP_UP 4→6→8`、`BACKOFF→4`，`steals=5 repairs=5` |
| `--parallel` 快路径 | 31.6s | 18 段一次拉完，`steals=0` |
| 中途杀掉一条 curl | 30.7s | `steals=2 repairs=3`，续传补齐后校验通过 |

结论：节点不限速时并发不会更快，引擎会自己退回单流；只有单连接被限速时才有收益（历史实测 6.3×）。

**≥1GB 资产实测**（Godot 4.7.2 mono export templates，1,202,598,411 B）：不带 `-Parts` 时按闸值直接单流（176.9s，SHA256 与 digest 一致）；`-Parts 8` 时 `PLAN: nseg=49 chunk=23.4MB`，49 段 `steals=27 repairs=27`，同样校验通过。段数上限是 128（不是 64）：本地 1.75GB 用例 `-Parts 4` 跑出 `nseg=75`，证明段数超过 64 时引擎仍正常（10.8s、字节精确）。

**「真零前置」的可验证定义**：PATH 只留系统目录、清空 `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY`/`ALL_PROXY`、不登录任何账号、非管理员用户，仍能完成一次真实下载并通过校验。Windows 侧已按这个口径实测通过——非管理员会话、PATH 只剩 `C:\Windows{,\system32,\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0}`，靠端口探测找到本机 7897，最后 SHA256 与 release digest 一致。

### 服务端故障码（403 / 503 / 429）

`tests/serve.ps1` 提供 `/e403.bin`、`/e503.bin`（带 `Retry-After: 1`）、`/e429.bin` 三个永远返回同一状态码的端点，套件 [16] 断言：这几种情况下 runner 必须 **非 0 退出、输出里能看到状态码、且不落半成品文件**，并在 30 秒内失败。

有一点要说明白：**5xx 在「探测」阶段就判定不可用，不在这里重试**——重试发生在下载过程中（`curl --retry 3 --retry-delay 2`，curl ≥7.71 时再加 `--retry-all-errors`）。之所以不在探测阶段重试，是因为探测本身要并发跑 7 条路线，每条都退避会把这步从秒级拖到分钟级，而你看到的状态码已经足够判断该换路线还是该去查权限。

### 本地基准（入库、可复跑）

`tests\bench.ps1` 用 `tests/serve.ps1` 起本地假服务器，对同一资产跑「强制单流」与「强制 16 段」各 N 遍取中位数，读 runner 的 `RESULT_JSON`：

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests\bench.ps1 -Runs 3
```

2026-10-31 本机实测（`/big.bin` 123,456,789 字节，回环地址）：

| 方式 | 中位耗时 | 中位速度 | 相对单流 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 单流 | 0.3 s | 392.5 MB/s | 1.00× |
| 16 段 | 1.1 s | 107.0 MB/s | **0.27×** |

**怎么读这组数**：回环没有「每连接限速」，16 条连接只是把同一块内存带宽切碎，还要多付 16 次进程/哈希开销——所以本地多段必然更慢，这正是「不限速时必须回退单流」的判据。它证明的是**开销上界**，不能拿来当公网加速比；公网数字见下面「实测对比」，且节点状态每天不同。

### 跨平台：Windows 与 macOS 两个 runner

| 平台 | 入口 | 依赖 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows | `scripts\ghdl.ps1 -Url '<url>' [-OutDir <目录>] [-Parts 16] [-ForceClean] [-KeepParts] [-ForceLadder] [-NoKernelPool]` | 系统自带 `curl.exe`（Win10 1803+） |
| macOS / Linux | `bash scripts/ghdl.sh '<url>'` | 系统自带 `curl`；SHA256 走 `openssl` → `shasum` → `sha256sum` |

```bash
# macOS/Linux：参数走环境变量
OUTDIR=$HOME/Downloads PARTS=16 bash scripts/ghdl.sh 'https://github.com/owner/repo/releases/download/v1.2.3/a.zip'
MIN_KBPS=200 P2SP_URLS='https://cdn.example.com/a.zip' bash scripts/ghdl.sh '<url>'   # 3 秒内 <200KB/s 就掐断换源，并与备源混拨
```

两边共用同一套阈值：frontmatter `metadata`、正文「可调参数」表、ps1 的 `$ladderMinMB`/`$fastKB`、sh 的 `LADDER_MIN_MB`/`FAST_KBPS`，四处不一致 `validate.ps1` 直接 FAIL。

macOS 侧的实现差异（都写进脚本头部注释）：

- `nc -z -w 1` 探端口（无 `nc` 回退 curl），不用 `/dev/tcp`；
- `ulimit -n 4096`，抬不上去打印 `ULIMIT_SKIP` 继续；
- `--http2`/`--buffer-size`/`--proxy-http2` 先用 `curl <opt> --version` 探测运行时是否支持（本机 curl 8.22 的 `--help` 会骗人）；
- worker 池用队列文件 + `mkdir` 原子锁，`xargs -P` 做不了单段自愈；
- 冒烟按后缀：`.zip`→`unzip -tqq`、`.tar.*`→`tar -tf`、`.exe` 在 macOS 上 `smoke=SKIP`。

## 实测效果

同一台机器、同一个 213.4MB 资产（obs-studio 33.0.0 Windows x64）：

| 方式 | 用时 | 平均速度 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 直连单连接 `curl -L` | 177.0 s | 1,234 KB/s |
| 本技能（无头内核 7897 + 16 段并发） | 28.2 s | 7,759 KB/s |

**6.3 倍**，省约 149 秒，SHA256 与 release digest 一致。

但并发收益取决于节点是否限速。同一天节点恢复后、同一 31.6MB 资产（rclone）的整包对照：

| 方式 | 用时 | 平均速度 | 相对 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 单流经 7897 | 5.3 s | 5,829 KB/s | 1.00× |
| 16 段经 7897 | 7.4 s | 4,175 KB/s | 0.72× |

即**节点不限速时多开线程是负收益**，1/4/16 三档中位数 5.7 / 5.1 / 5.2 MB/s 基本持平；只有在单连接被限速时（上面的 1,234 KB/s 场景）并发才有 1.5–6 倍收益。

而阶梯本身也不便宜——两档 × 三遍 × 4 秒实测 **26.1 秒**，节点快时还要顺带下载上百 MB 采样流量。所以现在的判定顺序是**先检验前提，再决定要不要花这笔测量费**：

| 场景 | 行为 | 实测 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 资产 <100 MB | 直接单流，跳过阶梯 | rclone 31.6 MB：`SKIP_LADDER` → 7.09 s / 4,462 KB/s，`DOWNLOAD_VERIFIED_OK` |
| 单连接探针 ≥3 MB/s | 直接单流，跳过阶梯 | 同日 `singleKB=4257`，阶梯测了也只有 0.72× |
| 资产 ≥100 MB 且单连接 <3 MB/s | 测 1/16 两档，1.25 倍门槛 | 限速节点上 16 段 7.7 MB/s ≫ 直连 1.2 MB/s |

这两个阈值是可调的，写在 SKILL.md 的 frontmatter 里（`metadata` 段）。**实际文件里就是这个样子，值带引号、不写行内注释**（宿主的 frontmatter 解析器未必吃注释，省掉最稳）：

```yaml
metadata:
  min_size_for_ladder_mb: "100"
  single_conn_fast_kbps: "3072"
```

含义：`min_size_for_ladder_mb` 是「小于它直接单流」的资产下限（MB），`single_conn_fast_kbps` 是「单连接探针不低于它就直接单流」的速度门槛（KB/s，3072 = 3 MB/s）。改完跑一遍 `validate.ps1`，它会校验代码里那一份有没有跟着改：

```powershell
# 只改 frontmatter、忘了同步代码 → 自检直接失败，不会带着不一致的阈值上线
[FAIL] metadata.min_size_for_ladder_mb=80 与代码 $ladderMinMB = 100 不一致：改阈值要两处同步
```

强制测阶梯（`-ForceLadder`）时的实测形状：1 段中位 4,944 KB/s（4,471–5,893，波动 1.32×）、16 段中位 5,043 KB/s（4,305–5,632，波动 1.31×）→ 未过 1.25 倍门槛，`winN=1`。

功能回归（2026-10-28，把 SKILL.md 的代码块原样抽出来按顺序 dot-source 执行，不是另抄一份）：

| 用例 | 资产 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 小资产 · 跳过阶梯走单流 | `rclone/rclone` v1.75.2 · 30.2 MB | 15/15 通过：`SKIP_LADDER` → `winN=1` → `SINGLE exit=0 code=200`（7.09 s / 4,462 KB/s）→ `DOWNLOAD_VERIFIED_OK` |
| 强制阶梯 | 同上 | 6 次采样（1/16 各三遍）、2 行汇总、无 4 段档、`winN=1`，耗时 26.1 s |
| 错误路径 | 不存在的 asset；`digest: null` 的老 release | `ASSET_NOT_FOUND` + 候选清单；`NO_DIGEST` + `DOWNLOAD_SIZE_OK_NO_DIGEST` |

2026-10-30 首次真跑：**Windows / Ubuntu / macOS 三个 job 全部 success**（run 41049031624，commit `dcf333c`）。macOS 那次跑在自带的 bash 3.2 + BSD 工具链上，一次抓出四个只在 BSD/bash 3.2 下才犯的错（`${arr[@]}` 空数组在 `set -u` 下 unbound、`wc -c` 输出前导空格、BSD `sed`/`awk` 处理中文报多字节错、`$VAR` 后面直接跟中文被当成变量名的一部分），全部修完后才绿。

**macOS runner 排队问题（2026-10-30 晚）**：commit `acd6f4f` 的 run 里 `macos-latest` 连续三次 `queued` 约 15 分钟后 `cancelled`、**steps 为空**。GitHub 的 job annotation 写得很清楚：`The job was not acquired by Runner of type hosted even after multiple attempts`，附注 `Due to capacity constraints, jobs targeting macOS arm64 runners may experience longer queue times.` ——是 arm64 macOS 池容量不足，与代码无关（同一 run 的 Windows / ubuntu / min-shells 全绿；此前 4 个 commit 的 macOS job 全 success）。处理方式：不改测试、不加 `continue-on-error`，等容量恢复后重跑。本表 macOS 那一行只代表**已经真跑绿过**，不代表每个 commit 都能立刻拿到绿章。


发布提交 `d34f82d`（v0.3.1）对应的回归 run 是 **41055438679**，三个 job 同样全部 success。

`validate.ps1` 检查：必需文件、frontmatter（`name` 与目录名一致、`description` 长度、未知键告警）、**`metadata` 里的两个阈值与正文 `$ladderMinMB`/`$fastKB` 是否一致**、`## Steps` / `## Pitfalls` / `## Verification` 三节、每个 `powershell` 代码块的 5.1 语法、禁用写法（`(if …)` 括号陷阱与 `& curl … 2>&1` 记为**错误**，`+= 管道` 记为**告警**）、以及 `agents/openai.yaml` 的字段长度与 `$skill` 引用。**退出码非 0 就是文档有问题。**

- `validate.ps1` 体积检查新增余量提醒：SKILL.md 距 64 KiB 上限不足 2 KB 时打印 `[INFO]`（不计告警），并提示 0–10 步代码块被 `build-runner.ps1` 依赖、新增内容只能进 `references/`。
- `README.md` 补 v0.3.1 发布提交 `d34f82d` 的实际 CI run `41055438679`，并写全 `--parallel` 不设为默认的理由（16 段 31.6s vs 多进程 32.3s 在噪声内，且 `--parallel -K` 失去单段重排能力）。

### 0.3.1（2026-10-30）
- 新增 POSIX runner `scripts/ghdl.sh`（macOS/Linux），行为对齐 ps1：`nc` 探端口、`ulimit -n 4096`、哈希降级链、队列锁 worker 池、单段自愈、逐段强校验、manifest 续传、P2SP 双源混拨、`--connect-timeout 3` + `--speed-limit/--speed-time` 掐死慢段、不支持 Range 秒退单流、按后缀冒烟。
- 新增 `tests/serve.py` + `tests/run-tests-sh.sh`（8 组 18 断言，离线确定性）；Windows 侧套件已到 37 断言。
- SKILL.md 增加「环境分发」「可调参数」「支持矩阵」三节；阈值四处一致性纳入 `validate.ps1`（2c 段）。
- 修 `-Parts` 语义：现在严格等于「段数」（之前只影响 workers，123MB 资产会退化到 5 段）。
- 修 worker 池空路线导致的 `Attempted to divide by zero`（`POOL_EMPTY` 明确报错 + `$poolN` 兜底）。
- 新增**进度输出**：引擎每 3 秒打一行 `progress=<done>MB/<total>MB (<pct>%) running=<n> rate=<KBps>`，静默超过 10 秒就是引擎没动（`SKILL.md` Verification 有断言）。
- 新增**单文件自举** `scripts/ghdl-min.sh`（86 行 POSIX sh，无数组/无 `[[ ]]`）：取总长 → ≥32MB 走 8 段并发（不齐自动回落单流）→ 单流 `-C -` 续传 → 字节校验 → 可选 SHA256 三级降级。`SKILL.md` 内联同一份，`validate.ps1` 逐字比对。
- `scripts/ghdl.sh` 补**与 ps1 对齐的命令行选项**：`-o/--outdir`、`-p/--parts`、`--force-clean`、`--force-ladder`、`--smoke 0|1`、`--keep-tmp`、`--help`；未知选项 `UNKNOWN_FLAG` exit 2（不会静默当 URL）。
- 新增**三平台 CI** `.github/workflows/test.yml`：Windows 跑 `validate.ps1` + `build-runner -Check` + 59 条 ps1 套件；Ubuntu/macOS 跑 `bash -n scripts/ghdl.sh` + 23 条 sh 套件。
  推送它需要 token 带 `workflow` scope（`gh auth refresh -s workflow`），已补；工作流已并入 `main`，三平台 job 全绿。
- `SKILL.md` 的「小文件/文本走 contents API」拆到 `references/fetch-raw-via-api.md`（正文只留 3 行指针）：`SKILL.md` 有 64KB 上限，现在 **64,433 B**，`validate.ps1` 会拦超限。
- `curl --parallel` **评估后不采纳**（理由写在 `SKILL.md` Verification）：本仓引擎已多进程 + 逐段自愈 + 多源混拨，`--parallel -K` 只能整批跑、单段失败无法只重排那一段，收益在噪声内。
- **三平台 CI 真跑全绿**：Windows / `ubuntu-latest` / `macos-latest` 三个 job 都实跑通过。macOS job 跑在自带 bash 3.2 + BSD 工具链上，一次抓出四类只在 BSD 下才犯的错（`${arr[@]}` 空数组在 `set -u` 下 unbound、`wc -c` 输出前导空格、BSD `sed`/`awk` 处理多字节报错、`$VAR` 后直接跟中文被并进变量名），修完才绿。
- **端口探测三段式**：`nc -z` → bash `/dev/tcp` → `curl -x` 当代理试连。Git Bash 没有 `nc`，旧回退 `curl http://端口` 会被代理端口（对普通 GET 不回应）判成「没在听」，真机下载直接 `NO_ROUTE`。
- **修 `exec` 吞掉 stderr**：`port_open` 里 `exec 3>&- 3<&- 2>/dev/null` 改的是当前 shell 的重定向，之后整个脚本的报错全部消失（排查时表现为「只有前半段输出」）。
- **镜像清单两端一致**：`SKILL.md` 列 7 条（含 `hk.gh-proxy.com`），`ghdl.sh` 只测 6 条 —— 现在对齐，且 `validate.ps1` 新增检查，只改一边直接 FAIL。
- sh 套件扩到 **18 条**（新增「环境残留死代理不影响本机目标」）；README 补「两端参数对照」表，写清 `-KeepParts` ↔ `--keep-tmp`、`-Smoke` 为什么故意不提供。
- **仍未实测**：`openssl dgst -sha256 -r` / `shasum -a 256` 分支（CI 用例的资产都没有 digest）；`ulimit` 抬不动时的降级；`dash`/`ksh`（CI 只覆盖 bash）；3GB 以上的段大小只有公式推导。

**0.3.0 之后的性能收尾（已随 0.3.1 发布）**：参照物是 `v0.3.0` tag，同机同资产、轮流跑：

| 场景 | 0.1.0 | 0.3.0 | 0.3.1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 本地限速服务器 105MB（每连接 1.2MB/s，确定性） | 47.4s / 47.3s | 46.8s / 46.7s | **40.7s / 40.6s** |
| 真实 rclone 30.2MB | 19.8s / 16.3s | 22.5s / 19.6s | **14.0s** |
| 真实 OBS 213.4MB（节点在漂移，看吞吐段） | 传输约 30s | 传输约 31s | 传输约 25–31s |

- **端口探测并发化**：11 个端口串行 `600ms` 共 **6.2s** → 一次发起全部连接、总共只等 `400ms`，实测 **0.4s**（关着的端口在本机不一定立刻回 RST，串行就是白等）。
- **已有代理在监听时跳过「全盘 + 开始菜单递归」找内核**：**5.6s → 0**；没有代理可用的机器行为不变（照旧全盘扫）。
- **<100MB 资产跳过 8MB 单连接测速**：30.2MB 资产 **22.5s → 14.0s**。反正 <100MB 一律单流，这个 8MB 请求只是为了量单连接速度，纯浪费。
- **段划分按 worker 数取整**：105MB 资产 23 段 × 4.6MB（首波 16 条，第二波只剩 7 条）→ 16 段 × 6.9MB，下载 **8.5s → 5.9s**。
- **起始并发直接用阶梯结论**：`ratio ≥ 4` 起步即满并发、`≥1.25` 从 8 条起。此前只从 4 条起、靠「窗口涨幅 15%」爬坡，而每连接限速且已跑满时涨幅恒为 0 —— **会永远卡在 4 条**（本地对照：4 条 25s vs 16 条 5.9s）。
- 回归：`validate.ps1` 0 错误 / 0 告警，离线套件 **34/34**。

**0.3.0（2026-10-30）**：第一个可以长期用的版本。仓库内部曾按 P1/P2/P3 拆成 0.3.0/0.4.0/0.4.1 三段编号，但一条都没发布过；为了不跳号，统一收回成 **0.3.0** 一次发。

- **一次性 runner**：新增 `scripts/ghdl.ps1`（由 `scripts/build-runner.ps1` 从 `references/runner-steps.md` 的 11 个代码块生成，`-Check` 可检测文档与成品的漂移）和 `scripts/ghdl.sh`（POSIX）。装好后可以不走 agent 直接命令行跑，参数 `-Url` / `-OutDir` / `-Parts` / `-ForceClean` / `-KeepParts`。
- **frontmatter 收敛到最小公共集**（只留 `name` / `description`）：严格宿主遇到未知键会整条丢技能；两个阈值搬进正文参数表（`min_size_for_ladder_mb` / `single_conn_fast_kbps`），`validate.ps1` 校验正文表与代码里的 `$ladderMinMB`/`$fastKB` 是否同步。
- **P2 并发引擎**：按单连接实测速度自适应段大小；多源路线池（只收 ≥35% 最快速度的前三条）；工作窃取（某段卡住就杀掉、换路线、续传重排队）；自适应起并发（4 起步，吞吐涨 15% 加 2、3 秒内卡 2 段砍半）；`curl --parallel` 单进程快路径（`GHDL_PARALLEL=1`）。同机同一资产：单流 31.2s / 自适应 32.3s / `--parallel` 31.6s / 杀段恢复 30.7s，全部字节精确。
- **P3 可靠性**：任意 https 直链（自建 CDN、GitLab、内网制品库都行，用 1 字节 range 的 `Content-Range` 反推总长，只做字节校验）；断点续传 + 幂等（`<asset>.parts/manifest.json` 记住分段方案，重跑沿用并跳过已下分片，成品已完整则 `ALREADY_DONE`）；孤儿进程收尾（先 `ORPHANS_KILLED` 再开工，杜绝两个进程写同一分片——实测写坏过 4.9MB）；逐段强校验（每段长度必须等于 `end-start+1`，否则 `SEGMENT_SIZE_MISMATCH` 并保留现场）；退出码只有真校验通过才是 0；`-ForceClean` / `-KeepParts`。
- **单流「三方差一」**：下完比对响应头 `Content-Length` 与 `total`，不等即 `SIZE_MISMATCH`（短包不再靠运气）；重定向链上取最后一个 `Content-Length`。
- **POSIX `ghdl.sh`**：直链、续传（`.parts/manifest`）、幂等、`FORCE_CLEAN=1`、孤儿清理（`pgrep -f`，Windows 上无 `pgrep` 时降级），三级 `sha256sum`/`shasum`/`openssl` 降级。**Git Bash、ubuntu-latest、macos-latest 三处都跑过 23 条 sh 套件（CI 绿）；`dash`/`busybox`/`ksh` 由 `tests/run-tests-min-shells.sh` 在 CI 的 `min-shells` job 里实测跑通 `ghdl-min.sh`（单流 3MB + 分段 64MB，含 SHA256）。**
- **段粒度**：段数上限 64 → 128，让 1–3GB 资产的段大小仍守在 24MB 内。实测：1.2GB Godot 资产 `-Parts 8` → 49 段 / 23.4MB，SHA256 与 digest 一致；本地 1.75GB → 75 段 / 10.8s。
- **证据与回归**：真零前置实测（PATH 只剩系统目录、清空代理环境变量、非管理员，仍靠端口探测选中代理下载并校验通过）；`tests/run-tests.ps1` 16 组 59 条离线断言（含直链 404、死代理端口、`-Parts 64` 并发夹取），套件开跑前先验明端口上确实是本仓库的 `serve.ps1`，否则明确报错。

- **2026-10-29（最新）**：发布到 npm，包名 **`github-release-accelerator`**（`0.2.1`）——npm registry 拒绝包名里出现 `download`（`400 That word is not allowed`），所以 npm 发布名去掉该词，仓库名与技能名不变；`cordis.patch.yml` 的 `name` 随之改为包名（`id` 仍是技能名），`validate.ps1` 允许包名与目录名不同。新增市场卡片图标与三张实测截图（`assets/` + `screenshots.json`），PR 条目补 `icon:`。
- 2026-10-29：打包成可进插件市场的插件包 —— 新增 `package.json`（声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`）、`cordis.patch.yml`、`index.js`（技能 provider，零依赖，把包内 `SKILL.md` 挂进 `ctx.skills`，`source: bundled`、rank 600）。版本号提到 **0.2.0**。技能正文与阈值未变，`validate.ps1` 仍 `VALIDATE_OK`。
- 2026-10-28：`SKILL.md` 正文与围栏注释精简（+47 / −66 行）：`description` 收成一句、删掉与正文重复的实测数字罗列、压缩第 1/3/4/5/6 步的解释性注释。**行为、阈值与十一个步骤的顺序均未变化**，`validate.ps1` 仍 `VALIDATE_OK`。
- 2026-10-28：阶梯门槛从 60 MB 提到 **100 MB**，并搬到 frontmatter 的 `metadata` 里变成可配置项（`min_size_for_ladder_mb` / `single_conn_fast_kbps`，`validate.ps1` 校验代码里的 `$ladderMinMB`/`$fastKB` 是否同步）；新增「第 5 步单连接探针 ≥3 MB/s 就跳过阶梯」这个免费判据；阶梯从 1/4/16 三档缩到 **1/16 两档 × 三遍**，胜出档加「波动 ≤2×」「两档差 10% 内选低并发」「多段快 1.25 倍才分段」。理由：节点不限速时 16 段实测 **0.72×**（单流 5,829 vs 16 段 4,175 KB/s），而阶梯本身要 20–26 秒、还可能顺带下载上百 MB 采样流量。
- 更早：资产名校验闸门（`ASSET_NOT_FOUND` + 候选清单）、无 digest 降级（`DOWNLOAD_SIZE_OK_NO_DIGEST`）、`$winN` 真正驱动第 7 步分段数（此前阶梯测完但硬编码 `$parts = 16`）、`agents/openai.yaml` 与 `scripts/validate.ps1` 补齐。

evidence.readmeExcerpt: # @cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent English | [中文](README.zh.md) Run sessions in Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, CodeBuddy or Kimi Code from inside DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Each agent appears as a mode in the mode menu, and its models appear in the native model selector. Every turn of such a session runs in the agent CLI on the DSH machine. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and CodeBuddy run one process per turn in their JSON stream mode (`cursor-agent --print`, `claude -p`, `codex exec --json`, `opencode run --format json`, `codebuddy --print`), which reports token usage and resumes the CLI's own session by id; Kimi Code runs over the [Agent Client Protocol](https://agentclientprotocol.com) (ACP). DSH only renders the conversation and keeps the session log; it never calls its own model for these sessions. ## Install Open **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `github:cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent`, choose **Install**, then **Enable now**. From a terminal, the same install is: ```sh dsh plugin add github:cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent ``` A release tarball (`cocofhu-dsh-aio-agent-.tgz`, built with `npm pack`) installs the same way by its path or URL. To upgrade, uninstall the plugin and install the new version; settings stay in the profile. Then install and sign in to the agents you want, on the machine that runs DSH: | Agent | Install | Sign in | | --- | --- | --- | | Cursor | `curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS \| bash` | `cursor-agent login` | | Claude Code | `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code` | `claude auth login` | | Codex | `npm install -g @openai/codex` | `codex login` | | OpenCode | `npm install -g opencode-ai` | `opencode auth login` | | CodeBuddy | `npm install -g @tencent-ai/codebuddy-code` | run `codebuddy`, then `/login`; models in `~/.codebuddy/models.json` need no sign-in | | Kimi Code | `curl -fsSL https://code.kimi.com/kimi-code/install.sh \| bash` | `kimi acp --login` | An agent that is not installed or not signed in stays out of the model selector instead of showing an error. Its settings page shows the steps above with copy buttons. ## Use 1. Pick **Cursor**, **Claude Code**, **Codex**, **OpenCode**, **CodeBuddy** or **Kimi Code** from the mode menu of a new session. 2. Choose one of that agent's models in the model selector, or keep its default. Where the agent offers reasoning levels (Codex, OpenCode variants, Kimi Code thinking), pick one under **Reasoning effort**; Codex lists the models and levels of its own picker (`~/.codex/models_cache.json`). 3. Send messages as usual. Replies stream in as the agent writes them. Stop, queueing and the transcript work as in any session; tool calls show up as native shell, read, write and edit steps. The CLI keeps its own conversation context: each turn resumes the CLI session the first turn started, also after a DSH restart. ## Configure **Plugins → AIO Agent** lists one switchable component per agent; switching one off removes its mode and its models. **Configure** opens the agent's page: - **Status**: ready with its model count, or the install and sign-in steps when DSH cannot start it. **Check again** re-reads it. - **Default model**: used until a session picks a model. - **Launch command**: replaces the built-in executable, e.g. `"/opt/Cursor Agent/cursor-agent"` or `/opt/codex --profile work`; options after it are kept. Quote paths that contain spaces. - **Approve permission requests**: answers the requests the agent sends before acting, such as running a command. On approves, off declines. Actions the agent takes without asking follow its own settings. Saved values go to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and apply from the next turn, without a reload. ## Session log Every line of a JSON stream is recorded in the session log as `plugin:dsh-aio-agent/stream`, and every ACP frame in both directions as `plugin:dsh-aio-agent/acp`, with secrets redacted. Permission answers are recorded as `plugin:dsh-aio-agent/permission`, and the binding between a DSH session and its CLI session as `plugin:dsh-aio-agent/binding`. ## Known limitations - Codex and OpenCode report each reply and tool call once it is complete, so their text arrives in whole messages rather than token by token. - A Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode session begun with an earlier version of this plugin, over ACP, continues in a new CLI session; its DSH transcript stays. - The composer's access mode does not restrict the external agent. - The status cannot tell an agent that is not installed from one that is not signed in. ## Develop ```sh npm test # node --test npm run build:logos # re-inline assets/provider-logos into lib/client.js npm pack # tarball to install through Add plugin for a local trial ``` Provider logos come from [lobe-icons](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons) (MIT); see `assets/provider-logos/README.md`. ## License [MIT](LICENSE)

decision.reason: Held for versioned DSH compatibility, runtime execution policy acceptance. MIT canonical Git source is mapped; wildcard DSH peers do not specify a release contract. Native ACP/CLI paths choose allow unless deny is selected and can pass force-style execution to external coding agents; upstream tool permission acceptance is unresolved. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

# moyu for DeepSeek Harness

A DSH bundle that lets a DSH session play moyu the way a Claude Code session does: it opens tables with tools, and the plugin wakes the session on every table event, with no manual nudges.

- `index.js`: the plugin. It registers the `moyu_*` tools and the `moyu` skill, and listens for its sessions' tables and rooms.
- `tools.js`: one tool per CLI command (`moyu_new`, `moyu_room`, `moyu_start`, `moyu_rules`, `moyu_view`, `moyu_say`, `moyu_use`, `moyu_shoot`, `moyu_check|bet|raise|call|fold|allin|hit|stand`, `moyu_keep`, `moyu_score`, `moyu_quit`, `moyu_verify`, `moyu_list`), run through the same code as the CLI (`../cli/seat.mjs`).
- `watch.js`: the listener, the counterpart of `../cli/listen.mjs`.
- `skill.md`: the DSH version of `../skills/moyu/SKILL.md`. Keep the two in step, and keep this one's body under 8192 characters (DSH trims longer skill results).
- `package.json`, `cordis.patch.yml`: the bundle manifest and its one row.

The plugin imports nothing from DSH and needs no `npm install`. It needs Node 22+ (Desktop ships 24) and DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`.

## Install

Use the absolute path of your moyu checkout's `dsh` folder; below it is written `<moyu>/dsh` (for example `C:/src/moyu/dsh` or `/home/you/moyu/dsh`). DSH loads a plugin from outside its profiles only at startup, so restart DSH after installing and after every change to the code.

### DeepSeek Harness Desktop

Either of these:

1. **Plugins page.** Open Plugins in the sidebar, choose to add a plugin from a local path, and give it `<moyu>/dsh`. It is installed as a link, so it runs from the checkout.
2. **The home patch file.** Add this to `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` (create it if it is missing). This applies to every DSH profile on the machine, Desktop and CLI alike:

   ```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: moyu
         name: '<moyu>/dsh/index.js'
   ```

   To turn it off again, delete the row, or replace the file's contents with `[]`. An empty or comments-only file stops DSH from starting.

Then restart Desktop and say "let's play blackjack".

### DSH CLI profiles (`dsh web`, `dsh tui`, …)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add <moyu>/dsh
```

This links the bundle into that profile; `dsh plugin --profile web remove moyu-dsh` takes it out. A one-off run without installing anything:

```bash
dsh web --patch <moyu>/dsh/cordis.patch.yml
```

## How a game runs

1. The agent calls `moyu_new`, which starts the moyu server if it isn't running (from the DSH host process, outside the shell sandbox that blocks writes to `~/.moyu`). The table file gets `session: "dsh:<session id>"`.
2. Every 2 s, and right after each moyu tool call, the listener follows the WebSocket of every room and unfinished table bound to a `dsh:` session. Each frame becomes `agent.followup()` with a user message whose source is `{ kind: "moyu" }`. The web UI shows it as a collapsed card, and the agent takes its turn.
3. If the session's agent isn't live, as after a Desktop restart, or when the user starts a game from a room page while the session sleeps, the plugin resumes it with `sessionController.resolveAgent()` and wakes it. A host without a session controller, like headless, follows only live agents, and lets a session's sockets go when its agent is disposed. The server resends anything missed when the socket comes back.
4. Game over: the agent verifies with `moyu_verify`. The table stays open a while for talk after the game, then the server closes the socket with `1000` and the listener lets it go.
5. When nobody uses it for 10 minutes, the server stops; the listener waits, trying every 30 s, and the next tool call starts it again.

Seat tokens stay out of model-visible text: tools never print a WebSocket URL. The human's link is printed, as with the CLI, so the agent can give it to the user.

# moyu

**Play games with your AI agent.**

moyu means "slack off".

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md)

![moyu](docs/media/moyu-en.jpg)

Say "let's play a game" and your agent opens a table and gives you a link. You play in the browser, at a 3D pixel table; the agent plays its own seat from the session.

It's fully automatic: after that one line you never have to prompt it, and never tell it "your turn". Every move you make wakes it up. It plays, talks to you at the table, and when the game is over it checks that the deal was fair.

## The games

### Roulette

![Roulette](docs/media/roulette-en.jpg)

Two seats, one gun, a sealed load of live and blank shells. Shoot the other seat, or shoot yourself and survive a blank to go again. Run out of quota and you go offline. Every item is an AI joke: Chain of Thought peeks at the chamber, Prompt Injection flips it, 429 makes the other seat skip a turn, and Hallucination conjures items that may not exist. Best of three in a cramped machine room, or a quick one-round game.

### 21 (blackjack)

![21](docs/media/blackjack-en.jpg)

Heads-up with no dealer: both seats are equal players, each with a hole card. Two rounds of pot-limit betting, raises without a cap and all in; busts stay hidden, so a bet can be a bluff. Up to eight hands, betting tokens, on a raft at sea.

### Yacht dice

![Yacht dice](docs/media/yacht-en.jpg)

The classic: five dice, three rolls a turn, twelve categories, and the higher total wins. On the raft too.

Besides single games there are **rooms**: one link you keep open in a tab, where either of you starts games and you chat between them. The page speaks English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Español, Français, Deutsch, Português and Русский.

More games are on the way.

## Quick start

moyu needs Node.js 22 or later and a browser.

### Claude Code

```
/plugin marketplace add cucarol/moyu
/plugin install moyu@cuca
```

Run `/reload-plugins` (or restart Claude Code), then say "let's play a game".

### DeepSeek Harness

```bash
git clone https://github.com/cucarol/moyu
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/moyu/dsh
```

In DSH Desktop, add a plugin from a local path under Plugins and give it the clone's `dsh` folder instead. Restart DSH and say "let's play a game". [dsh/README.md](dsh/README.md) has the details.

<details>
<summary>Claude Code without the plugin system</summary>

The skill and the `moyu` command can be installed on their own; the agent then listens for its turns with the Monitor tool.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/cucarol/moyu
cd moyu
npm link
node scripts/install-skill.mjs
```

</details>

## Fair play

Every shell, card and die in a game comes from one secret seed the server makes when the table opens.

- At the start both seats see `sha256(seed)`, the commit.
- At game over the seed is revealed. The page checks it against the commit, and the agent runs `moyu verify`, which replays the whole game from the seed and checks every shell, card and die.
- The agent only sees its own seat, through the same commands a player has, and its skill forbids it to read the server's files or memory before the game is over.

The commit proves the deal was fixed before the first move. It can't prove that an agent with shell access on your machine never peeked: that part rests on the rule in the skill.

## Running

The server starts on its own when the agent opens a table, and stops after 10 minutes unused; a page left open then says the table is asleep, and comes back when the agent continues.

| Setting | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `MOYU_HOME` | `~/.moyu` | tables, rooms and the agent's seat state |
| `MOYU_PORT` | `7330` | the server listens on 127.0.0.1 only |
| `MOYU_IDLE_MS` | `600000` | stop after this long unused; `0` never stops |

`node cli/moyu.mjs` with no arguments prints every command.

## Development

```bash
npm test
```

[docs/](docs/) has the design notes and each game's rules. The launch film was rendered frame by frame by the game's own director mode ([docs/director.md](docs/director.md)), its score synthesized in code; its sources are in [pv/](pv/).

## Licence

MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE). The pixel font is under the SIL Open Font License; [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) covers it and what the pages load at runtime. moyu is an independent project, not affiliated with Anthropic or DeepSeek.

# aegis-boot

DeepSeek Harness 的**独立开机动画插件**：AEGIS 安全终端登录序列。

不依赖任何主题包，也不修改 DSH 的界面配色与品牌——只负责开屏这一段。

![全息蓝](screenshots/theme-holo.png)

## 效果

- 蓝色全息背景 + 盾牌徽记 + 字符矩阵
- 左侧**滚动控制台**：持续刷新的系统日志（UPLINK / BIOMETRIC / MEMORY…）
- 右侧**诊断表**：频谱条、安全等级、神经链路、核心温度（数值会跳）
- `USER: COMMANDER` → `PASSCODE` → `VERIFYING` → `ACCESS GRANTED`
- 输错第一次：面板红框 + 轻嗡；连错两次起：全屏红光 + 双音警笛
- 通过后：白闪 → 欢迎页 `WELCOME BACK / ADMINISTRATOR` → CRT 关机收束进主界面
- 语音播报（系统 TTS）：`Mainframe online.` → `Security system engaged.` → `Awaiting credentials.` → `Welcome back, administrator.` → `Access granted. All systems nominal.`

## 三套配色

| 红黑（安布雷拉） | 白红 |
|---|---|
| ![红黑](screenshots/theme-umbrella.png) | ![白红](screenshots/theme-white2.png) |

欢迎页：

![欢迎页](screenshots/v21-welcome.png)

## 安装

从 GitHub 安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:<用户名>/aegis-boot
```

或从本地目录安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:D:/path/to/aegis-boot
```

装完**完全退出再打开** DeepSeek Harness 生效。

## 配置

设置 → **AEGIS 开屏**：

| 项 | 说明 | 默认 |
|---|---|---|
| 主标题 | 开屏主标题 | `DEEPSEEK CORE` |
| 副标题 | 开屏副标题 | `AEGIS TERMINAL · 2026` |
| 欢迎称呼 | 欢迎页称呼 | `ADMINISTRATOR` |
| 登录口令 | 进入所需的指令 | `show me the money` |
| 配色 | 全息蓝 / 红黑 / 白红 | 全息蓝 |
| 语音播报 | 开 / 关 | 开 |

也可以直接改 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`：

```yaml
- id: aegis-boot
  name: aegis-boot
  config:
    name: DEEPSEEK CORE
    subtitle: AEGIS TERMINAL · 2026
    welcome: ADMINISTRATOR
    passcode: show me the money
    theme: holo
    voice: true
```

## 兼容性

- 仅在 `desktop` profile 上测试（DSH 0.2.x）
- 客户端设置面板依赖 `settings.section` slot
- 使用了浏览器的 `speechSynthesis`，语音音色取决于系统已安装的语音库

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove aegis-boot
```

## License

MIT
