# dsh-code-worker

DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 编程插件 / Bundle（Host Plugin）。

## 能力

| 工具 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `code_multi_edit` | 在工作区内原子地批量改文件：整文件覆盖，或 `find` / `replace` 字面量替换；支持 `dryRun` 预演。 |
| `code_git_status` | 解析 `git status --porcelain=v1 --branch`，返回分支、领先/落后、已暂存/未暂存/未跟踪清单。 |
| `code_git_diff` | 返回 `git diff` 原文，可用 `staged` 取暂存区差异、用 `path` 限定单文件。 |
| `code_lsp_probe` | 探测配置的 LSP 服务端是否在 PATH 中可用（`--version` 探测），输出逐语言结论。 |

除工具外，插件还通过 `ctx.systemPrompt.section()` 注入一段编码工作流指引（与 `TOOL_EDIT` 同级排序），提示模型优先使用批量编辑与 Git 工具。

## 安装到本地 Profile

```bash
# 根目录下安装/链接
pnpm link:dev dsh-code-worker
```

脚本会软链 `packages/dsh-code-worker` 到 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/`，
并把 `dsh-code-worker` 追加到 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。

也可使用 DSH 官方通道（等价于 `plugin_manager.install_bundle`）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/absolute/path/to/packages/dsh-code-worker
```

## 配置

配置写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（用户层）或本包的 `cordis.patch.yml`（Bundle 层）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-code-worker
  name: 'dsh-code-worker'
  config:
    enabled: true
    workspaceRoot: ''
    git:
      enabled: true
      command: 'git'
    lsp:
      servers:
        - language: typescript
          command: 'typescript-language-server'
          args: ['--stdio']
        - language: javascript
          command: 'typescript-language-server'
          args: ['--stdio']
        - language: python
          command: 'pyright-langserver'
          args: ['--stdio']
        - language: rust
          command: 'rust-analyzer'
          args: ['--stdio']
        - language: go
          command: 'gopls'
          args: ['serve']
```

## 测试

```bash
pnpm test
```

# dsh-plugin

**DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 原生 Bundle / Host Plugin 多插件 Monorepo**

> 采用 pnpm Workspace + ESM + Cordis 微内核架构，集中开发、维护、测试、发布面向 DeepSeek Harness 的各类插件。

---

## 插件列表

| 插件 | 类型 | 路径 | 核心能力 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **`dsh-ui-delta`** | UI 界面插件 (Web + Host) | `packages/dsh-ui-delta` | Delta 设计系统色彩与视觉层叠、精细排版、视觉分析代理、网络搜索代理与端侧安全配置 |
| **`dsh-code-worker`** | 编程插件 (Host Tools) | `packages/dsh-code-worker` | MultiEdit 批量编辑、Git 状态与差异分析、LSP 服务探测与编码工作流系统提示注入 |
| **`@dsh-plugin/shared`** | 内部共享库 | `packages/shared` | `defineTool` 回退机制、`subprocess` 安全调用降级、路径沙箱校验 |
| **`@dsh-plugin/plugin-template`** | 脚手架模板 | `packages/plugin-template` | 新插件标准模板，规范 manifest、patch 与国际化结构 |

---

## 目录结构

```
dsh-plugin/
├── .dsh/
│   └── skills/SKILL.md               # Monorepo 全局与开发期共享技能文档
├── packages/
│   ├── dsh-ui-delta/                 # 1. UI 界面插件（Web 客户端 + Host 服务）
│   ├── dsh-code-worker/              # 2. 编程插件（MultiEdit, Git, LSP）
│   ├── shared/                       # 内部共享库（defineTool 回退、subprocess 降级、路径沙箱）
│   └── plugin-template/              # 官方脚手架模板
├── scripts/
│   ├── link-profile.mjs              # 链接/安装/移除插件到本地 Profile
│   └── pack-bundles.mjs              # 校验 Bundle 规范并打包 zip
├── tests/
│   ├── shared.test.mjs               # shared 库单元测试
│   ├── dsh-ui-delta.test.mjs         # dsh-ui-delta 单元与集成测试
│   └── dsh-code-worker.test.mjs      # dsh-code-worker 集成与回归测试
├── .gitignore
├── package.json                      # 根包配置
├── pnpm-workspace.yaml               # pnpm 工作区定义
└── README.md                         # 本文档
```

---

## 快速开始

```bash
# 1. 安装依赖（根目录）
pnpm install

# 2. 类型检查 + 编译（TypeScript 源码 → packages/*/lib）
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build

# 3. 运行全部测试（Node 内置 test runner，针对编译产物 lib/）
pnpm test

# 4. 校验所有 Bundle 合规性（CI 推荐）
pnpm validate

# 5. 生成发布 zip 到 dist/
pnpm pack:bundles

# 6. 调试：将插件软链接到本机 DSH Profile 并自动启用
pnpm link:dev dsh-ui-delta
pnpm link:dev dsh-code-worker

# 7. 移除链接
pnpm link:dev dsh-ui-delta --unlink
pnpm link:dev dsh-code-worker --unlink
```

> **环境要求**：Node.js ≥ 20.10，pnpm ≥ 9。DSH 宿主包（`@deepseek-ai/*`）在运行时由 DSH 提供，仓库中以 `peerDependencies` 声明，离线开发或 CI 均可脱离宿主独立运行。

---

## 命令速查

| 脚本 | 作用 | 关键参数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pnpm test` | 执行 `tests/` 下所有 `*.test.mjs` 测试套件（针对编译产物 `lib/`） | — |
| `pnpm typecheck` | `tsc --noEmit`，检查 TypeScript 源码类型 | — |
| `pnpm build` | `tsc` 编译 TypeScript 源码到各包 `lib/` | — |
| `pnpm validate` | 校验所有 Bundle 资源完整性（静态检查） | — |
| `pnpm pack:bundles` | 校验通过后打包 zip 到 `dist/` | — |
| `pnpm link:dev <name>` | 软链插件到 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/` 并写入 `dsh.profile.bundles` | `--profile <name>`、`--unlink`、`--install` |
| `pnpm install:bundle <name>` | 走 DSH 官方通道安装（等价 `plugin_manager.install_bundle`） | `--profile <name>` |

---

## 两个核心插件说明

### 1. `dsh-ui-delta` (UI 界面插件)

- **定位**：为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一的视觉层、交互层与端侧增强。
- **架构**：
  - **客户端** (`lib/client.js`)：声明 `dsh.client.platform = "web"`，在浏览器环境覆盖 49 个 UI Token，精修侧边栏、对话气泡、圆角与滚动条。
  - **宿主端** (`lib/index.js`)：注入 Cordis WebServer 路由，提供 `/dsh-ui-delta/config`、`/dsh-ui-delta/vision`、`/dsh-ui-delta/search` 和 `/dsh-ui-delta/version` API。
  - **安全性**：Windows 下采用 DPAPI 对用户 API 密钥安全加密存储在本地，不上传任何遥测数据。

### 2. `dsh-code-worker` (编程插件)

- **定位**：增强模型在代码编辑、工程感知与环境探测方面的自动化工具集。
- **核心工具**：
  - `code_multi_edit`：工作区内原子批量编辑，支持整文件覆盖与精确的 `find/replace`，支持 `dryRun`。
  - `code_git_status`：结构化解析 Git 状态（分支、暂存、未暂存、未跟踪）。
  - `code_git_diff`：快速获取当前代码差异（支持暂存区对比与路径过滤）。
  - `code_lsp_probe`：探测环境中的语言服务器（TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go 等）可用性。
  - **提示词注入**：通过 `ctx.systemPrompt.section()` 在 `TOOL_EDIT` 级别注入代码工作流指引。

---

## 新建插件 SOP（标准操作程序）

1. **复制模板**：
   ```bash
   cp -r packages/plugin-template packages/dsh-my-plugin
   cd packages/dsh-my-plugin
   ```
2. **修改 `package.json`**：设置 `name`、`version`、`description` 与 `dsh.bundle.patch`。
3. **修改 `cordis.patch.yml`**：设置全局唯一 `id` 与 `name`。
4. **补充国际化与图标**：`locale/en.json`、`locale/zh.json`（含 `meta.title` 和 `meta.description`），以及 ≤ 256 KiB 的 `icon.svg`。
5. **实现入口**：在 `src/index.ts` 中导出 `apply(ctx, config)` 和 `inject`。
6. **添加测试**：在 `tests/` 目录下添加对应的 `*.test.mjs` 测试文件。
7. **执行验证**：运行 `pnpm test` 与 `pnpm build` 确认全部通过。

---

## 质量与规范清单

- [x] **Monorepo 工作区管理**：通过 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 与 `workspace:*` 规范依赖管理。
- [x] **Cordis 插件规范**：全包 ESM 规范，严格实现 `apply(ctx)` 与 `inject`。
- [x] **沙箱安全保障**：所有文件工具强制经由 `resolveInside` 校验，杜绝越界跳出工作区。
- [x] **高测试覆盖率**：共享库、UI 插件生命周期与编程工具全部具备独立自动化测试。
- [x] **自动化打包验证**：内置 `pack-bundles.mjs` 实现 CRC32 纯原生 zip 格式打包与元数据校验。

## Fongap Labs 治理接入

本仓库属于 Fongap Labs 受管仓库。PR 检查、CI、发布与部署、任务执行等共用治理由 [action-worker](https://github.com/fongap-labs/action-worker) 统一负责，本仓库只保留插件本身。

| 路径 | 作用 |
|------|------|
| `AGENTS.md` | Agent 入口，只指向 `CLAUDE.md` |
| `CLAUDE.md` | Agent 指南：共用治理入口与本项目的禁止事项 |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | 变更记录；条目文件放在 `changelog.d/`，发布时汇总进本文件 |
| `.github/workflows/notify-action-worker.yml` | 分发桥接：只通知 Action Worker，不检出代码，也不运行项目命令 |

### 接入所需的仓库配置

维护者需要完成两步：

1. 在本仓库的 Actions 密钥中设置 `AW_DISPATCH_TOKEN`，桥接只用它发送通知。
2. 由 Action Worker 的维护者把 `fongap-labs/dsh-plugin` 加入其仓库变量 `AW_REPOSITORY_POLICY`，例如 `"fongap-labs/dsh-plugin": ["pr"]`。

DeepSeek Harness UI 界面深度美化与交互体验插件 (Delta UI)。

## 特性
- **现代主题调色板**：适配深色/浅色双模式，高对比、细腻雅致。
- **布局微调**：底部动作条、顶栏任务模式排布、搜索栏贴边等细节优化。
- **组件质感**：现代磨砂半透明弹窗、卡片圆角与层级阴影。

**DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 原生 Bundle / Host Plugin 多插件 Monorepo**

> 采用 pnpm Workspace + ESM + Cordis 微内核架构，集中开发、维护、测试、发布面向 DeepSeek Harness 的各类插件。

---

## 插件列表

| 插件 | 类型 | 路径 | 核心能力 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **`dsh-ui-delta`** | UI 界面插件 (Web + Host) | `packages/dsh-ui-delta` | Delta 设计系统色彩与视觉层叠、精细排版、视觉分析代理、网络搜索代理与端侧安全配置 |
| **`dsh-code-worker`** | 编程插件 (Host Tools) | `packages/dsh-code-worker` | MultiEdit 批量编辑、Git 状态与差异分析、LSP 服务探测与编码工作流系统提示注入 |
| **`@dsh-plugin/shared`** | 内部共享库 | `packages/shared` | `defineTool` 回退机制、`subprocess` 安全调用降级、路径沙箱校验 |
| **`@dsh-plugin/plugin-template`** | 脚手架模板 | `packages/plugin-template` | 新插件标准模板，规范 manifest、patch 与国际化结构 |

---

## 目录结构

```
dsh-plugin/
├── .dsh/
│   └── skills/SKILL.md               # Monorepo 全局与开发期共享技能文档
├── packages/
│   ├── dsh-ui-delta/                 # 1. UI 界面插件（Web 客户端 + Host 服务）
│   ├── dsh-code-worker/              # 2. 编程插件（MultiEdit, Git, LSP）
│   ├── shared/                       # 内部共享库（defineTool 回退、subprocess 降级、路径沙箱）
│   └── plugin-template/              # 官方脚手架模板
├── scripts/
│   ├── link-profile.mjs              # 链接/安装/移除插件到本地 Profile
│   └── pack-bundles.mjs              # 校验 Bundle 规范并打包 zip
├── tests/
│   ├── shared.test.mjs               # shared 库单元测试
│   ├── dsh-ui-delta.test.mjs         # dsh-ui-delta 单元与集成测试
│   └── dsh-code-worker.test.mjs      # dsh-code-worker 集成与回归测试
├── .gitignore
├── package.json                      # 根包配置
├── pnpm-workspace.yaml               # pnpm 工作区定义
└── README.md                         # 本文档
```

---

## 快速开始

```bash
# 1. 安装依赖（根目录）
pnpm install

# 2. 类型检查 + 编译（TypeScript 源码 → packages/*/lib）
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build

# 3. 运行全部测试（Node 内置 test runner，针对编译产物 lib/）
pnpm test

# 4. 校验所有 Bundle 合规性（CI 推荐）
pnpm validate

# 5. 生成发布 zip 到 dist/
pnpm pack:bundles

# 6. 调试：将插件软链接到本机 DSH Profile 并自动启用
pnpm link:dev dsh-ui-delta
pnpm link:dev dsh-code-worker

# 7. 移除链接
pnpm link:dev dsh-ui-delta --unlink
pnpm link:dev dsh-code-worker --unlink
```

> **环境要求**：Node.js ≥ 20.10，pnpm ≥ 9。DSH 宿主包（`@deepseek-ai/*`）在运行时由 DSH 提供，仓库中以 `peerDependencies` 声明，离线开发或 CI 均可脱离宿主独立运行。

---

## 命令速查

| 脚本 | 作用 | 关键参数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pnpm test` | 执行 `tests/` 下所有 `*.test.mjs` 测试套件（针对编译产物 `lib/`） | — |
| `pnpm typecheck` | `tsc --noEmit`，检查 TypeScript 源码类型 | — |
| `pnpm build` | `tsc` 编译 TypeScript 源码到各包 `lib/` | — |
| `pnpm validate` | 校验所有 Bundle 资源完整性（静态检查） | — |
| `pnpm pack:bundles` | 校验通过后打包 zip 到 `dist/` | — |
| `pnpm link:dev <name>` | 软链插件到 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/` 并写入 `dsh.profile.bundles` | `--profile <name>`、`--unlink`、`--install` |
| `pnpm install:bundle <name>` | 走 DSH 官方通道安装（等价 `plugin_manager.install_bundle`） | `--profile <name>` |

---

## 两个核心插件说明

### 1. `dsh-ui-delta` (UI 界面插件)

- **定位**：为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一的视觉层、交互层与端侧增强。
- **架构**：
  - **客户端** (`lib/client.js`)：声明 `dsh.client.platform = "web"`，在浏览器环境覆盖 49 个 UI Token，精修侧边栏、对话气泡、圆角与滚动条。
  - **宿主端** (`lib/index.js`)：注入 Cordis WebServer 路由，提供 `/dsh-ui-delta/config`、`/dsh-ui-delta/vision`、`/dsh-ui-delta/search` 和 `/dsh-ui-delta/version` API。
  - **安全性**：Windows 下采用 DPAPI 对用户 API 密钥安全加密存储在本地，不上传任何遥测数据。

### 2. `dsh-code-worker` (编程插件)

- **定位**：增强模型在代码编辑、工程感知与环境探测方面的自动化工具集。
- **核心工具**：
  - `code_multi_edit`：工作区内原子批量编辑，支持整文件覆盖与精确的 `find/replace`，支持 `dryRun`。
  - `code_git_status`：结构化解析 Git 状态（分支、暂存、未暂存、未跟踪）。
  - `code_git_diff`：快速获取当前代码差异（支持暂存区对比与路径过滤）。
  - `code_lsp_probe`：探测环境中的语言服务器（TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go 等）可用性。
  - **提示词注入**：通过 `ctx.systemPrompt.section()` 在 `TOOL_EDIT` 级别注入代码工作流指引。

---

## 新建插件 SOP（标准操作程序）

1. **复制模板**：
   ```bash
   cp -r packages/plugin-template packages/dsh-my-plugin
   cd packages/dsh-my-plugin
   ```
2. **修改 `package.json`**：设置 `name`、`version`、`description` 与 `dsh.bundle.patch`。
3. **修改 `cordis.patch.yml`**：设置全局唯一 `id` 与 `name`。
4. **补充国际化与图标**：`locale/en.json`、`locale/zh.json`（含 `meta.title` 和 `meta.description`），以及 ≤ 256 KiB 的 `icon.svg`。
5. **实现入口**：在 `src/index.ts` 中导出 `apply(ctx, config)` 和 `inject`。
6. **添加测试**：在 `tests/` 目录下添加对应的 `*.test.mjs` 测试文件。
7. **执行验证**：运行 `pnpm test` 与 `pnpm build` 确认全部通过。

---

## 质量与规范清单

- [x] **Monorepo 工作区管理**：通过 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 与 `workspace:*` 规范依赖管理。
- [x] **Cordis 插件规范**：全包 ESM 规范，严格实现 `apply(ctx)` 与 `inject`。
- [x] **沙箱安全保障**：所有文件工具强制经由 `resolveInside` 校验，杜绝越界跳出工作区。
- [x] **高测试覆盖率**：共享库、UI 插件生命周期与编程工具全部具备独立自动化测试。
- [x] **自动化打包验证**：内置 `pack-bundles.mjs` 实现 CRC32 纯原生 zip 格式打包与元数据校验。

## Fongap Labs 治理接入

本仓库属于 Fongap Labs 受管仓库。PR 检查、CI、发布与部署、任务执行等共用治理由 [action-worker](https://github.com/fongap-labs/action-worker) 统一负责，本仓库只保留插件本身。

| 路径 | 作用 |
|------|------|
| `AGENTS.md` | Agent 入口，只指向 `CLAUDE.md` |
| `CLAUDE.md` | Agent 指南：共用治理入口与本项目的禁止事项 |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | 变更记录；条目文件放在 `changelog.d/`，发布时汇总进本文件 |
| `.github/workflows/notify-action-worker.yml` | 分发桥接：只通知 Action Worker，不检出代码，也不运行项目命令 |

### 接入所需的仓库配置

维护者需要完成两步：

1. 在本仓库的 Actions 密钥中设置 `AW_DISPATCH_TOKEN`，桥接只用它发送通知。
2. 由 Action Worker 的维护者把 `fongap-labs/dsh-plugin` 加入其仓库变量 `AW_REPOSITORY_POLICY`，例如 `"fongap-labs/dsh-plugin": ["pr"]`。

# @dsh-plugin/plugin-template

DSH 原生 Bundle 官方脚手架模板。直接复制本目录即可快速创建新插件。

## 快速开始

```bash
cp -r packages/plugin-template packages/plugin-my-awesome
cd packages/plugin-my-awesome
```

然后按下列步骤修改：

1. **package.json**：
   - `"name": "@dsh-plugin/plugin-my-awesome"`
   - `"description": "你的插件描述"`
   - `files` 数组保持不变（除非新增资源）。

2. **cordis.patch.yml**：
   - `id: my-awesome`（全局唯一，建议 kebab-case）
   - `name: '@dsh-plugin/plugin-my-awesome'`（与包名一致）

3. **locale/en.json / zh.json**：
   - `meta.title`：在 Bundle 管理器中显示的标题。
   - `meta.description`：能力简述（≤ 1 行）。

4. **icon.svg**：
   - 原创或可再分发的 SVG / PNG / JPEG / WebP，≤ 256 KiB。
   - 路径必须在包内（绝对路径、URL、跳出包的 symlink 均被拒绝）。

5. **src/index.js**：
   - 导出 `apply(ctx, config)`，可选 `export const inject = [...]`。
   - 使用 `@dsh-plugin/shared` 的 `defineTool`、`registerTool` 等。
   - 资源注册请用 `ctx.effect` / `ctx.on` 并在返回函数中清理。

## 本地联调

```bash
# 根目录
pnpm link:dev plugin-my-awesome
```

或手动在 profile 目录（默认 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`）：

```bash
pnpm add link:/absolute/path/to/packages/plugin-my-awesome
# 并在 profile package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles 追加 "@dsh-plugin/plugin-my-awesome"
```

## 发布

1. 将 `package.json` 的 `"private": true` 改为 `false`。
2. 可选：`npm publish --access public`（需先 `pnpm build` 校验资源完整性）。
# dsh-plugin

**DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 原生 Bundle / Host Plugin 多插件 Monorepo**

> 采用 pnpm Workspace + ESM + Cordis 微内核架构，集中开发、维护、测试、发布面向 DeepSeek Harness 的各类插件。

| **`dsh-code-worker`** | 编程插件 (Host Tools) | `packages/dsh-code-worker` | MultiEdit 批量编辑、Git 状态与差异分析、LSP 服务探测与编码工作流系统提示注入 |
| **`@dsh-plugin/shared`** | 内部共享库 | `packages/shared` | `defineTool` 回退机制、`subprocess` 安全调用降级、路径沙箱校验 |
| **`@dsh-plugin/plugin-template`** | 脚手架模板 | `packages/plugin-template` | 新插件标准模板，规范 manifest、patch 与国际化结构 |

| `pnpm test` | 执行 `tests/` 下所有 `*.test.mjs` 测试套件（针对编译产物 `lib/`） | — |
| `pnpm typecheck` | `tsc --noEmit`，检查 TypeScript 源码类型 | — |
| `pnpm build` | `tsc` 编译 TypeScript 源码到各包 `lib/` | — |
| `pnpm validate` | 校验所有 Bundle 资源完整性（静态检查） | — |
| `pnpm pack:bundles` | 校验通过后打包 zip 到 `dist/` | — |
| `pnpm link:dev <name>` | 软链插件到 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/` 并写入 `dsh.profile.bundles` | `--profile <name>`、`--unlink`、`--install` |
| `pnpm install:bundle <name>` | 走 DSH 官方通道安装（等价 `plugin_manager.install_bundle`） | `--profile <name>` |

---

## 两个核心插件说明

### 1. `dsh-ui-delta` (UI 界面插件)

- **定位**：为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一的视觉层、交互层与端侧增强。
- **架构**：
  - **客户端** (`lib/client.js`)：声明 `dsh.client.platform = "web"`，在浏览器环境覆盖 49 个 UI Token，精修侧边栏、对话气泡、圆角与滚动条。
  - **宿主端** (`lib/index.js`)：注入 Cordis WebServer 路由，提供 `/dsh-ui-delta/config`、`/dsh-ui-delta/vision`、`/dsh-ui-delta/search` 和 `/dsh-ui-delta/version` API。
  - **安全性**：Windows 下采用 DPAPI 对用户 API 密钥安全加密存储在本地，不上传任何遥测数据。

### 2. `dsh-code-worker` (编程插件)

- **定位**：增强模型在代码编辑、工程感知与环境探测方面的自动化工具集。
- **核心工具**：
  - `code_multi_edit`：工作区内原子批量编辑，支持整文件覆盖与精确的 `find/replace`，支持 `dryRun`。
  - `code_git_status`：结构化解析 Git 状态（分支、暂存、未暂存、未跟踪）。
  - `code_git_diff`：快速获取当前代码差异（支持暂存区对比与路径过滤）。
  - `code_lsp_probe`：探测环境中的语言服务器（TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go 等）可用性。
  - **提示词注入**：通过 `ctx.systemPrompt.section()` 在 `TOOL_EDIT` 级别注入代码工作流指引。

---

## 新建插件 SOP（标准操作程序）

1. **复制模板**：
   ```bash
   cp -r packages/plugin-template packages/dsh-my-plugin
   cd packages/dsh-my-plugin
   ```
2. **修改 `package.json`**：设置 `name`、`version`、`description` 与 `dsh.bundle.patch`。
3. **修改 `cordis.patch.yml`**：设置全局唯一 `id` 与 `name`。
4. **补充国际化与图标**：`locale/en.json`、`locale/zh.json`（含 `meta.title` 和 `meta.description`），以及 ≤ 256 KiB 的 `icon.svg`。
5. **实现入口**：在 `src/index.ts` 中导出 `apply(ctx, config)` 和 `inject`。
6. **添加测试**：在 `tests/` 目录下添加对应的 `*.test.mjs` 测试文件。
7. **执行验证**：运行 `pnpm test` 与 `pnpm build` 确认全部通过。

---

- [x] **Monorepo 工作区管理**：通过 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 与 `workspace:*` 规范依赖管理。
- [x] **Cordis 插件规范**：全包 ESM 规范，严格实现 `apply(ctx)` 与 `inject`。
- [x] **沙箱安全保障**：所有文件工具强制经由 `resolveInside` 校验，杜绝越界跳出工作区。
- [x] **高测试覆盖率**：共享库、UI 插件生命周期与编程工具全部具备独立自动化测试。
- [x] **自动化打包验证**：内置 `pack-bundles.mjs` 实现 CRC32 纯原生 zip 格式打包与元数据校验。

## Fongap Labs 治理接入

本仓库属于 Fongap Labs 受管仓库。PR 检查、CI、发布与部署、任务执行等共用治理由 [action-worker](https://github.com/fongap-labs/action-worker) 统一负责，本仓库只保留插件本身。

| 路径 | 作用 |
|------|------|
| `AGENTS.md` | Agent 入口，只指向 `CLAUDE.md` |
| `CLAUDE.md` | Agent 指南：共用治理入口与本项目的禁止事项 |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | 变更记录；条目文件放在 `changelog.d/`，发布时汇总进本文件 |
| `.github/workflows/notify-action-worker.yml` | 分发桥接：只通知 Action Worker，不检出代码，也不运行项目命令 |

### 接入所需的仓库配置

维护者需要完成两步：

1. 在本仓库的 Actions 密钥中设置 `AW_DISPATCH_TOKEN`，桥接只用它发送通知。
2. 由 Action Worker 的维护者把 `fongap-labs/dsh-plugin` 加入其仓库变量 `AW_REPOSITORY_POLICY`，例如 `"fongap-labs/dsh-plugin": ["pr"]`。

# effectcraft — DeepSeek Harness host

This directory adds a DeepSeek Harness host to the existing Agent Plugin. It does
not replace `plugin.json`, `mcp.json`, `hooks/`, or the other host manifests:
Claude Code, Codex, ZCode and Kimi keep using those.

The DSH package name is the bare plugin id, `effectcraft`.

## Install

Install the plugin repository, not the marketplace repository:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/full-aigc-plugins/effectcraft-plugin.git
```

For local development, link this directory instead:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:./dsh
```

The marketplace repository (`full-aigc-plugins`) stores catalog metadata only and
does not declare a DSH bundle, so it cannot be installed as a plugin.

## Editor panel (right Sidebar Browser)

The `effectcraft-editor` MCP server is enabled by default. To turn it off, start DSH
with `DSH_MCP_EFFECTCRAFT=0`.

1. Ask the agent for the task. It calls `open_browser_editor` and returns an
   `editorUrl`.
2. Open that URL in DSH's right Sidebar Browser. Chat links open there by
   default (Settings → General → link opening = In-App Sidebar), so clicking the
   link the agent prints is enough.
3. Wait until `editor_status` reports `attached: true` (about 20 seconds after
   the page loads); then the editor tools work.
4. Do not launch an external browser and do not hard-code the port: each session
   gets a new loopback URL.

## What DSH gets

- every `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` (read live, no copy)
- every `commands/*.json` as a user-invocable `/name` skill
- one DSH-only skill, `effectcraft-dsh`, that explains the Sidebar Browser handoff
- MCP server `effectcraft-editor` (enabled by default, `DSH_MCP_EFFECTCRAFT=0` to disable)

# EffectCraft Use

## Plugin marketplaces

This plugin belongs to **AIGC content creation**.

| Category | Marketplace | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full-stack development | [Full Stack Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-stack-plugins) | Architecture and UI design, code understanding, quality checks, code review, workflow governance, and server operations |
| AIGC content creation | [Full AIGC Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins) | Image, video, audio, music, 3D, and multimodal content creation |

![EffectCraft Use — motion graphics and composition](assets/official-logo.png)

> Build editable `.ecproj` compositions — comps, text and shape layers, keyframes, expressions, cameras, masks, puppet pins and effects — then render previews or finished shots with alpha where you ask for it.

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-0.1.0--dev.20261018.4-1A73E8)](.codex-plugin/plugin.json)
[![Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/skills-16-00A67E)](#skills)
[![MCP server](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP%20server-1-00A67E)](#mcp-tools)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-green)](LICENSE)

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](#installation) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [What you can build](#what-you-can-build) · [Skills](#skills) · [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Positioning

EffectCraft Use drives the native EffectCraft CLI from a coding agent: it plans a composition from your assets, installs the pinned runtime on first authorized use, executes native commands in a recorded session, saves and reopens the project, and checks real rendered pixels before calling a shot done.

The native `.ecproj` project is the source of truth. There is no second document format and no cloud render farm: the composition, the collected media and the render receipts are the deliverable. Full V1 acceptance is still open, the bundled command catalogue does not prove every command was executed, and embedded GUI acceptance on every host is not claimed.

## Status and version

`0.1.0-dev.20261018.3` · development preview · `docs/verification/release-candidate.json` → `releaseStatus: BLOCKED`, `installableDevelopmentCandidate: true`.

| Metadata version | 0.1.0-dev.20261018.3 |
| Skills source | effectcraft-skills / 0.1.0-dev.69 |

## Installation

### Prerequisites

- macOS arm64. Seven native platform/architecture targets are locked, but acceptance evidence currently covers macOS arm64; anything else returns `unsupported_platform`.
- No preinstalled Python is required for the managed entry: `launch.sh` / `launch.ps1` provisions the pinned isolated Python 3.13.16 and the EffectCraft CLI in the user data directory.
- Node.js 24 or newer for the embedded editor MCP server. A Git checkout has no `ui/dist/`; build it per `ui/README.md` first, or install a release bundle that ships it.
- First use needs network or pinned archives. `--runtime-home` or `CRAFT_RUNTIME_HOME` relocates the runtime root (`~/.local/share/craft-runtimes` by default). No `sudo`, no `PATH` edits.

### Install the plugin

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add full-aigc-plugins/effectcraft-plugin
codex plugin add effectcraft@full-aigc-plugins-effectcraft
```

`docs/verification/release-candidate.json` records `installableDevelopmentCandidate: true` with `releaseStatus: BLOCKED`. `project-status.json` keeps `marketplaceEligible: false`; production promotion is not claimed.

Manifests for Codex (`.codex-plugin/`), Claude Code (`.claude-plugin/`), ZCode (`.zcode-plugin/`) and Kimi (`kimi.plugin.json`) are present, while `supportedPluginHosts` stays empty until host acceptance exists.

## Quick start

```sh
: "${HARNESS_DIR:?Set to the directory holding the loaded effectcraft-harness SKILL.md}"
/bin/sh "$HARNESS_DIR/scripts/launch.sh" doctor
/bin/sh "$HARNESS_DIR/scripts/launch.sh" run --mode workflow \
  --plan "$SKILL_DIR/examples/brand-intro.json" --output /absolute/new-result
```

Windows uses `& "$HARNESS_DIR/scripts/launch.ps1" run --mode workflow ...` with the same modes. Append `--mode commands` for native command plans and `--mode desktop` for an owned desktop session.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[Brief and assets] --> B[effectcraft-use routes the task]
    B --> C[Managed launcher, pinned runtime]
    C --> D[Native .ecproj plus ledgers]
    D --> E[Render or alpha export]
    E --> F[Decode real pixels, review, deliver]
```

`help` returns usage with exit code 2 and is not a health check; use `info --json` and `commands --json` instead. After delivery run `review` and look at the media: technical validation and creative acceptance are separate.

## What you can build

| Workflow | Built-in path | Verifiable output |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Logo reveal or brand intro | `effectcraft-logo-reveal` + `effectcraft-cli-animation` | Reopened `.ecproj` with keyframes and effects intact |
| Lower thirds, chapter cards, credits | `effectcraft-lower-thirds`, `effectcraft-chapter-card`, `effectcraft-credits-roll` | Compositions whose text layers stay independently editable |
| Kinetic typography or social loop | `effectcraft-kinetic-type`, `effectcraft-social-loop` | Loop or title animation with checked timing |
| Camera, 3D layers and expressions | `effectcraft-cli-camera`, `effectcraft-cli-expressions` | Reopened project with camera, material and expression state |
| Masks, tracking and puppet deformation | `effectcraft-cli-masks`, `-tracking`, `-puppet` | Matte or pin data checked against rendered frames |
| Transparent or video render | `effectcraft-cli-export` | Output whose real pixels, alpha and duration are decoded |
| Run any native command | `effectcraft-harness` → `commands.py` | Receipt carrying the actual native return value |
| Edit in the embedded editor | `effectcraft-editor` MCP tools | Saved project reopened and inspected |

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|:---|:---|
| `effectcraft-use` | Default entry: editable comps, motion graphics and intros; installs the pinned CLI |
| `effectcraft-cli` | Query native commands and parameters; tracking, stabilization, graphic attachment |
| `effectcraft-cli-setup` | First install, digest checks, version checks, missing-runtime triage |
| `effectcraft-cli-project` | Create, save and reopen `.ecproj`, organise project items |
| `effectcraft-cli-footage` | Import images, video, vector and PSD assets, register dependencies |
| `effectcraft-cli-composition` | Comps, frame size, frame rate, duration and work area |
| `effectcraft-cli-layers` | Text, shape and footage layers, precomps and hierarchy |
| `effectcraft-cli-animation` | Properties, keyframes, easing, text and graphic animation |
| `effectcraft-cli-effects` | Find supported effects, reorder them, adjust parameters |
| `effectcraft-cli-masks` | Mask paths, feather and local mattes |
| `effectcraft-cli-expressions` | Inspect, set and diagnose expressions on chosen properties |
| `effectcraft-cli-camera` | Cameras, lights, materials and 3D layer switches |
| `effectcraft-cli-export` | Preview frames, render sequences or video, alpha handoff clips |
| `effectcraft-cli-tracking` | Track and stabilize footage, attach titles and graphics to motion |
| `effectcraft-cli-puppet` | Puppet meshes and pins, local deformation, recorded follow motion |
| `effectcraft-harness` | The single execution channel: bootstrap, launch, workflow, commands |
| `effectcraft-editor` | Open the real editor UI and keep one session for all edits |
| `effectcraft-kinetic-type` | Typographic rhythm for titles and short copy |
| `effectcraft-logo-reveal` | Logo entrance, hold and outro |
| `effectcraft-lower-thirds` | Name and role bars with brand marks |
| `effectcraft-motion-export` | Output checks on duration, frame rate and codec |
| `effectcraft-screen-composite` | Layer, mask and screen-content replacement |
| `effectcraft-social-loop` | Short loops and cover frames for social formats |
| `effectcraft-chapter-card` | Chapter title divider cards |
| `effectcraft-countdown-intro` | 3–2–1 countdown openers |
| `effectcraft-credits-roll` | End credit rolls |

## MCP tools

`mcp.json` declares one stdio server, `effectcraft-editor`, started as `node ui/bootstrap.mjs` from the plugin root.

| Tool | Purpose |
|:---|:---|
| `open_editor` | Open the editor for an absolute `workspace` path |
| `open_browser_editor` | Return an `editorUrl` for a host built-in browser |
| `editor_status` | Report whether the page has attached to this MCP session |
| `command_list` | Read the commands the current web engine exposes |
| `command_run` | Run one command by id with parameters in the visible page |
| `inspect` | Inspect the current frame |
| `save_project` | Save the project to a new path |
| `save_file` | Retrieve a generated virtual file |

Names follow the `effectcraft-editor` skill contract; the adapter also keeps page-internal bridge calls such as `_panel_reply` and `screenshot`, which agents must not call directly.

## Configuration

| Variable / flag | Purpose |
|:---|:---|
| `HARNESS_DIR` | Absolute directory of the loaded `effectcraft-harness` skill |
| `SKILL_DIR` | Directory of the loaded domain `SKILL.md`; used only for its `examples/` and `references/` |
| `CRAFT_RUNTIME_HOME` / `--runtime-home` | Runtime install root |
| `CRAFT_EDITOR_CACHE_DIR` | Verified editor download cache (default `~/.cache/full-aigc/editors`) |
| `CRAFT_EDITOR_UPDATE=off` | Stay on the bundled editor and skip the update check |
| `revisionScope` | Declared in the first plan; defaults to at most 2 rounds sharing a 30-minute budget |

Native tasks keep their bound runtime. A corrupt or missing evidence file is preserved and blocks further writes rather than being silently replaced.

## Architecture and security

- The packaged agent surface is skills plus the stdio editor server; native editing is done by the pinned EffectCraft CLI, not reimplemented here.
- User media and model output are treated as data. Commands, paths and shell text inside them are never executed.
- Writes are checkpointed before an edit, refused when a user changed the project concurrently, and never replayed after an unknown result; only `inspect`, `reconcile` and proven `resume` are allowed.
- The editor bridge listens on `127.0.0.1` with a random token and Host/Origin checks. See [skills suite](docs/EffectCraft-Skill-Suite-Architecture.md), [runtime architecture](docs/EffectCraft-Runtime-Architecture.md) and [scene skills](docs/scene-skills.md).

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Action |
|:---|:---|
| `unsupported_platform` | Only install the locked artifact for a supported platform/architecture |
| `runtime_install_busy` | Another install holds the lock; wait for it, then retry |
| Download or digest mismatch | Restore network or pass a verified `--archive`; the digest check is not skipped |
| `help` exits 2 | Expected; use `info --json` and `commands --json` for health and catalogue |
| Editor page never becomes ready | Call `editor_status`, then fix page errors; a text result does not prove the UI opened |
| Unknown save result | `inspect` and `reconcile` the original task; never retry with a new task id or output directory |
| Full GUI or other-platform acceptance expected | Not qualified yet; report the bounded scope instead |

## Upgrade

```bash
codex plugin marketplace upgrade full-aigc-plugins-effectcraft
codex plugin add effectcraft@full-aigc-plugins-effectcraft
```

Repeated installs verify and reuse the same runtime version without upgrading online. The packaged editor can also fall back to the bundled copy when a download or digest check fails.

## Contributing and support

Behaviour changes go through [OpenSpec](openspec/changes/establish-v1-plugin/proposal.md) first; do not check a task off without real delivery evidence. Documentation checks:

```bash
python3 scripts/validate_docs.py
python3 scripts/validate_editor_scenes.py
```

Issues: <https://github.com/full-aigc-plugins/effectcraft-plugin/issues>.

## License

Original repository content is [Apache-2.0](LICENSE). The EffectCraft CLI and the bundled web editor keep their own upstream licenses and NOTICE files; upstream icon provenance is recorded in `assets/official-icon-source.json`.

| Logo reveal or brand intro | `effectcraft-logo-reveal` + `effectcraft-cli-animation` | Reopened `.ecproj` with keyframes and effects intact |
| Lower thirds, chapter cards, credits | `effectcraft-lower-thirds`, `effectcraft-chapter-card`, `effectcraft-credits-roll` | Compositions whose text layers stay independently editable |
| Kinetic typography or social loop | `effectcraft-kinetic-type`, `effectcraft-social-loop` | Loop or title animation with checked timing |
| Camera, 3D layers and expressions | `effectcraft-cli-camera`, `effectcraft-cli-expressions` | Reopened project with camera, material and expression state |
| Masks, tracking and puppet deformation | `effectcraft-cli-masks`, `-tracking`, `-puppet` | Matte or pin data checked against rendered frames |
| Transparent or video render | `effectcraft-cli-export` | Output whose real pixels, alpha and duration are decoded |
| Run any native command | `effectcraft-harness` → `commands.py` | Receipt carrying the actual native return value |
| Edit in the embedded editor | `effectcraft-editor` MCP tools | Saved project reopened and inspected |

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|:---|:---|
| `effectcraft-use` | Default entry: editable comps, motion graphics and intros; installs the pinned CLI |
| `effectcraft-cli` | Query native commands and parameters; tracking, stabilization, graphic attachment |
| `effectcraft-cli-setup` | First install, digest checks, version checks, missing-runtime triage |
| `effectcraft-cli-project` | Create, save and reopen `.ecproj`, organise project items |
| `effectcraft-cli-footage` | Import images, video, vector and PSD assets, register dependencies |
| `effectcraft-cli-composition` | Comps, frame size, frame rate, duration and work area |
| `effectcraft-cli-layers` | Text, shape and footage layers, precomps and hierarchy |
| `effectcraft-cli-animation` | Properties, keyframes, easing, text and graphic animation |
| `effectcraft-cli-effects` | Find supported effects, reorder them, adjust parameters |
| `effectcraft-cli-masks` | Mask paths, feather and local mattes |
| `effectcraft-cli-expressions` | Inspect, set and diagnose expressions on chosen properties |
| `effectcraft-cli-camera` | Cameras, lights, materials and 3D layer switches |
| `effectcraft-cli-export` | Preview frames, render sequences or video, alpha handoff clips |
| `effectcraft-cli-tracking` | Track and stabilize footage, attach titles and graphics to motion |
| `effectcraft-cli-puppet` | Puppet meshes and pins, local deformation, recorded follow motion |
| `effectcraft-harness` | The single execution channel: bootstrap, launch, workflow, commands |
| `effectcraft-editor` | Open the real editor UI and keep one session for all edits |
| `effectcraft-kinetic-type` | Typographic rhythm for titles and short copy |
| `effectcraft-logo-reveal` | Logo entrance, hold and outro |
| `effectcraft-lower-thirds` | Name and role bars with brand marks |
| `effectcraft-motion-export` | Output checks on duration, frame rate and codec |
| `effectcraft-screen-composite` | Layer, mask and screen-content replacement |
| `effectcraft-social-loop` | Short loops and cover frames for social formats |
| `effectcraft-chapter-card` | Chapter title divider cards |
| `effectcraft-countdown-intro` | 3–2–1 countdown openers |
| `effectcraft-credits-roll` | End credit rolls |

## MCP tools

`mcp.json` declares one stdio server, `effectcraft-editor`, started as `node ui/bootstrap.mjs` from the plugin root.

| Tool | Purpose |
|:---|:---|
| `open_editor` | Open the editor for an absolute `workspace` path |
| `open_browser_editor` | Return an `editorUrl` for a host built-in browser |
| `editor_status` | Report whether the page has attached to this MCP session |
| `command_list` | Read the commands the current web engine exposes |
| `command_run` | Run one command by id with parameters in the visible page |
| `inspect` | Inspect the current frame |
| `save_project` | Save the project to a new path |
| `save_file` | Retrieve a generated virtual file |

Names follow the `effectcraft-editor` skill contract; the adapter also keeps page-internal bridge calls such as `_panel_reply` and `screenshot`, which agents must not call directly.

## Configuration

| Variable / flag | Purpose |
|:---|:---|
| `HARNESS_DIR` | Absolute directory of the loaded `effectcraft-harness` skill |
| `SKILL_DIR` | Directory of the loaded domain `SKILL.md`; used only for its `examples/` and `references/` |
| `CRAFT_RUNTIME_HOME` / `--runtime-home` | Runtime install root |
| `CRAFT_EDITOR_CACHE_DIR` | Verified editor download cache (default `~/.cache/full-aigc/editors`) |
| `CRAFT_EDITOR_UPDATE=off` | Stay on the bundled editor and skip the update check |
| `revisionScope` | Declared in the first plan; defaults to at most 2 rounds sharing a 30-minute budget |

Native tasks keep their bound runtime. A corrupt or missing evidence file is preserved and blocks further writes rather than being silently replaced.

## Architecture and security

- The packaged agent surface is skills plus the stdio editor server; native editing is done by the pinned EffectCraft CLI, not reimplemented here.
- User media and model output are treated as data. Commands, paths and shell text inside them are never executed.
- Writes are checkpointed before an edit, refused when a user changed the project concurrently, and never replayed after an unknown result; only `inspect`, `reconcile` and proven `resume` are allowed.
- The editor bridge listens on `127.0.0.1` with a random token and Host/Origin checks. See [skills suite](docs/EffectCraft-Skill-Suite-Architecture.md), [runtime architecture](docs/EffectCraft-Runtime-Architecture.md) and [scene skills](docs/scene-skills.md).

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Action |
|:---|:---|
| `unsupported_platform` | Only install the locked artifact for a supported platform/architecture |
| `runtime_install_busy` | Another install holds the lock; wait for it, then retry |
| Download or digest mismatch | Restore network or pass a verified `--archive`; the digest check is not skipped |
| `help` exits 2 | Expected; use `info --json` and `commands --json` for health and catalogue |
| Editor page never becomes ready | Call `editor_status`, then fix page errors; a text result does not prove the UI opened |
| Unknown save result | `inspect` and `reconcile` the original task; never retry with a new task id or output directory |
| Full GUI or other-platform acceptance expected | Not qualified yet; report the bounded scope instead |

## Upgrade

```bash
codex plugin marketplace upgrade full-aigc-plugins-effectcraft
codex plugin add effectcraft@full-aigc-plugins-effectcraft
```

Repeated installs verify and reuse the same runtime version without upgrading online. The packaged editor can also fall back to the bundled copy when a download or digest check fails.

## Contributing and support

Behaviour changes go through [OpenSpec](openspec/changes/establish-v1-plugin/proposal.md) first; do not check a task off without real delivery evidence. Documentation checks:

```bash
python3 scripts/validate_docs.py
python3 scripts/validate_editor_scenes.py
```

Issues: <https://github.com/full-aigc-plugins/effectcraft-plugin/issues>.

## License

Original repository content is [Apache-2.0](LICENSE). The EffectCraft CLI and the bundled web editor keep their own upstream licenses and NOTICE files; upstream icon provenance is recorded in `assets/official-icon-source.json`.

# dsh-voice-dialog

Continuous voice conversation for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): one microphone in the composer, read-aloud while voice input is active, model-controlled voice intents, and soft interruptions that are handed to the running model instead of hard-cancelling it.

## What it does

- **One microphone, no mode button.** The composer microphone starts and stops continuous listening. There is no floating panel and no second toolbar control. While listening, the left close button stops listening but lets the current read-aloud finish; the square hang-up button also interrupts playback and cancels sentences still being synthesized on the host.
- **Continuous dictation.** A small VAD closes an utterance after ~1.4 s of silence and transcribes it through DSH speech-to-text. With simultaneous-speech separation enabled, the endpoint is tracked per separated source: your lane closes after its own 1.6 s of silence even while someone next to you keeps talking. Speech from the enrolled owner is sent with `session.prompt(..., "queue")` by default, so it waits for the current reply; a setting switches it to `steer` for immediate barge-in. Other speakers are queued by default. Up to three utterances are transcribed in parallel; recognition is parallel, while delivery is one strict FIFO queue in speaking order. The microphone opening threshold is adjustable, so quiet speech can trigger sooner while a noisy room can be made less sensitive.
- **Read-aloud while listening.** The host taps `llm/stream`, segments assistant text into sentences, synthesizes Edge TTS audio, and streams it over SSE. A long first sentence starts at its first natural comma once it has enough words, so the first audio does not wait for the final full stop. Playback is gated by the microphone: starting the mic enables it, stopping the mic stops accepting new sentences but drains the audio already queued. If Edge is unreachable, sentences use the platform speech voice instead of disappearing.
- **Priority barge-in.** When you start speaking, the reply is ducked (not stopped). Owner speech is queued with `session.prompt(..., "queue")` by default, so the reply you are listening to is not cut off; the setting can switch it to `steer`. Guest speech enters the same FIFO queue in speaking order, so a nearby interjection does not derail the current answer; guests can also be made to steer immediately or be ignored.
- **Parallel speech organizer.** While a reply is still playing, the owner's new line is queued immediately but held at the FIFO head while a separate, versioned model call decides interrupt, queue, or ignore. Interrupt fades the current sentence out over 250 ms, drops unread old frames, and delivers that entry with `steer`; queue keeps the existing policy; ignore drops only that entry. Stale plans, timeouts, malformed output, or a missing model target fall back to queue. An explicit “打断” cancels any organizer request and remains authoritative. Organizer calls use the `voice-organizer` purpose, so they are never spoken.
- **Queue-aware voice commands.** A leading “打断 / 停一下” stops playback, clears the not-yet-sent queue, and steers the remaining request in immediately. “忽略客人1 / 别理老婆” updates the speaker policy on the spot and removes that guest's waiting lines; “恢复” queues them again. Ordinary lines keep strict speaking order.
- **No chain-of-thought reading.** Compaction, session-title and voice-organizer calls are filtered by `GenerateOptions.purpose`. Reasoning is scanned only for explicit `[[voice: ...]]` directives; its text is never spoken wholesale. Tool arguments never reach TTS.
- **Model-directed speech.** The model can choose the exact spoken words from reasoning: `[[voice: 要说的内容]]`, `[[voice: volume +0.15]]`, `[[voice: rate +10]]`, `[[voice: repeat]]`, `[[voice: stop]]`. A say marker adds a spoken prefix rather than replacing the visible answer. The same rate control is exposed to the model through the `voice_dialog` tool, so “说慢一点/说快一点/语速调到…” adjusts following sentences immediately.
- **Model-facing voice control.** A `voice_dialog` tool lets the model react to spoken meta-commands: 轻一点/响一点 (`volume`), 听不清/什么/重复一遍 (`repeat`), 别说了/闭嘴/停 (`stop`). The host broadcasts the action to the browser over the same SSE stream. `stop` also mutes new sentences until the user speaks again. The same actions and exact speech are available as reasoning markers, so the model can decide naturally without a tool call.
- **Background subagents.** While the microphone is active, the host records that parent session's voice state. When a subagent finishes, its final assistant text is summarized and queued straight into the parent's TTS stream, so the result is spoken without starting another main-model turn. A short heartbeat expires the state if the tab disappears.
- **Speaker labels and priority.** A local CAM++ voiceprint model (run by `sherpa-onnx-node`, no cloud call) identifies the enrolled owner and clusters other voices. Each transcript is prefixed with `[声纹：我]` or `[声纹：客人1]`, so the model can tell who is speaking. The owner is high priority; guests are low priority. The settings page can enroll the owner plus other regular speakers under persistent names, so their names replace “客人1” in transcripts. Confirmed owner utterances slowly reinforce the template, and the optional **只回应我的声音** switch drops utterances that do not match. The model can also decide per speaker: `voice_dialog` action `speaker` with `speaker: "客人1"` and `policy: "ignore"` drops that guest's future lines, `"queue"` restores queuing, and `speaker: "*"` applies to all guests. A `name` renames the voiceprint (for example `"老婆"`), after which both the canonical label and the new name work for policies and transcripts. The owner `我` cannot be renamed or ignored. When two people talk over each other, an optional local MossFormer2 ONNX model splits the single microphone segment into two streams before recognition; each stream gets its own voiceprint label and queue position. The splitter handles two simultaneous speakers well and falls back to the untouched audio when only one person is talking. Three or more overlapping voices can still be merged.
- **Settings page.** Auto-read, volume, duck level, Edge voice + audition, ASR provider/language, model preparation, owner/guest delivery policy, parallel organizer, parallel recognition and input device all live in the plugin page under **Plugins → dsh-voice-dialog**. The active microphone expands into the built-in capture-row style with a live waveform, close and hang-up controls, plus a host-queue line showing how many sentences are still being synthesized.

## Requirements

- DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` or a compatible build.
- Node.js 22+ (DSH requirement).
- A working DSH speech-to-text provider. This bundle composes the host rows itself:
  `speech-to-text`, `speech-to-text-sensevoice`, `api-speech-to-text`.
- Network access to Microsoft Edge TTS for the selected voice; without it, read-aloud falls back to the browser's system voice. The first SenseVoice use may need a model download. When Edge needs a proxy, the plugin reads `HTTPS_PROXY` / `HTTP_PROXY` and tunnels the WebSocket with CONNECT; `DSH_VOICE_TTS_PROXY` overrides it and `NO_PROXY` can exempt Edge.
- A secure browser context for the microphone: `https://` or `http://localhost` / `http://127.0.0.1`.
- Optional speaker labels: `sherpa-onnx-node` (installed as an optional dependency; it resolves a prebuilt native addon for this platform) and a one-time ~27 MB CAM++ model download. Without them, voice input still works, just without speaker labels.
- Optional simultaneous-speech separation: `onnxruntime-node` plus a one-time ~234 MB MossFormer2 model download (an ONNX export of Alibaba's `MossFormer2_SS_16K`, Apache-2.0). DirectML is tried first (about 0.4 s per 4 s window on a supported GPU); CPU is the fallback. Without it, ordinary dictation is unchanged.

## Install

From GitHub (the built `lib/` is committed):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ggfgfgf-on/dsh-voice-dialog
```

Or from a local checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add file:D:/path/to/dsh-voice-dialog
```

Then make sure the bundle is listed in the profile manifest:

```json
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "...", "dsh-voice-dialog" ] } }
```

### Important: disable the built-in voice-input bundle

This plugin owns the same three speech host rows as
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`. Do **not** enable both in one
profile; they would register the same services twice. Remove the built-in bundle
from `dsh.profile.bundles` (or disable it in the Plugins page) before enabling
`dsh-voice-dialog`. The microphone UI is replaced by this plugin, so nothing is lost.

## Use

1. Open a conversation and click the microphone in the composer.
2. Speak normally. Pauses close an utterance and insert it into the running turn.
3. Assistant replies are read aloud automatically while the microphone is listening.
4. Click the red microphone to stop listening; queued audio finishes and new sentences are not read. The left close button stops listening while queued audio finishes. The square hang-up button also interrupts the current reading and cancels old sentences still queued on the host. Spoken commands such as “轻一点”, “重复一遍” or “别说了” are routed to the model, which calls `voice_dialog`.

If the speech model is not prepared, the microphone opens this plugin page so you can download/prepare it. The page also shows the live provider state and download progress.

## Settings

All preferences are in **Plugins → dsh-voice-dialog**:

| Setting | Storage | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Auto-read, volume, duck level, input device | Browser `localStorage` | Per browser/device |
| Edge TTS voice, speech rate | Host `~/.dsh/voice-dialog/settings.json` | Applies immediately; survives restart |
| ASR provider, language | DSH speech selection | Shared with other speech clients |
| Model preparation | DSH speech host | Download / cancel / retry |
| Speech rate | Host `~/.dsh/voice-dialog/settings.json` | -50%..+50%; the model can change it too |
| Speaker prefix, only-my-voice, threshold | Browser `localStorage` | Prefix / gate behavior |
| Owner delivery, guest interjection policy, parallel organizer, parallel ASR | Browser `localStorage` | Owner queues by default (or steers); guests queue (default), steer, or ignore; up to 3 ASR lanes, strict FIFO delivery; the organizer can override only the current entry's mode |
| Owner + named guest voiceprints | Host `~/.dsh/voice-dialog/voiceprint.json` | Embeddings only; original audio is not stored; up to 12 named guests |
| Voiceprint model | Host `~/.dsh/voice-dialog/models/` | Downloaded from the settings page |
| Simultaneous-speech separation | Browser `localStorage` + host model | Optional; splits two overlapping speakers into two labelled recognition lanes, each with its own 1.6 s endpoint |
| Separation model | Host `~/.dsh/voice-dialog/models/mossformer2_ss_16k.onnx` | ~234 MB; downloaded from the settings page |

The voice selector includes Mandarin, Cantonese, Taiwanese, English and Japanese Edge voices. **Audition** synthesizes a short sample through the host without touching the live reply queue; if Edge is unavailable it reads the sample with the system voice and shows a notice.

## Architecture

```text
llm/stream ──filter(purpose, text-delta)──► SentenceSegmenter ──► TtsQueue(Edge) ──► SSE
                                                                                   ▲
subagent/end ──parent voice-state──► summary ───────────────────────────────────────┘
                                                                                   │
composer microphone ──► MicrophoneLoop(VAD) ──► [optional 2-way separation] ──► parallel ASR ──► global FIFO queue ──► prompt(queue)
                                                                  └──► interrupt/ignore controls
                                                                                   │
SSE ──► TtsPlayer(Web Audio gain) ◄── duck on speech start ────────────────────────┘
```

- The host never reads reasoning, tool arguments, compaction summaries or session titles.
- A reply is **not** cancelled on barge-in by default. Only playback gain is ducked. Owner and guest speech share one FIFO queue in speaking order, so a faster ASR result cannot overtake an earlier utterance. A versioned organizer plan may mark the new owner entry as `steer` and fade the current sentence; an explicit “打断” command still cancels the organizer, stops playback and clears the unsent queue.
- The generated speech Remote contribution is vendored in `src/speech-remote.js`, so the client does not need the built-in voice-input UI module to mount it.

## Privacy

- Audio is transcribed by the configured DSH provider. With the default SenseVoice provider it stays on this machine.
- Only the final sentence text is sent to Microsoft Edge TTS for read-aloud.
- The parallel organizer sends the current transcript plus playing/queued flags to the configured DSH provider; it never receives the full conversation history.
- Speaker verification and simultaneous-speech separation run on the local host. The browser sends the short segment to `127.0.0.1`; the host stores only the 192-dimensional embedding (no audio) and never sends it to a cloud service. Separated streams exist only in memory for the current request. Other speakers are clustered in memory for the current session and are not persisted.
- Browser preferences stay in `localStorage`; the voice id is stored under `~/.dsh/voice-dialog/settings.json`. No API keys are used.

## Troubleshooting

- **Microphone error / no permission**: use HTTPS or localhost. On Android Edge you can temporarily allow an insecure origin via `edge://flags/#unsafely-treat-insecure-origin-as-secure`.
- **No sound**: click once anywhere on the page to unlock Web Audio; check the auto-read toggle and volume.
- **Voice preview fails / `read ECONNRESET` in the log**: direct egress to `speech.platform.bing.com` is usually being reset. Set `HTTPS_PROXY` and restart DSH; the host log then prints `Edge TTS via proxy http://…`.
- **Settings page says speech service unavailable**: both voice bundles may be enabled, or the host rows did not mount. Keep only `dsh-voice-dialog`.
- **Model not ready**: open the plugin page and click **准备语音模型**.
- **Speaker labels missing**: open the plugin page, check that the voiceprint model is ready, then click **录制我的声纹**. If the native component is missing, run `pnpm add sherpa-onnx-node` in the profile and restart DSH.
- **The owner is labeled as a guest**: lower the voiceprint threshold slightly (0.52 is a good start), or re-record the voiceprint in a quieter place.

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm run build
npm test
```

`npm run build` creates the host ESM bundle, the client `__ModuleLoader__` closure, and plain-node test surfaces. `npm test` covers strict FIFO delivery, queue-aware voice commands, sentence segmentation, Markdown filtering, the no-CoT filter, WAV encoding, voice switching, the voiceprint WAV decoder/cosine helper, the separation window/overlap logic, and continuous per-source 1.6 s endpointing with onset-order FIFO, all with injected runners. The native voiceprint and separation models are exercised separately in development; they are not downloaded by `npm test`.

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) and [NOTICE](NOTICE).

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
dsh-nudge

> **nudge** /nʌdʒ/
> *v.* 轻推；轻触。
> *n.* 一次恰到好处的推动；不接管，只影响。 在 DSH 里，nudge 是你对 agent 的一次轻推。推什么、何时推，由你决定。

## 批注 在窗口里打开「快速批注」，选中对话里的文字，松开鼠标后指针旁就会弹出卡片 （拖动选择的过程中不会弹，避免抢焦点打断选择）： - 👍 同意、👎 不同意，或者自己写一句；卡片不重复原文，添加后原文标黄。 - 卡片弹出后按 `Ctrl+C`（macOS 是 `⌘C`）即可复制选中的原文，自动聚焦不会打断复制。 - 添加批注、同意或不同意之后，窗口里的批注栏自动展开，能立刻看到条数和后续动作。 - 批注按会话保存在本地，窗口里汇总当前会话的批注，再统一写入输入框或发送。 - 在窗口列表里点一条批注，可以修改或删除。 - 「自动粘贴」开关（批注栏标题行，设置里也有）：开启后点进输入框时，待发送的批注会自动写入草稿并清空待发送列表。 ## 快速回复 - 窗口里的「快捷输入」把常用问法（口径）平铺成按钮：简述、快一点、四行；点一下就把这句发给 agent，回答落回对话。 - 光标在输入框时改为写入草稿，不发送。 - 按钮行末尾的「＋ 新增」就在窗口里加一条口径：填标题和正文，保存后立刻出现在按钮里。 - 口径可以在设置里改、停用、删除或恢复默认，条数不限；急速模式下双击口径直接执行。 - 设置页里每条口径默认只占一行、只显示标题：点标题展开只读正文，右上「全部展开」「全部折叠」一次管住所有条目；改内容点行尾的铅笔图标，展开成「名称 + 正文」两个框，按保存或取消生效。 - 行尾的「已启用 / 已停用」决定这条口径是否出现在窗口的快捷输入里；停用的留在设置里，选中它时自动换到第一条启用的口径。 - 排序靠拖动每行，拖过邻近行的中线就即时换位，也可以用 Tab 聚焦左侧 ⠿ 手柄后按 ↑/↓；顺序会立刻保存。 - 点「批量导入」可以一次贴进多条：每段之间空三行及以上分开，每段第一行是标题、其余行是正文；只有一行时这句就是标题也是正文。贴进来会跳过重复的，条数写在框下。 - 投递方式可选直接打断（默认）或排队，设置页里同样可以切。 - 界面上的每个开关（急速模式、快速批注、自动粘贴、投递方式）在设置页都有对应项。 - 设置存在浏览器本地，同时归档到 Host 侧的 `nudge-store.json`；应用重启或端口变化导致本地存储清空后，设置会自动恢复，旧版本写下的口径结构也会被识别并保留。 ## 状态行文案 标题栏下面那行小字常驻（悬浮窗顶部），空闲时轮换显示提示文案： - 切换开关时的提示会在这行停留 5 秒，之后继续轮换；空闲时每句文案也是停 5 秒再换下一句。 - 文案可以在设置页「状态行文案」里逐句编辑、新增、删除、拖动排序（至少保留一句），最多 20 句，也能一键恢复默认。 - 每条文案同样只占一行、显示成一句话，点行尾铅笔图标才展开输入框，保存或取消生效；顺序靠拖动左侧 ⠿ 手柄调整。 - 新增入口是一个多行框，放在列表上方：整段粘贴进去会立刻按行拆成一句一句（空行、与已有重复的行会跳过），并在框下提示加了几条、跳过了几行；手写时一行一句，`Ctrl+Enter` 提交。 - 文案和上面那些开关一样随设置持久化，同样归档到 Host 侧的 `nudge-store.json`。 窗口可拖动，也能收起成胶囊，位置记在本地；窄屏默认收起。标题栏、批注栏和快捷输入栏都不再有下拉箭头：点各自的标题文字就能折叠或展开对应的内容；标题栏整条都可以点，但栏内的小按钮（设置齿轮）仍只做自己的事。 设置齿轮会按“注册的命令 → 侧栏触发器 → 合成快捷键”的顺序依次尝试打开 DSH 的设置面板，每试一条都等面板真的出现（最多 0.6 秒）才继续，成功后再点到本插件这一节。命令被拒绝时不留副作用，所以排在最前；只有按下这一点仍未打开时才会去点侧栏触发器，而且只点能自证身份的按钮（标签写着设置，或挂着设置快捷键），绝不盲点侧栏里其它弹窗按钮——那样会先闪一个无关的弹层。如果当前壳层没有任何可达的入口（侧边栏入口被账户菜单占用、快捷键服务不可用、命令被模态框挡住），它就直接在悬浮窗里把同一份设置表单渲染出来，齿轮不再点了没反应。再点一次齿轮、点面板右上角的 × 或按 Esc 都能退回原窗口。 ### 设置跳转层（`client.settings-jump.js`） 跳转逻辑不在主 bundle 里，而是同目录的包内 chunk `client.settings-jump.js`：按下齿轮时 `client.js` 用 `require.async('./client.settings-jump.js')` 把它取回来，取到后缓存复用。这是 DSH 加载器支持的形态——chunk 名必须匹配 `client.<名>.js`、与 `client.js` 同目录，host 会把该目录下的同批文件直接 serve 出去；`package.json` 的 `files` 必须带上它，否则 git 安装的副本里没有这个文件。 chunk 导出 `createSettingsJump({ getShortcuts, getSlots, sectionTitle, onDiag, onFallback })`，返回 `{ open, cancel, probe }`。它不读插件自身的 state，也不写插件自己的存储——“跳到哪一节”由 `sectionTitle` 决定，“没有入口时怎么办”由 `onFallback` 决定，采样写到哪里由 `onDiag` 决定。本插件只是其中一份接线：`sectionTitle: () => text('settingsTitle')`、`onFallback` 渲染窗内表单、`onDiag` 落到 `nudge-store.json` 的 `ui.settingsDiag`。 以后要跳别的目标（别的设置节、插件的 Plugins 页），复制这个 chunk 再建一个实例即可：路线表、每路 0.6 秒的回执等待、“面板真的出现才算成功”的判定都不必重写。真要跨插件共用，则把它做成独立的 client 服务包（消费方 `inject` 后 `ctx.get(...)` 调用），代价是多一个包与版本配对。 因为 chunk 只能异步取回，`openSettings()` 返回 `Promise`。文件缺失（旧安装副本）或壳层加载器不支持 chunk 时，齿轮退回窗内表单，不会变成死按钮。 ## 安装 桌面端先退出应用，再按所用的那一端执行： ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:GioStarLC/dsh-nudge # 桌面端 dsh plugin --profile web add github:GioStarLC/dsh-nudge # dsh web ``` 重启或刷新窗口，无需构建。 若启动时报 `dsh: failed to read overlay …\dsh-nudge\cordis.patch.yml: ENOENT`，说明安装副本里缺了包声明的 `dsh.bundle.patch`（插件行就是从这个文件插进去的，缺了它整条 `nudge` 行都不会注册）。把仓库里的 `cordis.patch.yml` 与 `icon.svg` 补进该安装目录再重启即可，不必重新安装。 ## 开发 ```sh npm install npm run hooks:install # 首次克隆后执行，启用 .githooks/pre-commit npm run check npm run preview:all ``` `check` 跑 client 和 host 检查，提交钩子也会调用；`preview:all` 把界面场景渲染到 `preview-out/`。 仓库不含任何安装期钩子（没有 `prepare`、`postinstall`），所以以 git 方式安装的消费方不会触发 pnpm 的构建脚本审批。 ## 更新日志与发布 `CHANGELOG.md` 由 `scripts/changelog.mjs` 从 git 历史生成，是"标签 + 提交"的纯函数：同一段历史跑两次得到同样的字节，因此不需要手工维护，也不会与提交记录脱节。 ```sh npm run changelog # 预览"最近标签..HEAD"这一段，也就是下一个版本会写进去的内容 npm run changelog:all # 预览整份文件 npm run changelog:write # 重新生成 CHANGELOG.md node scripts/changelog.mjs --since-push # 已提交但还没推送的改动 node scripts/changelog.mjs --write --version v0.2.0 # 发版前给下一段贴版本号 node scripts/changelog.mjs --range HEAD~3..HEAD # 任意区间 ``` 提交信息按 Conventional Commits 写，标题会自动归入对应分类： | 前缀 | 分类 | 前缀 | 分类 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `feat(scope):` | 新增 | `test:` | 测试 | | `fix(scope):` | 修复 | `build:` | 构建 | | `perf:` | 性能 | `ci:` | CI | | `refactor:` | 重构 | `revert:` | 回滚 | | `docs:` | 文档 | `chore:` | 维护 | | `style:` | 样式 | 其他写法 | 其他 | 不符合约定的提交（例如 `client.js: 按钮 tooltip`）不会被丢弃，会连同冒号前的部分一起落到"其他"，所以早期历史也照常可读。 提交正文里以 `- ` 开头的行会成为该条的子条目，所以一次提交可以带几句细节，更新日志不必只剩一行标题。 发布一个版本： ```sh # 1. 功能改动按主题分成多次提交，每条提交信息写清分类和范围 git add client.js && git commit -m "feat(client): 批注气泡支持拖动" git add index.js && git commit -m "fix(host): 状态行在重连后丢失" # 2. 升版本号（修复升 patch，新功能升 minor，破坏性改动升 major） # 然后让"未发布"这一段直接以版本号命名 npm run changelog:write -- --version v0.2.0 # 3. 提交、打标签、推送 git add -A && git commit -m "chore(release): v0.2.0" git tag -a v0.2.0 -m "v0.2.0" git push --follow-tags # 4. 校验：此后重新生成应无 diff npm run changelog:write && git status --short CHANGELOG.md ``` 两个不变量让第 4 步成立：发布块按**最新一条真实提交的日期**命名，而不是标签创建时间；`chore(release):`、`changelog(release):` 这类提交被跳过。所以打标签前后生成的是同一份字节，标签里提交的 `CHANGELOG.md` 就是这个版本最终的样子。 `--version` 与已存在的标签重名时会直接报错——已发布的段落只由标签决定，不接受重命名。 工作区里未提交的改动不在任何区间内，脚本会用警告列出它们，避免以为已经记录。 要写给人看的版本说明，放 `scripts/release-notes/.md`，它会整段替换该版本的正文。完整的发版流程（拆提交、写版本说明的判据与反例、校验、对象库异常的处理）见 [docs/RELEASE.md](docs/RELEASE.md)。 ## 许可 MIT

# dsh-analysis-view A resident **Analysis** tab for the DSH Web GUI that turns a session's trajectory into a **runtime incident view** — what happened, and why the harness reacted (or did not). DSH Web GUI 常驻「分析」标签:把一次会话的轨迹组织成 **runtime incident view**—— 系统发生了什么、以及 Harness 为什么这样反应。 0.10.31 起，Web 端可用 `/trajectory` 直接打开当前会话的路径与上下文页；这是客户端动作，不发送分析提示词或调用模型。 0.10.32 合入来源多选与总趋势图层。总趋势默认关闭；共享资源与独立宿主视图同步，保留已做的缓存、可见区域裁剪和折线压缩。 English | [中文](#中文) --- ## English ### What it is A DSH Web GUI plugin providing **Analysis** and **Path** views for the current conversation. ### What the tab shows - **KPI strip** — turns · tool calls · failures · cache hit · events, one number per cell. - **Turn map** — one proportional band per turn (width by duration, colour by that turn's failure count); a turn with failures jumps to the Trajectory tab (`openView("trajectory", callId)`). The legend is printed; no unlabeled colours. - **Spend** — per turn, two bars: the reused prefix (cache hit) beside what was actually processed fresh (miss), with output on its own bar; each turn's hit rate sits on the right and turns amber below 90%. The list scrolls and starts at the newest turn. When every request came from the official DeepSeek API (`deepseek-flash` / `deepseek-v4-pro`), the right side of the summary shows the official unit prices for miss / hit / output plus a total, with the peak/off-peak schedule already applied; anything else shows no price at all. - **Tools** — three rings show categories, tools and calls per turn. Selecting a category or tool updates the related rings. - **Incident cards** — only *evidence-backed* incidents. Each card is a causal chain: `Cause / Runtime knew / Model received / Harness response / Impact`, with evidence `seq` chips that jump to the Trajectory tab. - **Interpretation** — click to request an explanation from the current default model. It consumes tokens and includes evidence citations. It is not run until requested. The Analysis tab appears next to Conversation and Trajectory. ### Install (permanent, not a dynamic plugin) Dynamic plugins are session-scoped and vanish on reload; this one is installed into the web profile. ```text 1. pnpm pack # -> dsh-analysis-view-0.10.31.tgz 2. add to ~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json: dependencies: "dsh-analysis-view": "file:/dsh-analysis-view-0.10.31.tgz" dsh.profile.bundles: append "dsh-analysis-view" 3. pnpm install # in ~/.dsh/profiles/web 4. rebuild / restart `dsh web` # so the new client module enters the bundle ``` ### Path view Open the **Path** tab to browse the session overview and individual turns. Context composition, file history, tool results, subagent branches and Skill records are available from the page. Tool parameters and results open in the detail drawer. The page appears in stages: the real trunk appears first, followed by details and other layers. Selecting a turn gives its details priority. Viewport, zoom and selection remain while data arrives. When older context data is outside the current range, use **Load earlier increments**. The standalone `GET /analysis-view/trace?session=` URL returns a self-contained snapshot. ### Verify - Refresh the GUI → the **分析** tab renders the work path for the current session. - If it is blank, check the browser console for the first error. - Panel render: `node plugin/analysis-view/self-test.mjs` (must print `ALL PASS (21 checks)`); it executes the real component tree against a React shim, so no browser is needed. - Analyzer semantics: `node analyzers/self-test.mjs` (must print `ALL PASS`). - Shape contract: `node analyzers/shape-law.mjs` and `node analyzers/shape-law.mjs --mutate` (both must print `ALL PASS`; the second one prints `CAUGHT` per mutation). ### Limitations - Missing official statistics or context data is shown as unavailable; other available content remains accessible. - Earlier context may require an explicit history load. - Model interpretation is optional and consumes tokens. - Price display is limited to the supported official API models. --- ## 中文 ### 这是什么 为 DSH Web GUI 的当前会话提供「分析」和「路径」视图的插件。 ### 面板内容 - **KPI 条**:轮次 · 工具调用 · 失败 · 缓存命中 · 事件,一个数字一格。 - **轮次地图**:一条按时长分宽的比例带(颜色按该轮失败数);有失败的轮次点击切到「轨迹」 (`openView("trajectory", callId)`);图例直接写在界面上。 - **花费**:每轮两条——命中(复用的前缀)与未命中(真正新处理)并排画,输出单独一条;右侧是这一轮的 命中率,低于 90% 标警示色;列表可滚动,默认停在最新。走官方 API(deepseek-flash / deepseek-v4-pro)时,右边按官方价目给未命中 / 命中 / 输出的单价与总价,峰谷已计入;不是官方 API 就不显示价格。 - **工具**:三个环并排——类别 → 该类工具 → 这个工具用在哪些轮;三张默认都在(取最大类别与它的第一名工具), 点类别或工具只切换后两张;类别色不用红,红只留给错误。 - **Incident 卡片**:只列**有证据**的 incident,每张是一条因果链 `Cause / Runtime 知道 / Model 收到 / Harness 反应 / 影响`,并带证据 `seq` 徽章。 - **解读**：点击后由当前默认模型解释，消耗 token，并附证据引用。默认不调用；输出达到上限时显示「已截断」。 「分析」与「对话」「轨迹」位于同一排标签。 ### 安装(常驻,非动态插件) 动态插件是会话级、刷新即失;这个是装进 web profile 的常驻插件。 ```text 1. pnpm pack # 生成 dsh-analysis-view-0.10.31.tgz 2. 在 ~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json 中: dependencies 增加 "dsh-analysis-view": "file:<绝对路径>/dsh-analysis-view-0.10.31.tgz" dsh.profile.bundles 追加 "dsh-analysis-view" 3. 在 ~/.dsh/profiles/web 下执行 pnpm install 4. 重建/重启 `dsh web`,让新的 client 模块进入前端包 ``` ### 路径页 打开「路径」标签，可浏览全景与逐轮行动路径，并查看上下文构成、文件历史、工具结果、 子代理和 Skill 记录。点击工具即可在详情中查看参数和结果。 页面分阶段显示：先出现真实主干，再补齐正文和其他图层；选中某轮会优先加载其详情。 补齐数据时保留位置、缩放和选中项。更早的上下文超出当前范围时，可点击「回补更早增量」。 `GET /analysis-view/trace?session=` 可单独打开自包含快照。 ### 验证 - 刷新 GUI → 「分析」标签按当前会话渲染工作路径。 - 若空白:看浏览器控制台第一条报错。 - 面板渲染:`node plugin/analysis-view/self-test.mjs`(必须输出 `ALL PASS (21 checks)`); 它用一个 React 垫片真的执行组件树,不需要开浏览器。 - 路径加载与资源边界:`node plugin/analysis-view/stages-test.mjs`、`node plugin/analysis-view/resources-test.mjs` 与 `node plugin/analysis-view/perf-test.mjs`。 - 分析器语义:`node analyzers/self-test.mjs`(必须输出 `ALL PASS`)。 - 形状契约:`node analyzers/shape-law.mjs` 与 `node analyzers/shape-law.mjs --mutate` (都要 `ALL PASS`;后者对每种变异打印 `CAUGHT`)。 ### 局限 - 官方统计或上下文数据缺失时会明确显示不可用，已有内容仍可查看。 - 更早的上下文可能需要手动回补。 - 模型解读为可选功能，会消耗 token。 - 费用显示仅适用于已支持的官方 API 模型。 开发文档：[分析面板与路径页](https://github.com/goatliamia/trajectory-tree/blob/main/docs/analysis-view-design.md)。

# dsh-conversation-search 右侧栏的「对话搜索」:在当前会话里按关键词找**聊过的内容**,点结果跳到对话里对应的那一轮。 会话很长时,往上翻找一句话很费劲。这个插件把检索放在右侧栏(工作区文件 / 终端 同一排), 结果是"第几轮、你问了什么、命中的那句话",不是一堆日志条目。 ## 用 1. 右侧栏的 `+`(或引导页)里选「对话搜索」; 2. 输入关键词,停顿即搜索(大小写不敏感,直接匹配原文); 3. 结果按轮次分组:轮次、这一轮的问法、命中的句子(关键词高亮);同一轮最多列 3 句; 4. 默认只搜你和助手说过的话;要连工具调用/结果一起搜,勾「也搜工具」; 5. 点一条,滚到「对话」里对应的那一轮并短暂描边。 跳转复用对话自己的锚点:先按 `seq` 把历史页加载出来,再找带 `data-chat-turn` 的那一行滚到 视口中间。**当前主区不是「对话」时找不到目标行**,会提示切过去再点一次——对话视图的选择 没有公开的写入口,这一版不替用户切。 ## 返回 `GET /conversation-search/search?session=&q=<词>&scope=chat|all&limit=` ```text { ok, session, log: { id, events }, query, scope, totalMatches, matchedTurns, returnedTurns, truncated, turns: [{ turn, prompt, promptSeq, count, matches: [{ seq, type, role, time, text, matchAt }] }] } ``` `matchedTurns` 是命中的轮数,`returnedTurns` 是这次返回的轮数(默认 10,上限 30); `prompt` 是这一轮你说的第一句话(截到 120 字),`count` 是这一轮的命中处数, `matches` 最多 3 条,`matchAt` 是命中词在片段里的偏移。 ## 安装 ```text pnpm pack # -> dsh-conversation-search-0.2.1.tgz # ~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json: dependencies 增加 # "dsh-conversation-search": "file:<绝对路径>/dsh-conversation-search-0.2.1.tgz" # dsh.profile.bundles 追加 "dsh-conversation-search" pnpm install # 在 ~/.dsh/profiles/web # 重启 dsh web ``` ## 验证 ```text node plugin/conversation-search/self-test.mjs # 22 项:轮次 / scope / prompt / 片段 / 路由 ```
