evidence.readmeExcerpt: # dsh-remote-automation [English](README.en.md) | 简体中文 [![CI](https://github.com/knight8818/dsh-remote-automation/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/knight8818/dsh-remote-automation/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20-brightgreen.svg)](package.json) **在 DeepSeek Harness 里把定时任务放到远程云服务器上跑：阿里云 ECS、腾讯云 CVM、AWS EC2。** 给 DSH 增加一个侧栏「**云端任务**」页面和一组工具。脚本通过云厂商的零入站命令通道（阿里云 Cloud Assistant / 腾讯云 TAT / AWS SSM）在你自己的实例上执行：**不需要任何入站端口**，安全组可以一直关着，本机关机也不影响任务。 > 已支持阿里云 ECS、腾讯云 CVM、AWS EC2（SSM）。云厂商通过 `lib/providers.js` + `lib/clients.js` 抽象，Azure / GCP 可以按同一接口继续加。 ## 特性 - **独立页面**：侧栏「自动化任务」下方新增「云端任务」，可切换云厂商、查看实时状态、立即运行、看日志、删除。 - **每个任务记住自己的云厂商**：之后切换默认厂商或脚本目录，老任务仍按原来的位置运行、查询、删除。 - **每次都先问**：通过 `automation_create` 创建任务时会先问「云端服务器」还是「本地 DSH 提醒」，没有默认值。 - **真实状态**：运行中 / 空闲 / 成功 / 失败、上次退出码、最近日志时间；打开即刷新，页面可见时轮询。 - **零入站**：只走出站 HTTPS（`ecs..aliyuncs.com`、`tat.tencentcloudapi.com` 或 `ssm..amazonaws.com`），不需要 SSH 或开放端口。 - **密钥不出本机**：仓库里没有任何凭证；页面只拿到打码后的 AccessKey ID / SecretId，密钥永不回传。 - **对 Agent 友好**：仓库自带 [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md)，DeepSeek 读完就知道怎么安装、验证、升级和卸载。 ## 环境要求 | 要求 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | DeepSeek Harness | `>= 0.2.0`（需要 bundle layer + 客户端插件支持） | | Node.js | `>= 20`（宿主使用 Node 标准库 + 腾讯云 / AWS 官方 SDK） | | 云服务器 | 阿里云 ECS（云助手在线）、腾讯云 CVM（TAT 在线）或 AWS EC2（SSM Agent 在线） | | 网络 | 实例能出站访问 `ecs..aliyuncs.com:443`、`tat.tencentcloudapi.com:443` 或 `ssm..amazonaws.com:443` | | Git | 仅「从 GitHub 直接安装」时需要 | 插件需要 **Web profile**（桌面版或 `dsh web`）：它要在 `webServer` 服务上注册侧栏页面和 HTTP 路由。headless / SDK profile 没有这个服务，插件不会加载。 ## 安装 ### 1. 让你的 DeepSeek 安装（推荐） 把下面这段和仓库链接一起发给 DSH 里的 Agent： ```text 请安装这个 DSH 插件：https://github.com/knight8818/dsh-remote-automation 按仓库里的 AGENTS.md 操作：装到我的 desktop profile，验证 YAML layer 和 node --check，不要打印 ~/.dsh/remote-automation 下的任何文件，不要重启 DSH， 装完告诉我什么时候需要完全退出再启动。 ``` Agent 会读 [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md)，里面有确切的 `dsh plugin` 命令、手动兜底、验证步骤和安全规则。 ### 2. 一条命令 先装一次 `dsh` CLI，或者用 `npx` 一次性执行： ```bash npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:knight8818/dsh-remote-automation ``` 桌面版 profile 一般叫 `desktop`，`dsh web` 用 `web`；如果你的 profile 名字不同就换成实际名字。profile 不存在时 `dsh plugin` 会自动初始化。 不想全局安装： ```bash npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest plugin --profile desktop add github:knight8818/dsh-remote-automation ``` 因为包里声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，这条命令会把包加进 profile，并自动把 bundle layer 追加到 `dsh.profile.bundles`。不用手改 YAML，也不用复制文件。 不启动、只验证 layer： ```bash dsh --profile desktop --dump-config | grep dsh-remote-automation ``` ### 3. 手动兜底（离线 / 没有 pnpm） ```bash git clone https://github.com/knight8818/dsh-remote-automation # 目标已存在就停下，不要在它里面再套一层 test -e ~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/dsh-remote-automation \ && echo "already installed: remove or back it up first" \ || cp -r dsh-remote-automation ~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/dsh-remote-automation ``` Windows PowerShell： ```powershell git clone https://github.com/knight8818/dsh-remote-automation $dst = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\node_modules\dsh-remote-automation" if (Test-Path $dst) { throw "already installed: $dst" } Copy-Item -Recurse .\dsh-remote-automation $dst ``` 然后在 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加（仅当文件里还没有 `id: remote-automation` 时）： ```yaml - insert: - id: remote-automation name: dsh-remote-automation ``` Windows 下路径是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\node_modules\` 和 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml`。 无论用哪种方式，装完都要**完全退出 DSH**（托盘图标也要退出，不是只关窗口）再启动。只刷新页面不够，宿主插件需要重启才会挂载。 ### 从手动安装的 `0.1.x` 升级 先删掉旧副本（`~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/dsh-remote-automation`）和 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里那段三行 `- insert:`，再用上面的一条命令安装。两套都留着会让 `id: remote-automation` 注册两次。 ## 配置 打开侧栏「云端任务」，在顶部下拉框选择 **阿里云 ECS** 或 **腾讯云 CVM**，点「编辑」填写，保存后该厂商即成为当前默认厂商。 **阿里云 ECS** | 字段 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | AccessKey ID / Secret | RAM 子账号，建议只授下面的最小权限 | | 地域 | 例如 `cn-shenzhen` | | 实例 ID | 例如 `i-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx` | **腾讯云 CVM** | 字段 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | SecretId / SecretKey | CAM 子用户，建议只授下面的最小权限 | | 地域 | 例如 `ap-guangzhou` | | 实例 ID | 例如 `ins-xxxxxxxx` 或 `lhins-xxxxxxxx`（Lighthouse） | **AWS EC2 (SSM)** | 字段 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | Access Key ID / Secret Access Key | IAM 用户，建议只授下面的最小权限 | | Session Token | 可选，仅临时凭证需要 | | 地域 | 例如 `us-east-1` | | 实例 ID | 例如 `i-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx` | 「脚本目录」三家共用，默认 `/opt/automation`。已保存的密钥不会回传页面，输入框显示占位符并保持为空；留空保存就沿用旧值。 环境变量优先于配置文件： | 厂商 | 环境变量 | | --- | --- | | 公共 | `DSH_RA_PROVIDER`（`aliyun` / `tencent` / `aws`）、`DSH_RA_SERVER_DIR` | | 阿里云 | `DSH_RA_AK_ID`、`DSH_RA_AK_SECRET`、`DSH_RA_REGION`、`DSH_RA_INSTANCE_ID`（也接受 `ALIYUN_*`） | | 腾讯云 | `DSH_RA_TC_SECRET_ID`、`DSH_RA_TC_SECRET_KEY`、`DSH_RA_TC_REGION`、`DSH_RA_TC_INSTANCE_ID`（也接受 `TENCENTCLOUD_*`） | | AWS | `DSH_RA_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`、`DSH_RA_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`、`DSH_RA_AWS_SESSION_TOKEN`、`DSH_RA_AWS_REGION`、`DSH_RA_AWS_INSTANCE_ID`（也接受 `AWS_*`） | 配置文件位于 `$DSH_HOME/remote-automation/config.json`（默认 `~/.dsh/remote-automation/config.json`），以 `0600` 权限写入。0.2.x 的扁平配置会自动按「阿里云」读取，首次保存后升级为 `providers` 结构，不需要手动迁移。 ### 阿里云 RAM 最小权限 新建自定义策略，只勾下面这些动作，授权给该 RAM 用户： ```json { "Version": "1", "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": [ "ecs:RunCommand", "ecs:DescribeInvocationResults", "ecs:DescribeCloudAssistantStatus", "ecs:DescribeInstances", "ecs:InstallCloudAssistant", "ecs:SendFile", "ecs:DescribeSendFileResults" ], "Resource": "*" } ] } ``` `ecs:SendFile` / `ecs:DescribeSendFileResults` 用于把脚本/小制品直接下发到实例；没有这两个权限时会自动退回 RunCommand 内联/分块，不影响大文件部署。它不能删实例、改安全组、动磁盘或网络。 ### 腾讯云 CAM 最小权限 新建自定义策略（按策略语法创建），只允许 TAT 的三个动作，授权给该 CAM 子用户： ```json { "version": "2.0", "statement": [ { "effect": "allow", "action": [ "tat:RunCommand", "tat:DescribeInvocationTasks", "tat:DescribeAutomationAgentStatus" ], "resource": ["*"] } ] } ``` 它同样不能删实例、改安全组、动磁盘或网络。 ### AWS IAM 最小权限 新建自定义策略（JSON），只允许 SSM 的三个动作，附加给该 IAM 用户： ```json { "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": [ "ssm:SendCommand", "ssm:GetCommandInvocation", "ssm:DescribeInstanceInformation" ], "Resource": "*" } ] } ``` 它同样不能删实例、改安全组、动磁盘或网络。 ## 使用 在对话里说： ```text 每天 9 点，在云端服务器上跑我的 daily-report 脚本。 ``` `automation_create` 会先问「云端」还是「本地」。选云端 → 在页面当前选中的云厂商上生成脚本 + 可选 cron；选本地 → 转去创建 `schedule_*` 提醒。 工具： | 工具 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `automation_create` | 创建自动化任务的唯一入口，先问云端/本地，使用当前选中的云厂商；支持 `command` 内联或 `sourcePath` 制品 | | `cloud_task_list` | 列出所有厂商的任务和实时状态（每个厂商一次查询） | | `cloud_task_run` | 立即触发（自动使用任务所属厂商） | | `cloud_task_logs` | 查看日志尾部 | | `cloud_task_delete` | 删除脚本、cron 和日志 | ### 部署方式：内联 vs 制品 `automation_create` 支持两种方式： | 方式 | 参数 | 适合 | | --- | --- | --- | | 内联 | `command` | 单条命令/小脚本，≤ 12 KB | | 制品 | `sourcePath` + `entry` | 整个目录、多文件项目 | 制品流程： 1. 本地把文件/目录打成 `tar.gz`，计算 `sha256`； 2. **阿里云且制品 ≤ 24 KB**：用 `SendFile` 原生下发（需 `ecs:SendFile`）；没有权限或超过 24 KB 时自动退回分块； 3. 分块上传：阿里云 8 KB/块、腾讯云 28 KB/块、AWS 48 KB/块，4 路并发，最后 `sha256` 校验、解压到 `<脚本目录>/tasks/<任务id>/`； 4. 任务脚本 `cd` 到该目录执行 `entry`； 5. cron 之后只跑本地已解压文件，**不再需要网络下载**。 ```text 把本地 C:\work\etl 部署成每天 2 点的云端任务，入口 bash run.sh ``` Agent 会调用 `automation_create({ name, sourcePath, entry, schedule })`。 限制：制品硬上限 20 MB；超过 2 MB 建议改用 OSS/COS/S3。整个方案**不需要新账号、不需要 Tailscale、不需要对象存储**，只走你已有的云助手通道；阿里云 `SendFile` 是可选的加速项。 ### 状态是怎么判断的 每次查询都会在目标实例上执行一段只读脚本，返回： | 字段 | 含义 | | --- | --- | | `running` | 脚本启动时写入的 pid 是否还活着（`kill -0`） | | 上次退出码 | 日志里最后一条 `EXIT `（脚本结束时写入） | | 最近日志时间 | 日志文件的 mtime | 所以「运行中」表示进程还在；「成功 / 失败」表示最近一次运行已经结束。如果脚本被 `kill -9`、机器重启或进程在写 `EXIT` 前消失，状态可能停留在上一次结果，需要结合日志时间判断。插件只监控自己创建的任务；要检查任意脚本，可以让 Agent 在服务器上跑 `ps` / `crontab -l`。 ## 安全模型 - **仓库和 git 历史里没有密钥**；配置来自环境变量或运行时写入的本机文件。 - 本机 HTTP 接口（`/dsh-remote-automation/*`）要求每个进程随机生成、仅注入已登录页面的令牌，比较使用常量时间算法。 - 页面只拿到打码的 AccessKey ID / SecretId；Secret 不回传、不写日志、不渲染。 - 命令通过云厂商的零入站通道（Cloud Assistant / TAT）下发，实例上没有新增监听端口。 - 腾讯云通道使用官方 `tencentcloud-sdk-nodejs-tat` SDK，AWS 通道使用官方 `@aws-sdk/client-ssm`；阿里云通道仍是纯标准库 HMAC-SHA1 实现。 - 制品分块只包含已打包的 tar.gz 数据，路径和任务 id 都经过校验；部署完会删除服务器上的临时压缩包。 - `state.json` 会保存你要求执行的命令，请当作 shell history 对待；写入权限 `0600`。 - 插件不上报任何遥测。 发现安全问题请看 [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md)。 ## 常见问题 | 现象 | 处理 | | --- | --- | | `dsh: command not found` | 改用 `npx` 形式，或 `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh` | | 侧栏没有「云端任务」 | 完全退出 DSH（含托盘进程）再启动 | | 提示「插件尚未配置」 | 在页面填写，或设置 `DSH_RA_*` 环境变量 | | `Forbidden.RAM` | 给 RAM 用户挂上面的最小权限策略 | | `AuthFailure` / `UnauthorizedOperation` | 给 CAM 子用户挂上面的 TAT 最小权限策略 | | AWS `AccessDenied` | 给 IAM 用户挂上面的 SSM 最小权限策略 | | 云助手离线 | 在实例上启动/安装云助手 agent | | TAT 自动化助手离线 | 在 CVM 上安装并启动 `tat_agent`（公共镜像默认有） | | SSM Agent 离线 | 在 EC2 上安装并启动 `amazon-ssm-agent`，并确认实例角色允许 SSM | | `ClientNeedUpgrade` | 云助手/TAT Agent 版本太旧；升级后会自动使用 SendFile/文件下发，否则退回内联 | | 制品上传很慢 | 压缩后仍大于 2 MB 时建议改用 OSS/COS/S3；分块是给中小项目用的 | | `id: remote-automation` 出现两次 | 同时用了 bundle 和手动 patch，删掉其中一个 | | 刚点「运行」日志是空的 | 进程刚启动，过几秒刷新 | ## 卸载 ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-remote-automation ``` 手动安装的话，删除 `~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/dsh-remote-automation`，并从 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里移除那段三行 `- insert:`。`~/.dsh/remote-automation/` 里的凭证会保留；要彻底清除请自行删除该目录。 ## 开发 ```bash npm install # 测试依赖 yaml + 腾讯云/AWS SDK + tar npm run check # 对所有运行时文件执行 node --check npm test # node:test ``` 目录： ``` lib/host.js 宿主插件：工具 + HTTP 路由 + 页面令牌 lib/client.js 浏览器插件：侧栏页面（预构建，lazy-CJS 模块格式） lib/providers.js 云厂商元数据、字段校验、脱敏 lib/clients.js 云厂商客户端工厂 lib/aliyun.js 阿里云 ECS 云助手 RPC 客户端（HMAC-SHA1，零 SDK） lib/tencent.js 腾讯云 TAT 客户端（官方 SDK，RunCommand 轮询） lib/aws.js AWS SSM 客户端（官方 SDK，SendCommand 轮询） lib/artifact.js 制品打包（tar.gz）、sha256、分块 lib/tasks.js 任务模型 + 制品上传/解压 + 远端脚本/cron/日志/状态操作 lib/config.js 配置读取、v1→v2 迁移与打码 lib/validate.js 配置、任务、HTTP 共用的输入校验 cordis.patch.yml bundle layer（插入插件行） ``` `lib/client.js` 是手写产物，格式为 DSH 客户端模块的 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load`，不是构建输出。阿里云通道不依赖任何第三方运行时库；腾讯云 / AWS 通道使用官方 SDK，由 `dsh plugin add` / pnpm 自动安装。 ## License [MIT](LICENSE)

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-session-git

A Git tab inside every DSH conversation.

Each conversation gets its own **Git** tab next to `Chat | Trajectory`, and that tab
opens the repository belonging to *that* session — its working directory, not some
global one. Two sessions on two different projects show two different histories, and
neither remembers what the other picked.

![History view with branch lanes](assets/screenshot-history.png)

## What it does

- **Bound to the session.** The tab is registered on the `conversation.view` slot, so it
  receives the current `sessionId` as a prop. Every request carries `?session=<id>`;
  the host resolves that session's working directory, then runs
  `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` on it. Sessions with no repository, empty
  repositories, and repositories nested under the working directory all have their own
  empty state instead of falling back to a shared panel.
- **Per-session memory.** The repository you pick is stored under
  `dsh-git-panel:repo:<sessionId>`, so one conversation switching projects does not
  change what another conversation is looking at.
- **Branch lanes.** Lanes are assigned incrementally from real parent relationships
  (newest to oldest): a parent already sitting in a column reuses that column, otherwise
  the first free column is taken, and trailing empty columns are trimmed. Linear history
  therefore stays one column wide. Merge commits draw bezier curves across columns, and
  colors come from a fixed palette indexed by column, so a refresh never reshuffles them.
- **Commit detail.** Author, time, short SHA (click to copy), `+adds −dels` totals, file
  list with per-file counts, commit body. Actions: detach checkout, create a branch or a
  tag at that commit, revert, cherry-pick.
- **Diffs.** Line-by-line coloring for added/removed lines and hunk headers, fetched per
  file on demand, truncated at 2 MB.
- **Working tree.** Staged/unstaged/untracked counts, per-file stage / unstage / discard,
  commit with an optional `add -A`, amend the previous commit, `git stash` everything.
- **Refs.** Local and remote branches, tags and stashes in one page. Two-line entries
  (name plus latest commit). Switch, merge, create and delete branches; create and delete
  tags; pop stashes.

![Commit detail with file list and diff](assets/screenshot-commit.png)

## Install

`dsh plugin` forwards its arguments to pnpm inside the profile directory, so install from
this repository:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:koi128bit/dsh-session-git
```

Or from a local checkout:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/koi128bit/dsh-session-git
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-session-git
```

There is also a prebuilt tarball attached to
[Releases](https://github.com/koi128bit/dsh-session-git/releases/latest/download/dsh-session-git.tgz),
which skips the build step:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/koi128bit/dsh-session-git/releases/latest/download/dsh-session-git.tgz
```

Reload the web UI and open any conversation: a **Git** tab appears in the conversation
header. Only real conversations get it — a brand-new empty session does not render the
view area at all, so the tab shows up once the conversation has its first message.

The desktop client manages its own profile; use that client's plugin manager instead of
the CLI for it.

## Files

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host side: mounts `/git-panel/api`, runs `git` through `ctx.subprocess` with argv arrays (never a shell), resolves the repository from the `session` parameter |
| `client.js` | Client side: registers `conversation.view` (id `git`), plain React plus same-origin `fetch` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch: one `insert` of `git-panel` |
| `locale/*.json` | Title and description shown by plugin storefronts (en / zh) |
| `screenshots.json` | Screenshots used by storefronts |
| `icon.svg`, `assets/icon-*.png` | Plugin icon |
| `assets/screenshot-*.png` | Screenshots shown above |

## API

Same-origin only, with a `sec-fetch-site` check, returning `{ ok, ... }`. Every route
except `/fs` and `/repos` accepts `session=<sessionId>`; the browser attaches it
automatically.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/git-panel/api` | Capability probe: `sessionCwd`, `defaultRepo`, `autoRepos`, `autoSource`, home, allow-list, write flag |
| GET | `/git-panel/api/status` | Branch, upstream, ahead/behind, HEAD, working-tree counts, remotes |
| GET | `/git-panel/api/log` | `limit` `skip` `all` `grep` `author` `since` `path` |
| GET | `/git-panel/api/branches` | Branches and tags in one `for-each-ref` |
| GET | `/git-panel/api/commit` | One commit plus its `--numstat` file table |
| GET | `/git-panel/api/diff` | `mode=commit\|working\|staged` plus `path` |
| GET | `/git-panel/api/working` | Working-tree changes |
| GET | `/git-panel/api/fs` | Directory browser, flags repositories |
| GET | `/git-panel/api/repos` | Recursively find repositories |
| GET | `/git-panel/api/stashes` | Stash list |
| POST | `/git-panel/api/action` | `checkout` `checkout-detach` `create-branch` `delete-branch` `create-tag` `delete-tag` `merge` `merge-abort` `revert` `cherry-pick` `stash` `stash-pop` `stage` `unstage` `discard` `commit` |

`push`, `pull` and `fetch` are deliberately not exposed: they need credentials and
network interaction, and their failures cannot be closed out inside the panel.

### How the repository is resolved

Each request walks this list and takes the first candidate that
`git rev-parse --show-toplevel` accepts:

1. an explicit `?repo=` parameter (something picked in the panel)
2. the plugin's `repoRoot` config
3. automatic detection from the session working directory (below)
4. the host's `workingDirectory.defaultDirectory`
5. `process.cwd()`

### Automatic detection

`GET /git-panel/api?session=<id>` reports the session's working directory and every
repository found in it:

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `sessionCwd` | The session's working directory |
| `autoRepos` | Repositories found there, de-duplicated and ordered |
| `autoSource` | `session-root` (the working directory is a repository), `session-child` (found below it), `config`, or `default` |

Detection takes two steps:

1. Run `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` on the session working directory — conversations
   often start inside a subdirectory of a repository (`<repo>/src`), and this resolves
   straight to the root.
2. Otherwise walk two levels down, keeping a directory as soon as it contains `.git` and
   not descending further. `node_modules`, `target`, `dist`, `build`, `.cache` and
   `Library` are skipped; at most 40 repositories are collected.

Results are ordered by depth (closest first), then by `.git` modification time
(most recent first), then by path. In a container directory holding a dozen projects,
alphabetical order would always land on the same unrelated repository; modification time
is closer to "what was touched last" and stays stable within the same second. Scans are
cached per root and depth for 8 seconds.

The top-bar dropdown only appears when more than one repository is found. Press
**Rescan** after `git init` to see a new one immediately.

## Configuration

The `config` block of the `insert` entry in `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: git-panel
      name: dsh-session-git
      config:
        repoRoot: ''            # fixed repository; empty means follow the session
        allowedRoots: []        # allow-list of roots; empty means unrestricted
        maxCommits: 400         # commit list page size
        allowWrite: true        # false turns the panel into a read-only browser
```

## Implementation notes

- **No shell.** `subprocess.spawn({ argv })` executes directly, so paths containing
  spaces or `$` are safe. When `ctx.subprocess` is unavailable it falls back to
  `node:child_process.execFile`.
- **Optional services only.** `apply()` hard-depends on `webServer` alone; `subprocess`,
  `workingDirectory`, `sessions` and `sessionController` are read through a try/catch
  helper, so the plugin loads in any profile and degrades instead of failing.
- **The view computes its own height.** The conversation view area is `flex: 1 0 auto`,
  so it grows to fit its content — a long commit list would push the page to a few
  thousand pixels and slide under the composer. The panel measures the viewport minus the
  composer seat with a `ResizeObserver` and scrolls internally.
- **Merge diffs.** Git prints no patch for a merge commit by default, which renders as
  "no changes". Both the file list and the diff pass `-m --first-parent`, so a merge is
  shown against its first parent.
- **Ref classification.** After `--decorate=full`, local branches are `refs/heads/x` and
  remote ones `refs/remotes/o/x`. Testing for a slash misfiles `feature/x` as a remote.
- **Empty repositories.** `git log` exits non-zero when there are no commits; the host
  recognises that case and returns an empty list. Non-repositories and permission errors
  are also empty states, not red text.
- **Renames.** With `--porcelain=v1 -z`, `R` and `C` entries carry a second NUL-separated
  path; consuming only one shifts every later path.
- **Lane width cap.** With every ref shown, a repository can have dozens of live columns —
  34 columns took 449 px and squeezed the subject to 15 px. `LANE_MAX = 12` clamps the
  geometry, trading a little visual accuracy for a readable subject column.
- **Theme tokens.** All colors are `var(--dsw-alias-*)`, so the panel follows the host's
  light and dark themes.

![Working tree with commit box and per-file actions](assets/screenshot-working.png)

## Known limits

- Empty conversations do not render the view area, so the tab appears after the first
  message.
- `push` / `pull` / `fetch` are out of scope (see above).
- Diffs over 2 MB are truncated; the commit list page is bounded by `maxCommits`.
- A merge commit's diff is always shown relative to its first parent.

![Branches, tags and stashes](assets/screenshot-branches.png)

## 中文说明

在每个 DSH 会话里直接查看、直接操作这个会话工作目录的 Git 仓库。对话头部会多一个
**Git** 页签，不同会话各管各的仓库，互不串。

- 会话绑定：注册在 `conversation.view` 插槽，请求统一带 `?session=<id>`
- 每会话独立记忆选中仓库
- 分支泳道图、提交详情、逐行着色 diff、工作区暂存/提交、引用与 stash 管理
- `push` / `pull` / `fetch` 不在面板内执行，留给终端

## License

# dsh-cad — CAD Plugin for DeepSeek Harness

![dsh-cad banner](docs/img/banner.svg)

[![homepage](https://img.shields.io/badge/homepage-dsh--cad-4D6BFE)](https://lau-mars.github.io/dsh-cad/)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-cad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad)
[![downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-cad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@deepseek-ai%2Fdsh?label=dsh)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D%2022-4D6BFE)](https://nodejs.org/)
[![occt](https://img.shields.io/badge/occt-7.9.3-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/LAU-MARS/opencascade-ts)
[![occt.ts](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/occt.ts?label=occt.ts)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/occt.ts)
[![ansatz](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/ansatz-wasm?label=ansatz)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ansatz-wasm)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-4D6BFE)](./LICENSE)

English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

A CAD plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness):
an **embedded 3D/2D CAD viewer** plus a **native parametric modeling tool family**
(OCCT kernel) in the Web UI, letting the agent build and inspect CAD geometry
step by step — "model while you watch".

## Preview

A full modeling session, end to end: the agent builds a parametric assembly
from plain chat — a 120×80×8 base plate with R5 rounded corners, then four
bolt instances placed at the corners — while the resident CAD panel tracks
every step live (parts tree with per-instance colors, ViewCube, "装配体"
assembly tab, 5 instances · 1,740 triangles). The finished assembly exports
as a structured STEP document and the agent verifies it by reading the file
back — 2 solids, 3 products, 2 assembly usages, 1,125.00 mm³:

![dsh-cad assembly session](docs/img/assembly-preview.png)

## Downloads

Cumulative downloads from the npm registry, refreshed daily by CI:

![npm cumulative downloads](docs/img/downloads-cumulative.svg)

## Feature Overview

| Capability | Description |
| --- | --- |
| ⚙️ Kernel chain: cadorange → occt.ts | Modeling goes through **[cadorange](https://github.com/LAU-MARS/cadorange)** (the agent-native CAD runtime wrapping the occt.ts/OCCT WASM; public API + the supported `cadorange/occt` escape hatch for meshing/HLR/wire construction); the direct occt.ts adapter stays as the fallback tier — `DSH_CAD_KERNEL` pins one explicitly (the opencascade.js tier was removed in v0.15.1, −64MB install). The old "no editing after shell" seam is gone — fillet/chamfer/boolean keep working after shelling |
| 🔍 CAD viewing | STL / OBJ / STEP / IGES / BREP / DCPRT (3D), DXF / SVG (2D); interactive viewport in the resident right panel (orbit / zoom / wireframe / pan), with a one-line result row in the conversation |
| 🌗 Dark-mode surfaces | Every rendered surface follows the host theme — viewport slab, DXF/drawing strokes, the Three.js grid / XYZ triad / feature edges / default mesh color / sketch overlays, and the ViewCube plate; a theme flip restyles mounted viewers live. Overrides: `--dsh-cad-bg`, `--dsh-cad-stroke`, `--dsh-cad-paper` |
| 🧭 CAD editor interactions | Onshape-style ViewCube (26-zone click-to-orient), hover/click face & edge picking with live measurement (area mm² / length mm), Faces+Edges / Faces / Wireframe render modes, switchable BRep demo parts (bracket / flange / shaft) |
| 🏗️ Parametric modeling | Primitives, profile extrusion, **loft**, **sweep**, **revolve**, booleans, all-edge fillet/chamfer, **shell**, **draft**, **patterns** (linear/circular), transforms; profiles take **curve segments** (arcs/circles exact BRep; B-splines sampled approximation) — exact OCCT BRep, not a mesh approximation. `cad_loft` sections accept **curves** too: point loops, `{through}` splines or planar `{profile}` chains; `smooth: true` fits a **periodic B-spline** through point loops — one continuous B-spline lateral face instead of planar strips meeting at G0 creases |
| ✏️ Named sketches | Standalone named profiles (Sketch1…) kept in the document (`cad_sketch_new` / `edit` / `list` / `delete`); extrude/revolve/sweep reference them **by name**, and `cad_sketch_edit` rewrites the definition in place + replays the log, rebuilding every dependent feature — the parametric loop. Sketches render as Onshape-style **blue curves + plane frame** in the viewport (refreshing live on edit), listed in a left-side **feature tree** (sketches + features, eye-toggle visibility, click-to-highlight bodies) over the Part tab |
| 🗂️ Codex-style document tabs | The resident display panel gets a tab strip with a "+" menu: **Part** (Part Studio, the default) / **Assembly** (instance insert/move/remove) / **Drawing** (true hidden-line sheets); tabs are closable and keep their state |
| 🔩 Joint-driven assemblies | The build123d joint family (rigid/revolute/linear/cylindrical/ball/planar/polar): `cad_assembly_joint` defines, `cad_assembly_connect` pairs-and-solves (parent fixed, child repositioned onto the joint frames), `cad_assembly_drive` drives motion values with cascading re-solve (motion studies), `cad_assembly_explode` for exploded views; the assembly-tree panel gains a JOINTS section (kind/current value/pairing link). Pure main-thread placement algebra — kernel-independent, replays from the op log |
| 📥 STEP assembly import | `cad_step_import` imports a STEP document as an assembly: names, nesting and instance placements survive, identical geometry dedupes into one body referenced by N instances (a bolt pattern is one body); files cache as content-addressed workspace assets so op-log replay stays self-contained (cadorange kernel) |
| 📁 Multi-document file space | Named documents per workspace (`.dsh-cad/docs/`), each session bound to its own active document — new sessions start empty instead of inheriting leftovers; a folder button in the panel lists every document (preview / delete), and `cad_doc_new` / `cad_doc_open` manage the modeling target from chat |
| 📐 Engineering drawings | GB first-angle layout: front / top / left views + isometric, true OCCT hidden-line removal via the **occt.ts** kernel (an npm dependency, dashed); sheet frame, title block, overall dimensions, standard scale series; exports SVG / DXF |
| 🔗 Constraint solving & motion | **Ansatz** geometric constraint solver (**one command: `npm install ansatz-wasm`** — a wasm dependency, no Rust toolchain, no native binary): entity/constraint modeling (assembly instances ↔ rigid3 poses mapped automatically), solve-with-writeback, full DOF/residual/redundancy/suggestion diagnostics (LLM-oriented), and parametric kinematic sweeps (`cad_constraint` / `cad_solve` / `cad_motion`) |
| 📐 Geometry measurement | Exact volume (mm³), bounding box, triangle counts, DXF layers |
| 📤 On-demand export | STEP (parametric) / STL (mesh); files are written only when the user asks |
| 🖥️ Resident CAD panel | A permanent panel right of the conversation: Codex-style tabs (Part / Assembly / Drawing), tracking the latest model in real time while modeling. A host-independent liveness poll (`GET /dsh-cad/docs` → per-document op count) keeps the viewport following modeling ops even when the conversation meta pipeline goes stale, and auto-returns from a file preview |
| ⚡ Zero-copy render pipeline | worker mesh → in-memory binary → three.js typed arrays; zero base64 / zero intermediate files / zero per-step disk writes |
| 💾 Modeling document persistence | Operation log (JSON) + debounced disk mirror; automatically replayed to restore state after a process restart |
| 🖼️ Image → profile | PNG sketch/screenshot → Otsu binarization → contour tracing → extrusion-ready polygon (`cad_image_profile`) |
| 🔌 FreeCAD executor | Run the same op family on an external FreeCAD console (STEP in/out); requires a local FreeCAD install |
| ☁️ Onshape executor | Run the same op family on **Onshape** over its signed REST API — zero local install; every op compiles to a **standard Onshape feature** pushed into the target Part Studio (no Feature Studio setup). Readback is three-tier: cheap per-part STL by default, `readback: "step"` for exact-BRep-derived named meshes via a server-side STEP translation, or `readback: "none"` — build only and return the document link (~3 calls, quota-friendliest). Exports `.stl` / `.step` / `.x_t` (Parasolid). Quota-aware errors distinguish credential problems from free-plan cooldowns; the Onshape document URL is always surfaced |

## Installation

The plugin is published to npm — one line:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cad
```

The installer applies the bundled `cordis.patch.yml` (declared in the `dsh.bundle` manifest) automatically, so there is nothing to configure by hand.

### Version requirements

- **Node.js** and **dsh CLI** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`): minimum versions live in
  the badge row above and the `engines` field of `package.json` — kept out of
  the prose so they never go stale

### Install from source (dev mode)

```sh
git clone https://github.com/LAU-MARS/dsh-cad.git
cd dsh-cad
npm install && npm run build && npm test   # deps include occt.ts (true-HLR drawing kernel, ~20MB wasm)

npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh pnpm
dsh web                                  # let the first launch init the profile, then Ctrl-C

dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-cad

dsh web
```

The patch insert ships as `cordis.patch.yml` in the package root and is applied by the installer via the same `dsh.bundle` manifest.

Set `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` and you are ready — for example:

- “open bracket.stl” → `cad_view`
- “model a 100×60×5 plate, punch a ⌀20 hole in the middle, R2 fillets on the four
  corners, add a ⌀16 boss 20 tall, export plate.step”
  → `cad_create_prim` + `cad_boolean` + `cad_fillet` + `cad_export`, with the 3D tab
  updating live at every step
- “build a snowman” → spheres + a cone nose + a cylinder hat (precise `at`/`axis` placement)
- “add two more b1, one rotated 90 degrees” → `cad_assembly_insert` + `cad_assembly_move`, the Assembly tab updates live
- “make an A3 drawing of b1 and export dxf” → `cad_drawing` (three views + iso + dashed hidden lines + dimensions) → `cad_export` `.dxf`

## Modeling Tool Family

| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cad_view` | Open a CAD file and render it in the viewer (resident panel) |
| `cad_info` | Read-only geometry metadata (format / counts / bounding box / units / layers) |
| `cad_create_prim` | Primitives (mm, Z-up); `at` for placement, `axis` for orientation (exact axis-angle rotation) |
| `cad_sketch_new` | Create a named sketch (Sketch1…): {start, segments} / {circle} / flat points loop — referenced by name from the profile features |
| `cad_sketch_edit` | Redefine a sketch (回改): the definition op is rewritten in place and the log replayed — every referencing feature rebuilds |
| `cad_sketch_list` | List the document's sketches (name / form / size) |
| `cad_sketch_delete` | Delete a sketch (refused while features still reference it) |
| `cad_extrude_profile` | Extrude a closed XY-plane profile along +Z into a solid — inline points/segments/circle or a named sketch (`sketch`) |
| `cad_loft` | Loft: skin a solid through successive closed sections (each a [x,y,z,…] loop in its own plane, or a curve/`profile` section); sections may differ in shape and point count; `smooth` fits a periodic B-spline through point loops for a **crease-free** skin; `ruled` for straight sides |
| `cad_revolve` | Solid of revolution: revolve a closed profile around an axis (profile coords = (radius, height); curve segments supported — rounded rims exact); optional `angle`; accepts a named sketch |
| `cad_chamfer` | Chamfer: bevel every sharp edge with one equal distance (mm) |
| `cad_pattern` | Pattern: linear (`delta` spacing) or circular (principal axis + `at` point + sweep angle); creates copy bodies, fuse afterwards for one body |
| `cad_shell` | Shell: hollow to a wall thickness (inward, outer skin preserved); `open` lists outward normals of the faces to open (empty = sealed). Runs on the occt.ts kernel; the result is a HOSTED body |
| `cad_draft` | Draft: tilt the walls `angle` degrees about a neutral plane (mold release); `direction` is the pull direction, walls auto-selected by default. Runs on the occt.ts kernel; the result is a HOSTED body |
| `cad_sweep` | Sweep: pipe a closed 2D profile along a 3D [x,y,z,…] path; the profile is auto-placed on the start plane, so no manual orientation; accepts a named sketch |
| `cad_boolean` | fuse / cut / common (classic hole punching: plate cut cylinder) |
| `cad_fillet` | Constant-radius fillet on all sharp edges |
| `cad_transform` | Translate / Euler rotate / mirror |
| `cad_volume` | Exact BRep volume (mm³) |
| `cad_drawing` | Engineering drawing: front/top/left + isometric views, dashed hidden lines, frame, title block, overall dimensions, standard scale, A4/A3 |
| `cad_assembly_insert` | Insert a body into the assembly as a placed instance (`at` position, `rotate` orientation) |
| `cad_assembly_move` | Set an instance's absolute placement |
| `cad_assembly_remove` | Remove an instance from the assembly (the body stays) |
| `cad_assembly_joint` | Define a joint on an instance (build123d family: rigid/revolute/linear/cylindrical/ball/planar/polar), frame in the instance's local coordinates |
| `cad_assembly_connect` | Pair joints to place a child: the parent stays fixed, the child is repositioned so both joint frames coincide (optional connect-time drive value) |
| `cad_assembly_drive` | Drive a joint's motion value and re-solve every pairing (one motion-study step; ranges enforced) |
| `cad_assembly_solve` | Re-solve all pairings at current joint values (after moving a parent manually) |
| `cad_assembly_explode` | Exploded-view factor (instances push radially from the assembly center; view-state only, exports/drawings stay assembled) |
| `cad_assembly_info` | Read the assembly state: placements + joint labels/types/values + pairings + explode factor |
| `cad_step_import` | Structured STEP import: names, part structure and placements survive; identical geometry dedupes into one body referenced by N instances |
| `cad_constraint` | Declare the constraint model: entities (assembly-instance bindings) + constraints (distance/angle/mate/coaxial…), persisted in the op log |
| `cad_solve` | Solve with Ansatz and write poses back; returns DOF/residual/redundancy/suggestion diagnostics |
| `cad_motion` | Kinematic sweep: drive one constraint value from `from` to `to`, solve frame by frame, apply the last pose, return the motion table |
| `cad_export` | Export STEP / STL / DCPRT (the native replayable part document) to a workspace path; `target: "assembly"` writes the assembly STEP, `target: "drawing"` writes the sheet as SVG / DXF |
| `cad_delete` | Delete a body |
| `cad_docs` | List the workspace's modeling documents (id / name / bodies / updated, active marked) |
| `cad_doc_new` | Create a named document and make it the session's modeling target (start multi-part projects here) |
| `cad_doc_open` | Open an existing document (by id or name) as the session's modeling target — bodies replay exactly |
| `cad_doc_rename` | Rename a document |
| `cad_doc_delete` | Permanently delete a document (requires `confirm: true`) |
| `cad_freecad` | Run an op program on an external FreeCAD executor (optional STEP input / export) |
| `cad_fusion` | Run an op program on an external Fusion 360 executor (GUI bridge; optional export) |
| `cad_onshape` | Run an op program on the Onshape cloud (signed REST API): creates or drives a document, returns its URL; `readback: "step"` for exact BRep meshes; exports `.stl` / `.step` / `.x_t` (Parasolid) |
| `cad_image_profile` | PNG → contours → extrusion-ready polygon points |
| `cad_script` | Deterministic script evaluation for geometry math (profile point arrays, arc coordinates): `js` runs in-process (Node vm — works even when the host shell is unavailable), `py` uses a system Python |

After every modeling step: **the chat result row updates in place** (stable viewId +
versioned URL), and the resident panel's "Part" tab tracks the latest model in real time.

## Connectors (roadmap)

Modeling runs on the **occt.ts kernel** via cadorange (OCCT in the browser —
zero install). The connectors below refer to **external CAD engines** acting as
executors for the same tool family, planned for future support:

| Connector | Suite | Platform | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Built-in kernel** | CAD modeling kernel based on OCCT + WebGL, runs in the browser — zero install | All platforms (WebGL rendering) | ✅ Built-in |
| FreeCAD | open-source parametric suite — natural local executor via its Python API (console + GUI window modes) | Windows / macOS / Linux | ✅ Available (needs local install) |
| Fusion 360 | Autodesk CAD/CAM — resident add-in + spool bridge (no headless; the Fusion window doubles as a viewer) | Windows / macOS | 🧪 Experimental (`cad_fusion`) |
| SolidWorks | Dassault Systèmes industry-standard 3D CAD, COM/.NET automation | Windows only | 🚧 Windows demo scaffold (`scripts/solidworks-bridge/`) |
| Onshape | PTC cloud-native SaaS CAD, fully in the browser — signed REST API (cad.onshape.com or chamber hosts); every op compiles to a standard Onshape feature pushed into the Part Studio, results read back as per-part STL + mass properties, the cloud is the viewer | All platforms (browser) | ✅ Available (`cad_onshape`; set `DSH_ONSHAPE_ACCESS_KEY` / `DSH_ONSHAPE_SECRET_KEY`) |
| ZW3D（中望3D） | ZWSOFT all-in-one CAD/CAM | Windows / Linux | 🚧 Planned |
| GstarCAD 3D（浩辰3D） | Gstarsoft 3D CAD | Windows | 🚧 Planned |

All external engines implement the same **GeometryExecutor contract** (`available()` /
`run(opProgram) → meshes`), so the WebGL display layer never changes — swapping a
backend changes only the quality of the produced geometry.

## Architecture

```
cad_view(path)                        modeling tools (cad_create_prim, …)
  → import worker (occt-import-js)      → modeling worker (occt.ts WASM via cadorange)
  → CadScene JSON (base64-f32)          → exact BRep geometry + meshing
  → GET /dsh-cad/scene/<id>            → in-memory binary scene (f32/u32 packed)
                                        → GET /dsh-cad/bin/<docId>
            ↓ session presentationMeta (viewId + versioned URL) ↓
        browser card + persistent "3D" tab (three.js / SVG, Z-up, XYZ axes)
```

- **Two workers**: import (occt-import-js, read-only STEP/IGES/BREP) and modeling
  (cadorange over the occt.ts wasm) are separate, both lazily started
- **Zero-copy pipeline**: modeling scenes use zero base64 / zero large JSON arrays /
  zero per-step disk writes (disk mirror debounced 1.5s, replayed only on service
  restart); `cad_export` is the only explicit file export
- **Modeling document**: `<workspace>/.dsh-cad/model.json` operation log; all bodies
  are restored by replay after a restart
- **Drawing HLR kernel**: hidden lines run on **occt.ts** (npm dependency,
  `npm i occt.ts`) — true OCCT removal, no fallback engine, a missing kernel is
  a hard error. Kernel APIs: `hiddenLines()` true hidden-line
  removal, byte-level STEP/BRep `readStep`/`readBrep`/`writeStep`/`writeBrep`
  without MEMFS, tessellation with built-in feature-edge extraction, and a
  `hasError()`/`lastError()` error contract. Geometry crosses kernels as STEP
  bytes and the projected segments are remapped into the sheet frame. Kernel
  dist resolution: `DSH_OCCTJS_DIST` env var → Node's own resolution of the
  `occt.ts` dependency (walks up every parent node_modules — npm/yarn flat and
  pnpm symlink layouts all hit) → `<repo>/../opencascade-ts/dist` (sibling
  checkout) → `vendor/` → `node_modules/opencascade-ts`
- **Constraint solving (Ansatz)**: the solver is the npm dependency
  **`ansatz-wasm`** (a wasm-bindgen build, single package ~538KB, zero deps) —
  installing dsh-cad pulls it automatically, and `npm install ansatz-wasm` alone
  upgrades it. **No Rust toolchain, no native binary, platform independent.**
  Resolution: the npm package (node_modules) → a `DSH_ANSATZ_WASM` directory → a
  sibling Ansatz checkout's pkg-node. The solver speaks one JSON envelope
  contract, with tool-layer errors (e.g. `unsupported_constraint`) surfaced
  verbatim for the LLM. Assembly placements (translate + XYZ Euler
  degrees) map bidirectionally to the solver's rigid3 poses (translate +
  exponential-map rotation, radians). Solver capability is staged
  (point-distance-to-origin today) — the plumbing contract is finished and needs
  no changes as it grows
- **Kernel chain**: modeling goes through **cadorange** (agent-native CAD
  runtime; public build123d-style API for prims/curve-segment profiles (TRUE
  B-spline interpolation)/loft/sweep/revolve/booleans (cleaned by default)/
  fillet/chamfer/shell/draft/native mirror/centroid, plus the supported
  `cadorange/occt` escape hatch for viewer tessellation, engineering-drawing
  HLR (zero STEP hops, one wasm session) and wire construction); the direct
  occt.ts adapter stays as the fallback tier (`DSH_CAD_KERNEL` pins one; see
  docs/cadorange-integration.md for the verb-by-verb mapping). Editing after
  shelling is seamless. Assembly STEP export writes a **structured document**
  (cadorange
  `exportStepAssembly`): one root product plus one named, placed child
  per instance — instance separation survives the file (STL stays a single
  fused mesh). Instance separation stays in
  the assembly scene/document for the fuse paths.
  Face selection matches `describe()` plane normals (outermost along ±normal)
- **Client**: esbuild single-file CJS factory (three.js inlined ~560KB, react provided
  by the host module table), Z-up CAD convention, empty scene with XYZ axis labels
  and a ground grid always displayed

## Theming (dark mode)

The viewer follows the host appearance automatically. DSH publishes the theme as
`color-scheme` on `<html>` plus `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`; the plugin resolves
that (falling back to `prefers-color-scheme`) and themes every surface the host
tokens cannot reach:

- the viewport slab behind the transparent WebGL canvas and 2D scenes,
- default 2D entity strokes (DXF / engineering-drawing entities),
- the Three.js ground grid, XYZ axis triad/labels, feature edges, default mesh
  color and sketch overlays,
- the ViewCube face plate (canvas texture).

A theme flip restyles mounted cards and the resident panel live — no reload and
no lost camera. Engineering drawings loaded as SVG keep a white sheet; in dark
mode it is framed as paper on the dark slab instead of filling the viewport.

Hosts can override the surfaces the plugin owns; an explicit definition wins in
either theme:

| CSS variable | Applies to | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dsh-cad-bg` | viewport background (any CSS `background` value) | light `#f5f6f8→#e9ecf0`, dark `#1b1b1c→#151517` |
| `--dsh-cad-stroke` | default 2D entity stroke | `#4c5561` light / `#c8ced6` dark |
| `--dsh-cad-paper` | drawing paper behind SVG sheets | `#ffffff` |

```css
:root { --dsh-cad-bg: #0b0d10; }          /* flat canvas in both themes */
```

## Tests

```sh
npm test                             # full suite: converters / modeling worker (exact volume assertions) / DCPRT round-trip / FreeCAD + Onshape executors / image profiles / binary pipeline / document persistence
node test/route-check.mjs            # JSON scene routing layer
node test/visual/serve.mjs           # browser card/tab visual verification page (http://127.0.0.1:3987)
```

Representative assertions covered: the boolean-punched volume exactly equals the
analytic value (28429.20 mm³), L-shaped profile extrusion 3000 mm³, volumes and
bounding-box flips of sphere/cone/torus placed with `at`/`axis`, 8-byte alignment
of the binary packing, an STL export round-trip (export → read back by the
phase-1 parser), and a DCPRT document round-trip (serialize → replay on the
OCCT worker → exact bounds).

## Known Limitations

- DWG (closed-source) is unsupported; DXF bulge arcs are approximated by chords;
  glTF/3MF viewing is not implemented (the structure is reserved)
- `cad_fillet` is all-edge constant-radius (per-edge selection is unstable under
  embind); chamfer is not implemented
- Sketch extrusion supports polygon profiles only (arc profiles are constructed by
  boolean combinations of cylinders/tori)
- dsh framework limitation: an already-mounted single slot (the right-side details
  panel itself) does not respond to components registered later, so the persistent
  view is provided as the "3D" view tab (a list slot, the official composition)
- The host reads CAD files via node:fs (the platform fs service supports UTF-8 text
  only and cannot carry binary data)

## Community

| QQ Group (🇨🇳 China) | Feishu (🇨🇳 China) | X / Twitter (🌍 International) | Discord (🌍 International) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `485038246` (join note: dsh-cad) | 🚧 Coming soon | 🚧 Coming soon | 🚧 Coming soon |

# dsh-token-audit

**Find out where your DeepSeek Harness tokens went — and what to change first.**

`dsh-token-audit` reads your local DSH session logs, prices every model call with the official DeepSeek peak/idle rates, and prints a ranked savings plan. It is a one-shot audit, not another dashboard: no plugin required, no config, no upload.

```bash
npx dsh-token-audit
```

```
DSH Token Audit
  /home/you/.dsh/sessions

  Window      2026-09-22 → 2026-10-31  (22 active days)
  Sessions    345  ·  59,823 model calls
  Total       CNY 778.78  ·  CNY 35.40/day  ·  CNY 1,061.98/month projected

  Cost split
    cache read      CNY 390.83  [##########........] 50.2%
    output          CNY 297.36  [########..........] 38.2%
    cache miss       CNY 90.59  [##................] 11.6%
    peak hours      CNY 281.49  [#######...........] 36.1%

  Context distribution
    0–50.0k          140 calls  [........................]
    ...
    500.0k–750.0k   2143 calls  [#######.................]

  Savings plan  (gross; combined overlaps, behavior unchanged)
    context cap 150k   save   CNY 210.20  27.0%
    context cap 250k   save   CNY 118.90  15.3%
    output      -20%   save    CNY 59.47   7.6%
    off-peak     40%   save    CNY 56.30   7.2%

  What to do first
    • 64% of calls ran above 200k context. Lower the compaction trigger ...
    • 36% of spend landed in peak hours (09-12, 14-18 Beijing) ...
```

A synthetic example report is in [docs/demo.html](docs/demo.html); open it in a browser to see the full layout.

## Why this exists

DSH is good at keeping a long conversation alive; that also makes it easy to spend far more than you expect. The official DSH surface shows context pressure and token counts, but not **which calls cost the most, which hours were expensive, or what to change**. This tool answers those three questions from the logs you already have.

It is deliberately not a dashboard:

- **One shot.** Run it monthly, or after an expensive week.
- **Exact accounting.** Uses provider-reported usage from `assistant/message` events, including cache reads, cache misses, and output.
- **Official prices.** DeepSeek `deepseek-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro`, peak and idle, in CNY per million tokens (as of 2026-10-31).
- **Actionable.** Ranks context caps, output discipline, off-peak scheduling, and tool-output bloat by the money they would save.

## Install

```bash
# zero-install
npx dsh-token-audit

# or globally
npm i -g dsh-token-audit
dsh-token-audit --days 7
```

Node.js 20+. If `zstdcat` is on `PATH` it is used to decode logs quickly; otherwise a pure-JS decoder is bundled. On Windows, the pure-JS path is used.

## Install as a DSH plugin

The npm package is also a DSH bundle. It adds one read-only agent tool, `token_audit`:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-token-audit
```

Then ask the agent: *"Audit my token spend for the last 30 days and tell me what to change."* The tool returns the same report. It never sends session data anywhere.

## Usage

```bash
dsh-token-audit                              # last 30 days, terminal
dsh-token-audit --days 7                     # last week
dsh-token-audit --since 2026-10-01 --until 2026-10-31   # calendar month (Beijing dates)
dsh-token-audit --all                        # every session on disk
dsh-token-audit --cwd Miner                  # one workspace
dsh-token-audit --session 4160cf07           # drill into one expensive session
dsh-token-audit --format markdown --out report.md
dsh-token-audit --format html --out report.html --open
dsh-token-audit --format json > audit.json
```

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--sessions <dir>` | Session root. Default `$DSH_HOME/sessions` or `~/.dsh/sessions`. |
| `--days <n>` | Only sessions active in the last N days. Default 30. |
| `--since <date>` | Only calls on/after this Beijing date (`YYYY-MM-DD`); implies `--all`. |
| `--until <date>` | Only calls on/before this Beijing date (`YYYY-MM-DD`); implies `--all`. |
| `--all` | Ignore the time window. |
| `--cwd <text>` | Only sessions whose working directory contains the text. |
| `--session <id>` | Only sessions whose id contains the text; drill into one expensive session. |
| `--format <fmt>` | `terminal` (default), `markdown`, `html`, `json`. |
| `--out <file>` | Write the report to a file. Format is inferred from the extension. |
| `--open` | Open an HTML report in the default browser. |
| `--redact` | Hide session titles, paths, commands, and file names; safe to share. |
| `--top <n>` | Rows in the terminal session table. Default 8. |
| `--no-color` | Disable ANSI colors. |

## Verify a change (before / after)

Save a baseline JSON report, make one change, wait a comparable window, then compare:

```bash
dsh-token-audit --format json > before.json
# ... change compaction / effort / scheduling for a week ...
dsh-token-audit --format json > after.json
dsh-token-audit compare before.json after.json
```

The comparison leads with **cost per call**, not just total cost: a cheaper week with half the work is not a win. It also shows context, peak share, cache/output composition, and a verdict.

## Generate a Lean preset

The audit tells you the shape of the problem; the preset applies a first fix:

```bash
dsh-token-audit preset --out ./dsh-lean-preset
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-lean-preset
```

It keeps the standard toolset, moves the compaction trigger from 80% to 45%, shrinks the retained tail, prunes tool results at 4k chars, and adds a cost-discipline persona. Tune with `--threshold 0.5 --retain 0.08 --prune 6144`. Choose **Lean** for a new session; existing sessions keep their preset.

## What the numbers mean

Every `assistant/message` in a DSH session log carries provider-reported usage:

- `cacheReadTokens` — input served from the prompt cache (cheap)
- `inputTokens` — uncached input (expensive)
- `outputTokens` — generated tokens, including reasoning (most expensive)

Cost is computed per call, using the call's Beijing timestamp to pick peak or idle pricing:

| Model | Cache hit | Cache miss | Output |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `deepseek-flash` idle | 0.02 | 1.00 | 4.00 |
| `deepseek-flash` peak | 0.04 | 2.00 | 8.00 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` idle | 0.15 | 4.50 | 13.50 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` peak | 0.30 | 9.00 | 27.00 |

Peak = Beijing weekdays 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, excluding China statutory holidays. Unknown models fall back to Flash rates and are flagged in the report.

## Savings estimates are gross, not promises

The `Savings plan` assumes behavior stays the same. Capping context at 250k means older history is compacted earlier; the model may lose detail and take more steps. Treat each row as an upper bound, then verify on a real task. The report labels the combined row as overlapping for the same reason.

The most reliable levers we have measured on real logs:

1. **Context size.** Cache-read cost is proportional to context length on every call. A 250k cap is often 15–25% of the bill.
2. **Output discipline.** On `reasoningEffort: max`, output can be 35–40% of cost. Use `high` for routine work.
3. **Off-peak scheduling.** Idle prices are half. Move batch jobs after 18:00 or before 09:00 Beijing time.
4. **Tool output.** `bash` is usually the largest source of context bloat; `tail`/`head`/quiet flags and redirecting logs to files are free.

## Privacy

Everything runs locally. The tool reads `~/.dsh/sessions/**`, computes in memory, and writes only the report you ask for. There is no network call, no telemetry, and no upload. The plugin tool is read-only.

Use `--redact` before sharing a report with anyone: it removes session titles, working directories, bash commands, and file names while keeping every number.

## Limitations

- This is an **estimate**, not your invoice. Subscription plans, credits, refunds, and provider discounts are not visible in session logs.
- Peak/idle holidays are hardcoded for China 2026. Weekends are always idle.
- Third-party providers are priced at Flash rates until a catalog is added.
- Session logs must be readable (`.jsonl` or `.jsonl.zstd`).
- Context caps are a trade-off; quality is not modeled.

## Development

```bash
git clone <repo>
cd dsh-token-audit
npm install
npm test
node bin/dsh-token-audit.mjs --days 3
```

The audit engine (`src/audit.mjs`) is independent of the CLI and can be imported. Pricing lives in `src/pricing.mjs`; renderers in `src/report.mjs`.

## Need this applied to your setup?

The audit is free. If you want the configuration work done for you — compaction thresholds, pruner settings, model routing, off-peak scheduling, and a before/after verification — see [docs/service.md](docs/service.md). Fixed scope, fixed price, pay only after the report.

## License

MIT. Pricing data belongs to DeepSeek; this project is unofficial.

No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

```
  Window      2026-09-22 → 2026-10-31  (22 active days)
  Sessions    345  ·  59,823 model calls
  Total       CNY 778.78  ·  CNY 35.40/day  ·  CNY 1,061.98/month projected

  Cost split
    cache read      CNY 390.83  [##########........] 50.2%
    output          CNY 297.36  [########..........] 38.2%
    cache miss       CNY 90.59  [##................] 11.6%
    peak hours      CNY 281.49  [#######...........] 36.1%

  Context distribution
    0–50.0k          140 calls  [........................]
    ...
    500.0k–750.0k   2143 calls  [#######.................]

  Savings plan  (gross; combined overlaps, behavior unchanged)
    context cap 150k   save   CNY 210.20  27.0%
    context cap 250k   save   CNY 118.90  15.3%
    output      -20%   save    CNY 59.47   7.6%
    off-peak     40%   save    CNY 56.30   7.2%

  What to do first
    • 64% of calls ran above 200k context. Lower the compaction trigger ...
    • 36% of spend landed in peak hours (09-12, 14-18 Beijing) ...
```

A synthetic example report is in [docs/demo.html](docs/demo.html); open it in a browser to see the full layout.

## Why this exists

DSH is good at keeping a long conversation alive; that also makes it easy to spend far more than you expect. The official DSH surface shows context pressure and token counts, but not **which calls cost the most, which hours were expensive, or what to change**. This tool answers those three questions from the logs you already have.

It is deliberately not a dashboard:

- **One shot.** Run it monthly, or after an expensive week.
- **Exact accounting.** Uses provider-reported usage from `assistant/message` events, including cache reads, cache misses, and output.
- **Official prices.** DeepSeek `deepseek-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro`, peak and idle, in CNY per million tokens (as of 2026-10-31).
- **Actionable.** Ranks context caps, output discipline, off-peak scheduling, and tool-output bloat by the money they would save.

## Install

```bash
# zero-install
npx dsh-token-audit

# or globally
npm i -g dsh-token-audit
dsh-token-audit --days 7
```

Node.js 20+. If `zstdcat` is on `PATH` it is used to decode logs quickly; otherwise a pure-JS decoder is bundled. On Windows, the pure-JS path is used.

## Install as a DSH plugin

The npm package is also a DSH bundle. It adds one read-only agent tool, `token_audit`:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-token-audit
```

Then ask the agent: *"Audit my token spend for the last 30 days and tell me what to change."* The tool returns the same report. It never sends session data anywhere.

## Usage

```bash
dsh-token-audit                              # last 30 days, terminal
dsh-token-audit --days 7                     # last week
dsh-token-audit --since 2026-10-01 --until 2026-10-31   # calendar month (Beijing dates)
dsh-token-audit --all                        # every session on disk
dsh-token-audit --cwd Miner                  # one workspace
dsh-token-audit --session 4160cf07           # drill into one expensive session
dsh-token-audit --format markdown --out report.md
dsh-token-audit --format html --out report.html --open
dsh-token-audit --format json > audit.json
```

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--sessions <dir>` | Session root. Default `$DSH_HOME/sessions` or `~/.dsh/sessions`. |
| `--days <n>` | Only sessions active in the last N days. Default 30. |
| `--since <date>` | Only calls on/after this Beijing date (`YYYY-MM-DD`); implies `--all`. |
| `--until <date>` | Only calls on/before this Beijing date (`YYYY-MM-DD`); implies `--all`. |
| `--all` | Ignore the time window. |
| `--cwd <text>` | Only sessions whose working directory contains the text. |
| `--session <id>` | Only sessions whose id contains the text; drill into one expensive session. |
| `--format <fmt>` | `terminal` (default), `markdown`, `html`, `json`. |
| `--out <file>` | Write the report to a file. Format is inferred from the extension. |
| `--open` | Open an HTML report in the default browser. |
| `--redact` | Hide session titles, paths, commands, and file names; safe to share. |
| `--top <n>` | Rows in the terminal session table. Default 8. |
| `--no-color` | Disable ANSI colors. |

## Verify a change (before / after)

Save a baseline JSON report, make one change, wait a comparable window, then compare:

```bash
dsh-token-audit --format json > before.json
# ... change compaction / effort / scheduling for a week ...
dsh-token-audit --format json > after.json
dsh-token-audit compare before.json after.json
```

The comparison leads with **cost per call**, not just total cost: a cheaper week with half the work is not a win. It also shows context, peak share, cache/output composition, and a verdict.

## Generate a Lean preset

The audit tells you the shape of the problem; the preset applies a first fix:

```bash
dsh-token-audit preset --out ./dsh-lean-preset
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-lean-preset
```

It keeps the standard toolset, moves the compaction trigger from 80% to 45%, shrinks the retained tail, prunes tool results at 4k chars, and adds a cost-discipline persona. Tune with `--threshold 0.5 --retain 0.08 --prune 6144`. Choose **Lean** for a new session; existing sessions keep their preset.

## What the numbers mean

Every `assistant/message` in a DSH session log carries provider-reported usage:

- `cacheReadTokens` — input served from the prompt cache (cheap)
- `inputTokens` — uncached input (expensive)
- `outputTokens` — generated tokens, including reasoning (most expensive)

Cost is computed per call, using the call's Beijing timestamp to pick peak or idle pricing:

| Model | Cache hit | Cache miss | Output |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `deepseek-flash` idle | 0.02 | 1.00 | 4.00 |
| `deepseek-flash` peak | 0.04 | 2.00 | 8.00 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` idle | 0.15 | 4.50 | 13.50 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` peak | 0.30 | 9.00 | 27.00 |

Peak = Beijing weekdays 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, excluding China statutory holidays. Unknown models fall back to Flash rates and are flagged in the report.

## Savings estimates are gross, not promises

The `Savings plan` assumes behavior stays the same. Capping context at 250k means older history is compacted earlier; the model may lose detail and take more steps. Treat each row as an upper bound, then verify on a real task. The report labels the combined row as overlapping for the same reason.

The most reliable levers we have measured on real logs:

1. **Context size.** Cache-read cost is proportional to context length on every call. A 250k cap is often 15–25% of the bill.
2. **Output discipline.** On `reasoningEffort: max`, output can be 35–40% of cost. Use `high` for routine work.
3. **Off-peak scheduling.** Idle prices are half. Move batch jobs after 18:00 or before 09:00 Beijing time.
4. **Tool output.** `bash` is usually the largest source of context bloat; `tail`/`head`/quiet flags and redirecting logs to files are free.

## Privacy

Everything runs locally. The tool reads `~/.dsh/sessions/**`, computes in memory, and writes only the report you ask for. There is no network call, no telemetry, and no upload. The plugin tool is read-only.

Use `--redact` before sharing a report with anyone: it removes session titles, working directories, bash commands, and file names while keeping every number.

## Limitations

- This is an **estimate**, not your invoice. Subscription plans, credits, refunds, and provider discounts are not visible in session logs.
- Peak/idle holidays are hardcoded for China 2026. Weekends are always idle.
- Third-party providers are priced at Flash rates until a catalog is added.
- Session logs must be readable (`.jsonl` or `.jsonl.zstd`).
- Context caps are a trade-off; quality is not modeled.

## Development

```bash
git clone <repo>
cd dsh-token-audit
npm install
npm test
node bin/dsh-token-audit.mjs --days 3
```

The audit engine (`src/audit.mjs`) is independent of the CLI and can be imported. Pricing lives in `src/pricing.mjs`; renderers in `src/report.mjs`.

## Need this applied to your setup?

The audit is free. If you want the configuration work done for you — compaction thresholds, pruner settings, model routing, off-peak scheduling, and a before/after verification — see [docs/service.md](docs/service.md). Fixed scope, fixed price, pay only after the report.

## License

MIT. Pricing data belongs to DeepSeek; this project is unofficial.

# dsh-paoding（庖丁解牛）
[English](README_en.md) · 中文

庖丁解牛，游刃有余 —— 把 DSH 调教成一支分工明确、按需加载的 agent 小团队。

dsh-paoding（中文品牌「庖丁」，典出《庄子》——庖丁顺纹理下刀，刀刃十九年若新发于硎）是 DSH（DeepSeek Harness agent 运行时）的**预设生成器**。DSH 原本是一个 agent 包揽约 60 个工具、每次请求全量加载；装上庖丁后变成「一个指挥 + 四个帮手」——主 agent 只带编排与内部搜索的精简工具，其余的活按角色委派给只带本行工具的子 agent。全部靠配置完成，**零 DSH 源码改动**。

## 功能特性

- **一支分工明确的小团队**：主 agent 当指挥，拆解任务、分派验收；联网调研、UI 设计、写代码、全仓深搜四位专属帮手各司其职，随叫随到、干完即走。
- **高频小事不过手他人**：找代码、查引用、读文件这类顺手的事，主 agent 自己直接办，不绕委派的圈子。
- **可招募专属帮手**：内置四角色只是起点——给新角色配好工具和技能（比如装上 `html-ppt` 技能的 PPT 帮手），之后一句「把这份大纲做成 PPT」就有人接活。配置文件、图形界面两个入口都能建。
- **帮手还能指定专用模型**：写代码的用强档、查资料的用轻快档，各配各的模型；不配就跟随主 agent 当前会话的模型。
- **帮手能继承对话开工**：把某个角色的「启动方式」切成继承对话（fork），帮手带着主 agent 已完成的对话轮次直接开工，省得在委派时把上下文复述一遍；默认全员全新启动，不开启就一切照旧。
- **帮手能就地续修**：把某个角色的「会话模式」切成可续（continuable），活干砸了或干得不满意，主 agent 用 `send_message` 在同一个子会话接着修，不用从头重派；默认全员一次性（one-shot）用完即弃，不开启就一切照旧。
- **省钱省上下文**：帮手的工具只在被叫到时才加载，用一次付一次；主 agent 每次请求的工具开销约降三分之二，上下文只收摘要，不再被搜索结果和代码改动撑爆。
- **角色随改随用**：删掉用不上的内置角色、给角色改显示名、给主 agent 配显示名，都是配置里一行的事；配了显示名的角色，派出的子代理标签自动带上角色名（「民工码农 · 修复标签显示」），任务管理页、子代理目录树、后台任务列表一眼可辨。改完在面板点一次「保存并应用」，预设即时重生成，重启 DSH / 新建会话后生效。
- **装了什么都能认出来**：MCP 服务器、本地插件、已装技能，安装与配置时全程检测；默认只装 dsh 基础工具，检测到的 host 工具在「庖丁配置」里按需勾选；停用哪个，重新应用后相关工具自动剔除。
- **按工作区各有各的班底**：不同项目可以配不同的主/子 agent——「庖丁配置」里选定工作区单独配置，每个工作区生成自己的预设（`orchestrator-<目录名>`），新建会话时选对应预设即可，全局默认不受影响。
- **图形界面配置**：不习惯改配置文件的话，点开左侧栏底部动作条（设置行上方）的「庖丁配置」入口，整页点选即可，「保存并应用」即时重生成预设——与首装自动化同一条生成管线。
- **工具条目支持通配符**：`*` 与 `?` 在生成期展开成具体工具名——`mcp__tavily__tavily_*` 一行顶五行，MCP 工具族不必逐个点名；零匹配有提醒，产物与运行时行为不变。
- **保存前先体检**：预览/应用时自动过一遍检查——配置了但未挂载的工具、零工具角色、查无此名的模型、预设落后于配置，分级提示一目了然；预览还顺带列出「本次变更」逐项明细与主 agent 工具面瘦身统计，改了什么、省了多少都在明面上。CLI 侧 `dsh-paoding doctor` 六项只读自检（配置可解析、安装轨道、声明行托管块、孤儿目录、版本标记、预设漂移），一条命令查全身；`--fix` 自动修孤儿目录与过期声明行两类安全项。
- **场景模板一键换班底**：轻量（只留实现）、调研（只留检索）、全开（全员到齐、主 agent 带满检测库存）三档点一下就切，只动「谁在场 + 主 agent 额外带什么」，精调过的角色配置分毫不动。
- **配置可导出可导入，还有后悔药**：面板「更多」菜单一键下载 `dsh-paoding.config.yml`，换机迁移、备份整份拷走；导入先验格式，覆盖整体配置（含工作区段）需二次确认。每次写盘前自动轮换备份三份，「恢复备份」二次确认即回退，误操作不用翻文件。
- **HTTP 接口直连配置**：预设的列举、新增、更新、删除走 `/api/paoding/presets` 四条接口，随 DSH Web 服务同进程挂载、本机回环直调；与面板「保存并应用」同一条生成管线、同一把写盘互斥闸——脚本和自动化工具改班底，不必开浏览器。
- **面板中英双语**：界面文案 zh/en 全覆盖，语言自动识别（显式选择 → 中文信号优先：浏览器语言、宿主页面语言、中文时区），「更多」菜单一键切换并记住。
- **版本更新有提醒，面板一键升级**：面板会对比 npm registry（npmmirror 镜像、GitHub release 依次兜底）上的最新版本，发现新版就地提示并附上发布页链接；点「升级」就地换上新版（profile 自动探测：普通 profile 走 `dsh plugin update dsh-paoding`；desktop profile 被 dsh CLI 的 Electron 专属守卫挡住，改在 profile 目录直跑 `pnpm add dsh-paoding@<版本>`，pnpm 找不到时自动回落 `corepack pnpm`），重启 DSH 后生效，编排预设会在重启时按新版自动重生成。开发检出的 link 形态无法就地升级，面板会提示切回 registry 版的办法；检测失败时页头留一行「版本检测失败 · 重试」（完整原因与代理排查提示在悬浮提示里），不弹窗打扰。
- **委派效果可量化**：面板「委派效果」卡按角色统计调用数、平均耗时与失败数（近 30 天），数据读宿主会话存档本地聚合——哪个角色用得多、哪个常掉链子，一眼可见；缺省项目（宿主 cwd 换算）扫不到任何委派记录时自动回落为全项目聚合（卡片标注「全部项目」），冷读带日志 mtime 预过滤，窗口外的日志文件不再开读句柄。
- **来去自由**：不改 DSH 一行源码；装完新会话即用，卸载即删目录。
- **两代宿主都兼容**：DSH 0.1.5 – 0.2.1 全支持（0.1.5 / 0.1.6 / 0.1.7-rc.1 / 0.1.7-rc.2 / 0.2.0-rc.1 / 0.2.0-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.2+）——两代宿主发现预设的机制不同（目录扫描 vs patch 声明行），安装器自动检测宿主版本选对落点；编排组合里的 workflow worker 行也按宿主版本自动适配（0.1.5 用 workflow-worker-thread，0.1.6+ 换 workflow-ptc——旧包 0.1.6 起已删除，残留行正是 0.2.0 面板上「加载失败」的元凶）；DSH 0.2.1 起角色委派行同步换代（0.2.1 的 dsh-tool-subagent 拒绝内联 persona/toolFilter——人设与工具面改挂各角色的 AgentPreset，spawn 子代理按 agentPreset 选择子预设；0.2.0 及以下保持内联形状），宿主升级、降级后的首次保存/自愈自动迁移（工作区专属预设 orchestrator-<slug> 随同轮自愈一并换代），全程无感；0.2.1 的 prerelease 再细分——tool-subagent 守卫自 0.2.1-rc.2 落地，rc.0/rc.1 仍按内联形状生成。

## 插件截图

![截图 1](docs/images/1.png)

## 快速开始

前置：**Node.js ≥ 18**、**pnpm** 与一台已装好的 DSH host（**@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.5 – 0.2.1** 全支持，预设落点与角色委派行形态自动适配宿主版本）。

**官方插件通道（唯一安装入口）**——不用克隆仓库，一条命令，装完重启即用：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-paoding
```

等价捷径：`npx dsh-paoding@latest`（内部转成上面这条命令，默认 profile web，需本机已装 dsh）。npx 拉到哪版就装哪版：实际安装的是 `dsh-paoding@<npx 拉取到的版本>`。

`dsh plugin` 是 pnpm 的透明转发器：包被 pnpm 装进 profile，包内声明的 bundle patch 把「庖丁配置」面板挂进 DSH Web 左侧栏。**重启 DSH（`dsh web`）**即完成全部安装——插件启动时会自动检测，编排预设缺失或版本不符就自动生成一次（有 `~/.dsh/dsh-paoding.config.yml` 按配置应用，没有则写基础模板），无需再点任何按钮。DSH 0.1.7 起宿主改用 patch 声明行发现预设，插件会自动改写登记方式，装法不变。新会话的预设选择器里选「编排模式 (Orchestrator)」即可；要设为默认，在 Settings → Agent Presets 里选。

开箱默认只带 DSH 自带的基础工具，检测到的 MCP/host 工具不会自动写入——装完点开左侧栏的**「庖丁配置」**按需勾选工具与角色，「保存并应用」即生效。不想要了，三条命令卸干净（按工作区配置生成的各工作区预设也一并删除）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-paoding
rm -rf "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/.agent-presets/orchestrator"
rm -rf "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/.agent-presets"/orchestrator-*
```

宿主是 DSH 0.1.7+ 时再补一步：删去 `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` 里的 dsh-paoding 托管块（带 auto-generated 起止标记），免得留下指向已删目录的声明行（详见[安装文档](docs/installation.md)第 7 节）。

**开发检出自装**——想改插件或预设源码时，用 link 形态直连仓库（改动经 HMR/重启生效）：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lifangjin/dsh-paoding.git
dsh plugin --profile web add link:"$PWD/dsh-paoding"
```

升级走面板「升级」按钮（普通 profile 等价 `dsh plugin update dsh-paoding`；desktop profile 则在 profile 目录直跑 `pnpm add` 精确版本，无裸 pnpm 时自动用 `corepack pnpm`）。详细步骤、升级与排查见 [安装文档](docs/installation.md)。

## 怎么用

给主 agent 派活即可，它按分工自己路由：

- 找代码 / 查引用 / 读文件 → 主 agent 自己办，不委派；
- 联网查资料、做调研 → 联网调研帮手（`search_external`，只带联网工具、不改文件）；
- 出界面方案、设计稿 → 设计帮手（`design`，可加载设计技能，出 spec 不写最终代码）；
- 写代码 / 改代码 → 实现帮手（`implement`，改完自验再汇报）；
- 超大仓库全仓探索、大文件通读 → 全仓深搜帮手（`search_internal_deep`，只读、无网络，只回浓缩摘要）；
- 专属活（比如做 PPT）→ 先建自定义角色，之后随叫随到。

帮手干活期间，主 agent 可以随时追问、查看进度、叫停；结束后只把摘要收进上下文，不把帮手的完整过程倒进来。任务失败怎么恢复、怎么多轮迭代，见 [编排文档](docs/orchestration.md)。

## 配置

所有偏好都写在 `~/.dsh/dsh-paoding.config.yml`：角色增删改、技能分配、专用模型、会话模式（one-shot / continuable）、启动方式（fresh / fork）、主 agent 的工具与技能……改完打开左侧栏底部的「庖丁配置」入口，点「保存并应用」即同步生效。预设每次由「静态源 + 配置」重新生成，不攒手工补丁。全部配置键说明见 [配置文档](docs/configuration.md)；背后机制与成本账见 [架构文档](docs/architecture.md)。

偏好走脚本的，还有一套 HTTP 接口：`/api/paoding/presets` 覆盖预设的列举 / 新增 / 更新 / 删除，随 DSH Web 服务同进程（端口即浏览器打开 DSH 的那个端口），本机回环直调即可：

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/paoding/presets
```

写操作与面板「保存并应用」同一条生成管线与写盘互斥。方法、请求体与错误语义见 [配置文档](docs/configuration.md)第 13 节。

## 文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [架构](docs/architecture.md) | 为什么这样设计——概述、成本账、角色与工具、对应 DSH 原生机制、Token 治理、已知边界。 |
| [安装](docs/installation.md) | 官方插件通道一条命令安装、版本支持与预设落点双轨（DSH 0.1.5 – 0.2.1）、首装自动化与版本标记、升级、开发检出自装、host patch 检测机制、庖丁配置面板、卸载（`dsh-paoding uninstall` 一条命令）、排查（doctor 可 `--fix`）。 |
| [编排](docs/orchestration.md) | 编排总览、失败如何呈现与三层处理、one-shot vs continuable、上下文隔离。 |
| [配置](docs/configuration.md) | 配置键全参考、工具条目通配符、内置角色微调、主 agent 工具与技能、自定义角色、按角色分模型、角色会话与启动方式、场景模板、配置导出导入与备份回滚、检查提示、HTTP 接口。 |

## 贡献

欢迎 issue 与 PR：使用中发现问题、想要新的角色、或发现文档与实现不一致，都可以提。动手前请先读 [架构](docs/architecture.md) 与 [配置](docs/configuration.md)；文档与实现冲突时，以 `presets/orchestrator/` 与 `tools/` 源码为准。

## 许可

以 [MIT License](LICENSE) 发布，完整条款见仓库根目录的 `LICENSE` 文件。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# Ebbing Context

[![test](https://github.com/Light-EI/dsh-ebbing-context/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Light-EI/dsh-ebbing-context/actions/workflows/test.yml)

**模拟记忆衰退的 DSH 分层上下文压缩插件。**

模型自己决定压哪里、自己写摘要；插件只把四条宿主本来就认识的会话事件写进日志，把旧内容一层层降成更粗的表示：

```
原文（逐字）  →  L1 块（一段的结论与数据）  →  L2 块  →  L3 块（只剩关键词句）
```

越旧的内容分辨率越低，但**从来没有被删掉**——原文仍在会话日志里，装了「会话搜索」插件就能按事件号取回。

名字里的 `ebbing` 是“渐渐消退”。它模拟的是记忆的自然衰退，不是曲线、也不是定时任务：降不降、降多少，由模型看着上下文压力自己决定。

---

## ⚠️ 状态：尚未在真机上安装运行过

代码是完整的，单元测试与冒烟测试全绿（`blocks` 47 / `compress` 11 / `callfold` 18 / `config` 11 / `prestep` 12 / `usage` 8 / `map` 8），但**还没有人在真实的 DSH 里装过它**。第一次安装请：

1. 先备份 profile 目录；
2. 装完先看插件卡片是否变成「运行中」；停在「未运行」说明 load 失败，DSH 日志里会有一条 `import` 相关的错误；
3. 确认两个工具 `context_map` / `compress` 与命令 `/context-status` 都在；
4. 先在一个新会话里试，别在长会话上试。

目标宿主：**DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 ~ 0.2.2-alpha.2**。用到的每个接缝都对着这两版的源码核对过，但核对不等于跑通。

---

## 它怎么工作

- **两个工具 + 一条命令**：`context_map`（看当前分层结构与占用）、`compress`（执行一次压缩）、`/context-status`（只读，内容和地图一致）。
- **键名 = 要压的那一层**：`l0` 压原文区头部 → 产物是 L1 块；`l1` 压 L1 区头部 → L2 块；`l2` 压 L2 区头部 → L3 块；`l3` 把整个 L3 区压成一块（唯一不写 `to` 的键）。
- **`to` 只能从地图上抄**：`l0` 写轮号（`T19`），`l1` / `l2` 写该区从 1 起的块序号。写错就被拒，拒绝回执里带着刷新后的地图。
- **级联**：压深层时，比它浅、且还能压的层必须在同一批里一起给，否则整批拒绝。这样做是为了只断一次前缀缓存。
- **零台账**：不建数据库、不写状态文件。每轮的层级都是从 `session.surface.nodes` 现算出来的，块的身份写在块正文第一行（`〔L1｜T16–T19｜ev 4121–4390〕标题`）。
- **提醒，但不代劳**：占用到 75%、自上次提醒后又长了一大截、或某一层超出设计配额时，插件会在一轮收尾把模型叫醒并给一张新地图——压不压、压哪里，仍然由模型决定。它**从不自动压缩**，也不催你敲宿主的 `/compact`。

---

## 安装

三种方式，都还没在真机上验证过。**npm 包尚未发布**（名字已占位为 `dsh-ebbing-context`），下面第一条等上架后才可用。

**方式零（npm，上架后）**

```bash
npm i -g dsh-ebbing-context
dsh plugin add dsh-ebbing-context
```

**方式一（推荐，源码目录）**

```bash
dsh plugin add "C:\path\to\dsh-ebbing-context"
```

**方式二**：在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加一行 insert：

```yaml
- id: dsh-ebbing-context
  name: ./index.js        # 或包名 dsh-ebbing-context
```

> ⚠️ `name` 只写目录、没写入口文件时，Loader 解析不到会**只写一行日志就放弃**，插件不会启动，界面只显示「未运行」。所以要么用 `dsh plugin add`，要么把 `name` 写成 `./index.js`。

---

## 配置

设置入口：**侧栏「插件」→ 找到 Ebbing Context → 行详情页**（系统「设置」里的插件清单是只读的）。

15 项，全部是普通配置项，保存在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里：

| 分组 | 项 |
|---|---|
| 配额 | `budget.l1` / `budget.l2` / `budget.l3`（各层占可用输入的百分比） |
| 单块上限 | `segment.l1` / `segment.l2` / `segment.l3` / `title.maxTokens` |
| 提醒 | `notice.enabled` / `notice.growthTokens` / `triggerPct` |
| 行为 | `keepTurns` / `pruneFirst` / `foldCallRecord` / `requireSessionQuery` / `reservedTokens` |

**建议关掉宿主自带的自动压缩**（`compaction-basic` 的 `auto`，默认在 80% 时触发）。它一旦触发，会把这里的多层摘要重新拍平成一段高层摘要，细节永久丢失——插件本身不受影响，但效果会打折。本插件不能替你改那一行（它在 profile 的 `group` 里），需要你自己在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里写 `config: { auto: false }`。

---

## 依赖与边界

- **需要「会话搜索」插件**（`session_search` 等工具）。`requireSessionQuery` 默认为 `true`：一旦取回原文的能力不存在，`compress` 与 `context_map` 都会拒绝执行并说明原因——宁可上下文大着，也不做不可逆的事。想在没有它的情况下也能压，把这个开关关掉。
- 不依赖任何特定模型；不调用模型。
- 不实现 `ctx.compaction`、不改宿主压缩插件、不注册 message projection、不拦截网络。

---

## 已知限制

- **不自动压缩**：所有压缩都由模型在对话中主动发起。
- **并行调用时折叠降级**：如果模型把 `compress` 和别的工具放在同一条消息里并行发，调用记录只能改成“折地图、留每个键的结果”，参数里那份摘要副本要到下一次覆盖它的压缩才会消失。
- **图片不单独记账**：宿主自带的图片离线化只处理最老的图片，被压缩遮掉的图片不会额外记录（块里会写一行图片台账）。
- 空节点、缺轮次大纲、缺会话搜索等异常情形都有守卫与明确报错，但这些守卫只在合成会话上跑过，真机行为待验证。

---

## 许可与出处

MIT。

插件里检查点前导语（`This is an automatically generated checkpoint …`）与被压内容边界标签（`<compacted-summary>` / `</compacted-summary>`）的**文字**抄自 DSH 自带的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic`（MIT）——宿主界面与日志靠这段文字识别检查点，必须逐字节一致。除此之外没有复制任何代码。

当前实现的完整规范见 [docs/SPEC.md](https://github.com/Light-EI/dsh-ebbing-context/blob/main/docs/SPEC.md)；设计推演与取舍见 [机制与实现路径](https://github.com/Light-EI/dsh-ebbing-context/blob/main/docs/机制与实现路径.md)。

---

## 参与

欢迎开 Issue 与 Discussion：使用中遇到的问题、对分层策略的想法、真机验证结果都很有用。

Pull Request 同样欢迎，但请先开 Issue 说明要改什么——这个插件的多数行为（提示词措辞、拒绝条件、折叠时机）都是针对宿主具体行为定的，改错一处可能让整个会话压不动，所以大改动需要先对齐设计。

本地跑测试（无依赖，Node ≥ 20）：

```bash
npm test
```

同一个测试集在 CI 里跑 Node 20 与 22 两档（见 `.github/workflows/test.yml`）。

安全问题**不要开公开 Issue**，走 [私密报告](https://github.com/Light-EI/dsh-ebbing-context/security/advisories/new)，细节见 [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Light-EI/dsh-ebbing-context/blob/main/SECURITY.md)。
